<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use App\Models\Location;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ResetCoordinatesCommand extends Command
{
    /**
     * The name and signature of the console command.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $signature = 'sdm:reset-coordinates {--force : Force reset without confirmation}';

    /**
     * The console command description.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $description = 'Reset all coordinates and coordinate sources to null';

    /**
     * Execute the console command.
     */
    public function handle()
    {
        if (!$this->option('force')) {
            if (!$this->confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin mereset semua koordinat di tabel locations?')) {
                $this->info('Dibatalkan.');
                return;
            }
        }

        $count = Location::whereNotNull('latitude')->orWhereNotNull('longitude')->count();
        
        Location::query()->update([
            'latitude' => null,
            'longitude' => null,
            'coordinate_source' => 'manual'
        ]);

        $this->info("Berhasil mereset koordinat untuk {$count} lokasi.");
    }
}

            $employee->join_date,

            $employee->job_level_code,
            $employee->job_title_code,
            $employee->job_title_name,
            $employee->organization_code,
            $employee->organization_name,
            $employee->company ? $employee->company->name : null,
            $employee->location ? $employee->location->name : null,
            $employee->gender,
            $employee->marital_status,
            $employee->religion,
            $employee->ptkp_code,
            $employee->ptkp_name,
            $employee->group,
            $employee->region,
        ];
    }

    public function bindValue(Cell $cell, mixed $value): bool
    {
        $column = $cell->getColumn();
        // Force these code columns to be explicit strings to prevent scientific notation
        if (in_array($column, ['B', 'H', 'I', 'K', 'R'])) {
            $cell->setValueExplicit($value, DataType::TYPE_STRING);
            return true;
        }

        return parent::bindValue($cell, $value);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Exports;

use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\FromQuery;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithHeadings;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithMapping;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\Exportable;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithCustomValueBinder;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DefaultValueBinder;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Cell;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DataType;

class TrainingRecordsExport extends DefaultValueBinder implements FromQuery, WithHeadings, WithMapping, WithCustomValueBinder
{
    use Exportable;

    protected $query;

    public function __construct($query)
    {
        $this->query = $query;
    }

    public function query(): \Illuminate\Database\Query\Builder|\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder|\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\Relation
    {
        return $this->query;
    }

    public function headings(): array
    {
        return [
            'ID Database',
            'NIK / Employee ID',
            'NIK Mentah',
            'Status NIK',
            'Nama Peserta',
            'Nama PT (Raw)',
            'Perusahaan Alias',
            'Departemen',

            'Group',
            'Region',
            'Kategori Jabatan (Staf/Non Staf)',
            'Posisi Jabatan',
            'Periode Bulan',
            'Periode Tahun',
            'Hari',
            'Jam',
            'Nama Pelatihan',
            'Instruktur',
            'Tempat',
            'Reguler / Non Reguler',
            'Internal / Eksternal',
            'Level',
        ];
    }

    public function map($record): array
    {
        return [
            $record->id,
            $record->nik,
            $record->nik_raw,
            $record->nik_status,
            $record->participant_name,
            $record->company_name_raw,
            $record->company ? $record->company->name : null,
            $record->department,
            $record->work_location,
            $record->group,
            $record->region,
            $record->grade,
            $record->position,
            $record->month,
            $record->year,
            $record->days,
            $record->hours,
            $record->training_name,
            $record->instructor,
            $record->venue,
            $record->regularity,
            $record->source_type,
            $record->level,
        ];
    }

    public function bindValue(Cell $cell, mixed $value): bool
    {
        $column = $cell->getColumn();
        // Force these code columns to be explicit strings to prevent scientific notation (NIK & NIK Mentah)
        if (in_array($column, ['B', 'C'])) {
            $cell->setValueExplicit($value, DataType::TYPE_STRING);
            return true;
        }

        return parent::bindValue($cell, $value);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Company;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Location;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Support\Demographics;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class DataController extends Controller
{
    public function locations(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $employees = $query->get(['company_id', 'location_id']);
        $locationIds = $employees->pluck('location_id')->unique()->filter();

        $locations = Location::whereIn('id', $locationIds)->get()->map(function ($l) use ($employees) {
            $emps = $employees->where('location_id', $l->id);

            return [
                'id' => $l->id,
                'code' => $l->code,
                'name' => $l->name,
                'latitude' => $l->latitude,
                'longitude' => $l->longitude,
                'facility_type' => $l->facility_type,
                'coordinate_source' => $l->coordinate_source,
                'region' => $emps->first()?->region ?? ($l->name === 'Corporate Office' || str_contains($l->name, 'Jakarta') ? 'Corp' : 'Unknown'),
                'employee_count' => $emps->count(),
                'companies' => $emps->pluck('company_id')->unique()->values(),
            ];
        });

        return response()->json($locations);
    }

    public function companies(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $employees = $query->get(['company_id', 'location_id', 'region']);
        $companyIds = $employees->pluck('company_id')->unique()->filter();

        $companies = Company::whereIn('id', $companyIds)->get()->map(function ($c) use ($employees) {
            $emps = $employees->where('company_id', $c->id);

            return [
                'id' => $c->id,
                'code' => $c->code,
                'name' => $c->name,
                'employee_count' => $emps->count(),
                'location_count' => $emps->pluck('location_id')->unique()->count(),
                'region' => $emps->first()->region ?? 'Unknown',
            ];
        })->sortByDesc('employee_count')->values();

        return response()->json([
            'data' => $companies,
            'total_locations' => $employees->pluck('location_id')->unique()->filter()->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function companyProfile(Request $request, Company $company, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $query = Employee::query()->where('company_id', $company->id);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);
        $employees = $query->get();

        $totalHc = $employees->count();
        if ($totalHc === 0) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'No data'], 404);
        }

        $females = $employees->where('gender', 'Female')->count();
        $perm = $employees->where('employment_type', 'PERM')->count();

        // Untuk umur dan masa kerja, ambil yg valid saja
        $ages = $employees->map(fn ($e) => Demographics::age(Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)))->filter();
        $loses = $employees->map(fn ($e) => Demographics::los(Carbon::parse($e->join_date)))->filter();

        $avgAge = $ages->count() > 0 ? $ages->average() : 0;
        $avgLos = $loses->count() > 0 ? $loses->average() : 0;

        // Pensiun (55 tahun)
        $pensiun = $employees->filter(fn ($e) => Demographics::ageFullYears(Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)) >= 55)->count();

        // Demografi: Generasi
        $generations = [];
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $g = Demographics::generation(Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)->year);
            if ($g) {
                $generations[$g] = ($generations[$g] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }

        // Job Level
        $levels = [];
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            if ($e->job_level_code) {
                $levels[$e->job_level_code] = ($levels[$e->job_level_code] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }

        // Department
        $depts = [];
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            if ($e->organization_name) {
                $depts[$e->organization_name] = ($depts[$e->organization_name] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }
        arsort($depts);
        $depts = array_slice($depts, 0, 8);

        // Lokasi
        $locs = [];
        $locNames = Location::whereIn('id', $employees->pluck('location_id')->unique())->pluck('name', 'id');
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            if ($e->location_id) {
                $locs[$e->location_id] = ($locs[$e->location_id] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }
        $locDetails = [];
        foreach ($locs as $id => $c) {
            $locDetails[] = [
                'id' => $id,
                'name' => $locNames[$id] ?? 'Unknown',
                'count' => $c,
            ];
        }

        return response()->json([
            'kpi' => [
                'hc' => $totalHc,
                'avg_age' => round($avgAge, 1),
                'avg_los' => round($avgLos, 1),
                'female_pct' => round(($females / $totalHc) * 100, 1),
                'perm_pct' => round(($perm / $totalHc) * 100, 1),
                'pensiun' => $pensiun,
            ],
            'generations' => $generations,
            'levels' => $levels,
            'departments' => $depts,
            'locations' => $locDetails,
        ]);
    }

    public function companyEmployees(Request $request, Company $company, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $query = Employee::query()->where('company_id', $company->id);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        if ($request->search) {
            $s = $request->search;
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($s) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%$s%")
                    ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%$s%")
                    ->orWhere('job_title_name', 'like', "%$s%");
            });
        }
        if ($request->location_id) {
            $query->where('location_id', $request->location_id);
        }
        if ($request->level) {
            $query->where('job_level_code', $request->level);
        }
        if ($request->employment_type) {
            $query->where('employment_type', $request->employment_type);
        }

        $employees = $query->paginate(20);

        // Map data yg akan direturn
        $employees->getCollection()->transform(function ($e) {
            return [
                'employee_id' => $e->employee_id,
                'name' => $e->name,
                'job_title_name' => $e->job_title_name,
                'job_level_code' => $e->job_level_code,
                'age' => Demographics::ageFullYears(Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)),
                'los' => Demographics::losFullYears(Carbon::parse($e->join_date)),
            ];
        });

        return response()->json($employees);
    }

    public function employeeDetail(Request $request, string $employee_id, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $employee = Employee::where('employee_id', $employee_id)->firstOrFail();

        // Catat audit log
        AuditLogger::log(
            $user->id,
            'VIEW_EMPLOYEE_DETAIL',
            Employee::class,
            $employee->id,
            ['description' => "Viewed detail of employee: {$employee->employee_id}"]
        );

        $company = Company::find($employee->company_id);
        $location = Location::find($employee->location_id);

        $birthDate = Carbon::parse($employee->birth_date);
        $age = Demographics::ageFullYears($birthDate);
        $retireYear = $birthDate->copy()->addYears(55)->format('d M Y');
        $isRetireRisk = $age >= 55;

        // Trainings
        $trainings = DB::table('training_records')->where('nik', $employee->employee_id)->get();

        return response()->json([
            'identitas' => [
                'name' => $employee->name,
                'employee_id' => $employee->employee_id,
                'job' => $employee->job_title_code.' - '.$employee->job_title_name,
                'level' => $employee->job_level_code,
                'dept' => $employee->organization_code.' - '.$employee->organization_name,
                'company' => $company->name ?? '-',
                'location' => $location->name ?? '-',
                'group' => $employee->group,
                'region' => $employee->region,
            ],
            'pribadi' => [
                'gender' => $employee->gender,
                'birth_place' => $employee->birth_place,
                'birth_date' => $birthDate->format('d M Y'),
                'age' => $age,
                'religion' => $employee->religion,
                'marital_status' => $employee->marital_status,
                'ptkp' => $employee->ptkp_code.' ('.$employee->ptkp_name.')',
            ],
            'kepegawaian' => [
                'join_date' => Carbon::parse($employee->join_date)->format('d M Y'),
                'los' => Demographics::losFullYears(Carbon::parse($employee->join_date)),
                'employment_type' => $employee->employment_type,
                'generation' => Demographics::generation($birthDate->year),
                'retire_risk' => $isRetireRisk,
                'retire_date' => $retireYear,
            ],
            'pelatihan' => $trainings->map(function ($t) {
                return [
                    'name' => $t->training_name,
                    'month_year' => $t->month.'/'.$t->year,
                    'hours' => $t->hours,
                    'provider' => $t->instructor,
                    'regularity' => $t->regularity,
                ];
            }),
            'pelatihan_total_jam' => $trainings->sum('hours'),
        ]);
    }

    public function trainings(Request $request, \App\Support\TrainingFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = DB::table('training_records');
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        if ($request->filled('search')) {
            $s = $request->input('search');
            $query->where('training_name', 'like', "%{$s}%");
        }
        
        $events = $query->select(
            'training_name',
            'month',
            'year',
            'source_type',
            DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) as participants'),
            DB::raw('SUM(hours) as total_hours')
        )
        ->groupBy('training_name', 'month', 'year', 'source_type');

        $sortField = $request->input('sort', 'year');
        $sortDir = $request->input('direction', 'desc');
        
        $validSorts = ['training_name', 'month', 'year', 'participants', 'total_hours', 'source_type'];
        if (in_array($sortField, $validSorts)) {
            if ($sortField === 'year' || $sortField === 'month') {
                $events->orderBy('year', $sortDir)->orderBy('month', $sortDir);
            } else {
                $events->orderBy($sortField, $sortDir);
            }
        }

        $paginated = $events->paginate(15);
        
        return response()->json($paginated);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use App\Support\Demographics;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use App\Exports\EmployeesExport;

class EmployeeDirectoryController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = Employee::with(['company', 'location']);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        // Search
        if ($search = $request->input('search')) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('job_title_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        // Sorting
        $sortKey = $request->input('sort', 'name');
        $sortOrder = $request->input('order', 'asc');
        
        $allowedSorts = [
            'employee_id', 'name', 'company_name', 'organization_name', 
            'job_title_name', 'job_level_code', 'employment_type'
        ];
        
        if ($sortKey === 'umur' || $sortKey === 'generasi') {
            $query->orderBy('birth_date', $sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'); 
        } elseif ($sortKey === 'masa_kerja') {
            $query->orderBy('join_date', $sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } elseif ($sortKey === 'company_name') {
            $query->join('companies', 'employees.company_id', '=', 'companies.id')
                  ->orderBy('companies.name', $sortOrder)
                  ->select('employees.*');
        } elseif (in_array($sortKey, $allowedSorts)) {
            $query->orderBy($sortKey, $sortOrder);
        }

        $perPage = (int) $request->input('per_page', 25);
        if (!in_array($perPage, [25, 50, 100])) {
            $perPage = 25;
        }

        $employees = $query->paginate($perPage)->withQueryString();

        // Transform for display
        $employees->getCollection()->transform(function ($e) {
            return [
                'id' => $e->id,
                'employee_id' => $e->employee_id,
                'name' => $e->name,
                'company_name' => $e->company->name ?? '-',
                'location_name' => $e->location->name ?? '-',
                'department' => $e->organization_name ?? '-',
                'job_title' => $e->job_title_name ?? '-',
                'level' => $e->job_level_code ?? '-',
                'employment_type' => $e->employment_type ?? '-',
                'generasi' => Demographics::generation($e->birth_date ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($e->birth_date)->year : null),
                'umur' => Demographics::age($e->birth_date ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($e->birth_date) : null),
                'masa_kerja' => Demographics::los($e->join_date ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null),
                
                // Add fields required by StaffDetailModal if needed
                'company_id' => $e->company_id,
                'region' => $e->region,
                'join_date' => $e->join_date,
                'birth_date' => $e->birth_date,
                'gender' => $e->gender,
                'marital_status' => $e->marital_status,
                'religion' => $e->religion,
                'ptkp_code' => $e->ptkp_code,
            ];
        });

        return Inertia::render('Employees/Index', [
            'employees' => $employees,
            'filters' => $request->all(),
        ]);
    }
    
    public function export(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        // 5.000 max rows
        $query = Employee::with(['company', 'location']);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);
        
        if ($search = $request->input('search')) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('employee_id', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('job_title_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }
        
        $count = $query->count();
        if ($count > 5000) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Export gagal: Maksimal 5.000 baris per ekspor. Silakan persempit filter.');
        }
        
        // Log to AuditLogger
        \App\Services\AuditLogger::log(auth()->id() ?? 1, 'EXPORT_EMPLOYEES', null, null, ['count' => $count]);

        return Excel::download(new EmployeesExport($query), 'direktori_karyawan_' . date('Ymd_His') . '.xlsx');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Company;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Location;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class FilterOptionsController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        // For distinct options, we can query Employee, Company, Location
        // Since dataset is small, doing distinct queries is fine
        
        $companies = Company::orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'code', 'name']);

        $employeeOptions = Employee::query()->get([
            'region', 'group', 'organization_name', 'job_level_code', 'employment_type', 'gender', 'location_id', 'company_id'
        ]);

        $regions = $employeeOptions->pluck('region')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $groups = $employeeOptions->pluck('group')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $departments = $employeeOptions->pluck('organization_name')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $jobLevels = $employeeOptions->pluck('job_level_code')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $employmentTypes = $employeeOptions->pluck('employment_type')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        $genders = $employeeOptions->pluck('gender')->unique()->filter()->sort()->values();
        


        $locationsMap = [];
        foreach ($employeeOptions as $emp) {
            if ($emp->location_id) {
                if (!isset($locationsMap[$emp->location_id])) {
                    $locationsMap[$emp->location_id] = [];
                }
                $locationsMap[$emp->location_id][] = $emp->company_id;
            }
        }

        $activeLocationIds = array_keys($locationsMap);
        $locations = Location::whereIn('id', $activeLocationIds)->orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'name'])->map(function ($loc) use ($locationsMap) {
            return [
                'id' => $loc->id,
                'name' => $loc->name,
                'companies' => array_values(array_unique($locationsMap[$loc->id] ?? [])),
            ];
        });

        // Generations are static
        $generations = ['Boomers', 'Gen X', 'Gen Y', 'Gen Z'];

        $trainingRegions = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('training_records')
            ->select('region')
            ->distinct()
            ->whereNotNull('region')
            ->pluck('region')
            ->sort()
            ->values();

        return response()->json([
            'regions' => $regions,
            'trainingRegions' => $trainingRegions,
            'groups' => $groups,
            'companies' => $companies,
            'locations' => $locations,
            'departments' => $departments,
            'jobLevels' => $jobLevels,
            'employmentTypes' => $employmentTypes,
            'genders' => $genders,
            'generations' => $generations,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Services\Import\EmployeeImporter;
use App\Services\Import\TrainingImporter;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ImportController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $batches = ImportBatch::latest()->take(20)->get();
        return Inertia::render('Admin/Import', [
            'batches' => $batches
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request, EmployeeImporter $empImporter, TrainingImporter $trainImporter)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'type' => 'required|in:employee,training',
            'file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt,xlsx,xls'
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $type = $request->input('type');

        try {
            if ($type === 'employee') {
                $empImporter->import($file, $request->user()->id);
            } else {
                $trainImporter->import($file, $request->user()->id);
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Import gagal: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }

        return back()->with('success', 'Import berhasil dijalankan.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Location;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class LocationController extends Controller
{

    {

            ->withCount('employees')
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get();

        return Inertia::render('Admin/Location', [
            'locations' => $locations

    }

    public function update(Request $request, Location $location)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'latitude' => 'nullable|numeric|min:-11|max:6',
            'longitude' => 'nullable|numeric|min:95|max:141',
            'facility_type' => 'nullable|string'
        ]);

        $location->update($validated);

        \App\Services\AuditLogger::log(
            $request->user()->id,
            'UPDATE_LOCATION',
            Location::class,
            $location->id,
            ['description' => "Updated coordinate for location: {$location->code}"]
        );

        return back()->with('success', 'Koordinat berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function import(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt'
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $fh = fopen($file->getRealPath(), 'r');
        $header = fgetcsv($fh, 0, ';');

        if (!$header || !in_array('code', $header) || !in_array('latitude', $header) || !in_array('longitude', $header)) {
            fclose($fh);
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Format kolom CSV harus memuat code;latitude;longitude dengan delimiter titik koma (;).']);
        }

        $codeIdx = array_search('code', $header);
        $latIdx = array_search('latitude', $header);
        $lngIdx = array_search('longitude', $header);
        $confIdx = array_search('confidence', $header);

        $updated = 0;
        $errors = [];

        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            while (($row = fgetcsv($fh, 0, ';')) !== false) {
                if (!isset($row[$codeIdx]) || !isset($row[$latIdx]) || !isset($row[$lngIdx])) continue;
                
                $code = trim($row[$codeIdx]);
                $lat = trim($row[$latIdx]);
                $lng = trim($row[$lngIdx]);
                $conf = $confIdx !== false && isset($row[$confIdx]) ? trim($row[$confIdx]) : '';

                if ($code === '' || $lat === '' || $lng === '') {
                    $errors[] = "Baris dengan kode $code dilewati: koordinat kosong.";
                    continue;
                }

                // Strict validation: precisely one dot or no dot, and must be numeric. No comma.
                if (strpos($lat, ',') !== false || strpos($lng, ',') !== false) {
                    $errors[] = "Baris dengan kode $code ditolak: menggunakan koma sebagai desimal.";
                    continue;
                }
                if (substr_count($lat, '.') > 1 || substr_count($lng, '.') > 1) {
                    $errors[] = "Baris dengan kode $code ditolak: format angka desimal tidak valid (terlalu banyak titik).";
                    continue;
                }
                if (!is_numeric($lat) || !is_numeric($lng)) {
                    $errors[] = "Baris dengan kode $code ditolak: bukan angka yang valid.";
                    continue;
                }
                if ($lat < -11 || $lat > 6 || $lng < 95 || $lng > 141) {
                    $errors[] = "Baris dengan kode $code ditolak: di luar batas Indonesia.";
                    continue;
                }

                $loc = Location::where('code', $code)->first();
                if (!$loc) {
                    $errors[] = "Baris dengan kode $code ditolak: lokasi tidak ditemukan di database.";
                    continue;
                }

                $source = 'manual';
                if ($conf === 'resmi') {
                    $source = 'resmi';
                } elseif (in_array($conf, ['pendekatan-pabrik', 'pendekatan-alamat', 'sedang'])) {
                    $source = 'pendekatan';
                }

                // Cek kewajaran per region
                $region = \App\Models\Employee::where('location_id', $loc->id)->value('region') ?? 'Unknown';
                if ($loc->name === 'Corporate Office' || str_contains($loc->name, 'Jakarta')) {
                    $region = 'Corp';
                }

                $warn = false;
                if ($region === 'Riau' && ($lat < -1.5 || $lat > 2.5 || $lng < 100 || $lng > 104.5)) $warn = true;
                if ($region === 'Kalbar' && ($lat < -3.5 || $lat > 2 || $lng < 108 || $lng > 112)) $warn = true;
                if (($region === 'Kubar' || $region === 'Kaltim') && ($lat < -3 || $lat > 2 || $lng < 114 || $lng > 118)) $warn = true;
                if ($region === 'Corp' && ($lat < -7 || $lat > -5.5 || $lng < 106 || $lng > 107.5)) $warn = true;

                if ($warn) {
                    $errors[] = "Peringatan pada kode $code: Koordinat sepertinya di luar kotak region $region.";
                }

                $loc->update([
                    'latitude' => $lat,
                    'longitude' => $lng,
                    'coordinate_source' => $source
                ]);
                $updated++;
            }

            \App\Services\AuditLogger::log(
                $request->user()->id,
                'IMPORT_LOCATIONS',
                null,
                null,
                ['description' => "Imported coordinates for $updated locations."]
            );

            DB::commit();
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            fclose($fh);
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Gagal memproses file. Pastikan delimiter titik koma (;) digunakan.']);
        }
        fclose($fh);

        if (count($errors) > 0) {
            return back()->with('warning', "Berhasil memperbarui $updated lokasi. " . count($errors) . " baris ditolak. Contoh: " . $errors[0]);
        }

        return back()->with('success', "Berhasil memperbarui $updated koordinat lokasi.");
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateProfileRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdatePasswordRequest;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;

class ProfileController extends Controller
{
    public function edit(Request $request)
    {
        return Inertia::render('Profile/Edit', [
            'mustVerifyEmail' => false,
            'status' => session('status'),
        ]);
    }

    public function updateProfile(UpdateProfileRequest $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $user->fill($request->validated());

        if ($user->isDirty('email')) {
            $user->email_verified_at = null;
        }

        $user->save();

        AuditLogger::log($user->id, 'account.updated', get_class($user), $user->id);

        return back()->with('status', 'profile-updated');
    }

    public function updatePassword(UpdatePasswordRequest $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $validated = $request->validated();

        $user->update([
            'password' => Hash::make($validated['password']),
        ]);

        AuditLogger::log($user->id, 'account.password_changed', get_class($user), $user->id);

        return back()->with('status', 'password-updated');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use App\Models\TrainingRecord;
use App\Support\TrainingFilter;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use App\Exports\TrainingRecordsExport;

class TrainingRecordController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request, TrainingFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = TrainingRecord::with(['employee', 'company']);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        // Filter NIK Status
        if ($nikStatus = $request->input('nik_status')) {
            if ($nikStatus === 'terhubung') {
                $query->whereNotNull('employee_id');
            } elseif ($nikStatus === 'tidak_terhubung') {
                $query->whereNull('employee_id');
            } elseif (in_array($nikStatus, ['kosong', 'rusak', 'tidak_valid'])) {
                if ($nikStatus === 'kosong') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'empty');
                } elseif ($nikStatus === 'rusak') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'corrupt');
                } elseif ($nikStatus === 'tidak_valid') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'not_found');
                }
            }
        }

        // Search
        if ($search = $request->input('search')) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('participant_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('nik', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('nik_raw', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('training_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('company_name_raw', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        // Sorting
        $sortKey = $request->input('sort', 'participant_name');
        $sortOrder = $request->input('order', 'asc');
        
        $allowedSorts = [
            'nik', 'participant_name', 'company_name_raw', 'department', 
            'work_location', 'group', 'region', 'grade', 'position',
            'month', 'year', 'days', 'hours', 'training_name',
            'instructor', 'venue', 'regularity', 'source_type', 'level'
        ];
        
        if (in_array($sortKey, $allowedSorts)) {
            $query->orderBy($sortKey, $sortOrder);
        } else {
            $query->orderBy('id', 'desc');
        }

        $perPage = (int) $request->input('per_page', 25);
        if (!in_array($perPage, [25, 50, 100])) {
            $perPage = 25;
        }

        $records = $query->paginate($perPage)->withQueryString();

        // Transform for display
        $records->getCollection()->transform(function ($t) {
            return [
                'id' => $t->id,
                'employee_id' => $t->employee_id,
                'nik' => $t->nik_status === 'ok' ? $t->nik : $t->nik_raw,
                'nik_status' => $t->nik_status,
                'participant_name' => $t->participant_name,
                'pt_name' => $t->company_name_raw,
                'company_alias' => $t->company->name ?? '-',
                'department' => $t->department,
                'work_location' => $t->work_location,
                'group' => $t->group,
                'region' => $t->region,
                'job_category' => $t->grade,
                'job_position' => $t->position,
                'period_month' => $t->month,
                'period_year' => $t->year,
                'days' => $t->days,
                'hours' => $t->hours,
                'training_name' => $t->training_name,
                'instructor' => $t->instructor,
                'place' => $t->venue,
                'is_regular' => $t->regularity === 'Reguler' || $t->regularity == 1,
                'is_internal' => $t->source_type === 'Internal' || $t->source_type == 1,
                'level' => $t->level,
                
                // Fields for employee modal if linked
                'employee' => $t->employee_id ? [
                    'id' => $t->employee->id ?? null,
                    'employee_id' => $t->employee->employee_id ?? null,
                    'name' => $t->employee->name ?? null,
                    'company_name' => $t->employee->company->name ?? null,
                    'location_name' => $t->employee->location->name ?? null,
                    'department' => $t->employee->organization_name ?? null,
                    'job_title' => $t->employee->job_title_name ?? null,
                    'level' => $t->employee->job_level_code ?? null,
                    'employment_type' => $t->employee->employment_type ?? null,
                    'company_id' => $t->employee->company_id ?? null,
                    'region' => $t->employee->region ?? null,
                    'join_date' => $t->employee->join_date ?? null,
                    'birth_date' => $t->employee->birth_date ?? null,
                    'gender' => $t->employee->gender ?? null,
                    'marital_status' => $t->employee->marital_status ?? null,
                    'religion' => $t->employee->religion ?? null,
                    'ptkp_code' => $t->employee->ptkp_code ?? null,
                ] : null,
            ];
        });

        return Inertia::render('Training/Data', [
            'records' => $records,
            'filters' => $request->all(),
        ]);
    }
    
    public function export(Request $request, TrainingFilter $filter)
    {
        // 5.000 max rows
        $query = TrainingRecord::with(['company']);
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);
        
        // Filter NIK Status
        if ($nikStatus = $request->input('nik_status')) {
            if ($nikStatus === 'terhubung') {
                $query->whereNotNull('employee_id');
            } elseif ($nikStatus === 'tidak_terhubung') {
                $query->whereNull('employee_id');
            } elseif (in_array($nikStatus, ['kosong', 'rusak', 'tidak_valid'])) {
                if ($nikStatus === 'kosong') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'empty');
                } elseif ($nikStatus === 'rusak') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'corrupt');
                } elseif ($nikStatus === 'tidak_valid') {
                    $query->where('nik_status', 'not_found');
                }
            }
        }

        if ($search = $request->input('search')) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('participant_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('nik', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('nik_raw', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('training_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('pt_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }
        
        $count = $query->count();
        if ($count > 5000) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Export gagal: Maksimal 5.000 baris per ekspor. Silakan persempit filter.');
        }
        
        // Log to AuditLogger
        \App\Services\AuditLogger::log(auth()->id() ?? 1, 'EXPORT_TRAINING_RECORDS', null, null, ['count' => $count]);

        return Excel::download(new TrainingRecordsExport($query), 'data_training_' . date('Ymd_His') . '.xlsx');
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Middleware;

class HandleInertiaRequests extends Middleware
{
    /**
     * The root template that's loaded on the first page visit.
     *
     * @see https://inertiajs.com/server-side-setup#root-template
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $rootView = 'app';

    /**
     * Determines the current asset version.
     *
     * @see https://inertiajs.com/asset-versioning
     */
    public function version(Request $request): ?string
    {
        return parent::version($request);
    }

    /**
     * Define the props that are shared by default.
     *
     * @see https://inertiajs.com/shared-data
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function share(Request $request): array
    {
        return [
            ...parent::share($request),
            'auth' => [
                'user' => $request->user(),
            ],
            'flash' => [
                'success' => $request->session()->get('success'),
                'warning' => $request->session()->get('warning'),
                'error' => $request->session()->get('error'),
            ],
        ];
    }
}

File: app/Imports/GenericImport.php
================
<?php

namespace App\Imports;

use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\ToArray;

use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithCustomValueBinder;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Cell;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DataType;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DefaultValueBinder;

class GenericImport extends DefaultValueBinder implements ToArray, WithCustomValueBinder
{
    public function array(array $array): void
    {
        // Handled by Excel::toArray() return value.
    }

    public function bindValue(Cell $cell, mixed $value): bool
    {
        // Jika nilai aslinya string numerik panjang, paksa sebagai string agar tidak jadi float/notasi ilmiah
        if (is_string($value) && is_numeric($value) && strlen($value) >= 10 && !str_contains($value, '.')) {
            $cell->setValueExplicit($value, DataType::TYPE_STRING);
            return true;
        }

        return parent::bindValue($cell, $value);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class AuditLogger
{
    /**
     * Catat aksi ke audit logs.
     *
     * @param int $userId ID pengguna yang melakukan aksi
     * @param string $action Nama aksi, contoh: 'IMPORT_LOCATIONS', 'VIEW_EMPLOYEE_DETAIL'
     * @param string|null $subjectType Model class, contoh: Location::class
     * @param int|null $subjectId ID dari model
     * @param array $meta Data tambahan dalam bentuk array
     * @return void
     */
    public static function log(int $userId, string $action, ?string $subjectType = null, ?int $subjectId = null, array $meta = [])
    {
        DB::table('audit_logs')->insert([
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'action' => $action,
            'subject_type' => $subjectType,
            'subject_id' => $subjectId,
            'meta' => json_encode($meta),
            'created_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }
}

File: app/Services/CombinedMetrics.php

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use App\Support\Demographics;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use App\Models\Employee;

class CombinedMetrics
{
    public function getMetrics(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $asOf = $request->input('as_of') ? Carbon::parse($request->input('as_of')) : Carbon::now();
        
        $query = Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);
        
        $employees = $query->get([
            'id', 'employee_id', 'region', 'company_id', 'organization_name', 'job_level_code', 
            'birth_date', 'join_date', 'gender'
        ]);
        
        $totalEmployees = $employees->count();
        if ($totalEmployees === 0) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }
        
        $empIds = $employees->pluck('id')->toArray();
        
        $trainings = DB::table('training_records')
            ->whereNotNull('employee_id')
            ->whereIn('employee_id', $empIds)
            ->get(['employee_id', 'hours']);

        $totalTrainingsAll = DB::table('training_records')->count();
        $unlinkedTrainingsAll = DB::table('training_records')->whereNull('employee_id')->count();
        $unlinkedPct = $totalTrainingsAll > 0 ? round(($unlinkedTrainingsAll / $totalTrainingsAll) * 100, 1) : 0;
        
        $banner = [
            'unlinked_count' => $unlinkedTrainingsAll,
            'total_count' => $totalTrainingsAll,
            'unlinked_pct' => $unlinkedPct
        ];

        $empHours = [];
        foreach ($trainings as $t) {
            if (!isset($empHours[$t->employee_id])) $empHours[$t->employee_id] = 0;
            $empHours[$t->employee_id] += $t->hours;
        }
        
        $covRegion = [];
        $covCompany = [];
        $covDept = [];
        $covLevel = [];

        $hrsGen = [];
        $hrsLevel = [];
        $hrsGender = [];
        
        $retirementTraining = [
            '0_jam' => 0,
            '1_15_jam' => 0,
            '16_plus_jam' => 0,
        ];
        
        $newHireNoTrainingCount = \App\Support\MetricsHelper::countNewHireNoTraining($employees, $asOf, $empHours);
        $scatter = [];
        $companyRanking = [];

        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $hasTraining = isset($empHours[$e->id]);
            $hours = $hasTraining ? $empHours[$e->id] : 0;
            
            $reg = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
            $cid = $e->company_id ?? 0;
            $dept = $e->organization_name ?? 'Unknown';
            $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
            $gender = $e->gender ?? 'Unknown';
            
            if (!isset($covRegion[$reg])) $covRegion[$reg] = ['total' => 0, 'trained' => 0];
            if (!isset($covCompany[$cid])) $covCompany[$cid] = ['total' => 0, 'trained' => 0];
            if (!isset($covDept[$dept])) $covDept[$dept] = ['total' => 0, 'trained' => 0];
            if (!isset($covLevel[$lvl])) $covLevel[$lvl] = ['total' => 0, 'trained' => 0];
            
            $covRegion[$reg]['total']++;
            $covCompany[$cid]['total']++;
            $covDept[$dept]['total']++;
            $covLevel[$lvl]['total']++;
            
            if ($hasTraining) {
                $covRegion[$reg]['trained']++;
                $covCompany[$cid]['trained']++;
                $covDept[$dept]['trained']++;
                $covLevel[$lvl]['trained']++;
            }
            
            $birth = $e->birth_date ? Carbon::parse($e->birth_date) : null;
            $ageFloat = Demographics::age($birth, $asOf);
            $gen = Demographics::generation($birth ? $birth->year : null);
            
            $join = $e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null;
            $tenureFloat = Demographics::los($join, $asOf);
            
            if ($hasTraining) {
                if (!isset($hrsGen[$gen])) $hrsGen[$gen] = ['hours' => 0, 'linked_hc' => 0];
                if (!isset($hrsLevel[$lvl])) $hrsLevel[$lvl] = ['hours' => 0, 'linked_hc' => 0];
                if (!isset($hrsGender[$gender])) $hrsGender[$gender] = ['hours' => 0, 'linked_hc' => 0];
                
                $hrsGen[$gen]['hours'] += $hours;
                $hrsGen[$gen]['linked_hc']++;
                
                $hrsLevel[$lvl]['hours'] += $hours;
                $hrsLevel[$lvl]['linked_hc']++;
                
                $hrsGender[$gender]['hours'] += $hours;
                $hrsGender[$gender]['linked_hc']++;
            }
            
            $isRisk = Demographics::isRetirementRisk($birth, $asOf);
            if ($isRisk) {
                if ($hours == 0) $retirementTraining['0_jam']++;
                elseif ($hours <= 15) $retirementTraining['1_15_jam']++;
                else $retirementTraining['16_plus_jam']++;
            }
            
            // Removed new hire no training inline calculation
            
            if ($tenureFloat !== null && $hasTraining) {
                $scatter[] = [
                    'masa_kerja' => round($tenureFloat, 2),
                    'jam_pelatihan' => round($hours, 1)
                ];
            }
            
            if (!isset($companyRanking[$cid])) {
                $companyRanking[$cid] = [
                    'hc' => 0, 'age_sum' => 0, 'age_count' => 0, 
                    'linked_hc' => 0, 'hours_sum' => 0, 'risk_count' => 0
                ];
            }
            $companyRanking[$cid]['hc']++;
            if ($ageFloat !== null) {
                $companyRanking[$cid]['age_sum'] += $ageFloat;
                $companyRanking[$cid]['age_count']++;
            }
            if ($hasTraining) {
                $companyRanking[$cid]['linked_hc']++;
                $companyRanking[$cid]['hours_sum'] += $hours;
            }
            if ($isRisk) {
                $companyRanking[$cid]['risk_count']++;
            }
        }
        
        $formatCoverage = function($map) {
            $res = [];
            foreach ($map as $name => $data) {
                $pct = $data['total'] > 0 ? ($data['trained'] / $data['total']) * 100 : 0;
                $res[] = ['name' => $name, 'trained' => $data['trained'], 'total' => $data['total'], 'pct' => round($pct, 1)];
            }
            usort($res, fn($a, $b) => $b['pct'] <=> $a['pct']);
            return $res;
        };
        
        $formatAvg = function($map) {
            $res = [];
            foreach ($map as $name => $data) {
                $avg = $data['linked_hc'] > 0 ? $data['hours'] / $data['linked_hc'] : 0;
                $res[] = ['name' => $name, 'avg_hours' => round($avg, 1), 'total_hours' => $data['hours'], 'linked_hc' => $data['linked_hc']];
            }
            usort($res, fn($a, $b) => $b['avg_hours'] <=> $a['avg_hours']);
            return $res;
        };

        $companyIds = array_keys($companyRanking);
        $companyNames = DB::table('companies')->whereIn('id', $companyIds)->pluck('name', 'id');
        
        $companyRankTable = [];
        foreach ($companyRanking as $cid => $data) {
            $name = $companyNames[$cid] ?? 'Unknown';
            $avgAge = $data['age_count'] > 0 ? $data['age_sum'] / $data['age_count'] : 0;
            $cov = $data['hc'] > 0 ? ($data['linked_hc'] / $data['hc']) * 100 : 0;
            $avgHours = $data['linked_hc'] > 0 ? $data['hours_sum'] / $data['linked_hc'] : 0;
            $riskPct = $data['hc'] > 0 ? ($data['risk_count'] / $data['hc']) * 100 : 0;
            
            $companyRankTable[] = [
                'name' => $name,
                'hc' => $data['hc'],
                'avg_age' => round($avgAge, 1),
                'coverage' => round($cov, 1),
                'avg_hours' => round($avgHours, 1),
                'risk_pct' => round($riskPct, 1),
            ];
        }
        usort($companyRankTable, fn($a, $b) => $b['coverage'] <=> $a['coverage']);
        
        $covCompanyNamed = [];
        foreach ($covCompany as $cid => $data) {
            $name = $companyNames[$cid] ?? 'Unknown';
            $covCompanyNamed[$name] = $data;
        }

        return [
            'banner' => $banner,
            'coverage' => [
                'region' => $formatCoverage($covRegion),
                'company' => $formatCoverage($covCompanyNamed),
                'dept' => $formatCoverage($covDept),
                'level' => $formatCoverage($covLevel),
            ],
            'hours' => [
                'generation' => $formatAvg($hrsGen),
                'level' => $formatAvg($hrsLevel),
                'gender' => $formatAvg($hrsGender),
            ],
            'retirement_training' => $retirementTraining,
            'new_hire_no_training' => $newHireNoTrainingCount,
            'scatter' => $scatter,
            'company_ranking' => $companyRankTable,
        ];
    }
    
    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Import;

use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Support\Clean;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use App\Imports\GenericImport;

class EmployeeImporter
{
    private array $companiesCache = [];
    private array $locationsCache = [];

    public function import(UploadedFile $file, ?int $userId = null): ImportBatch
    {
        $batch = ImportBatch::create([
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'type' => 'employee',
            'filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
            'status' => 'running',
            'started_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $report = new ImportReport();

        try {
            DB::transaction(function () use ($file, $report) {
                $this->companiesCache = DB::table('companies')->pluck('id', 'code')->all();
                $this->locationsCache = DB::table('locations')->pluck('id', 'code')->all();
                $this->processFile($file, $report);
            });

            try {
                $batch->update([
                    'rows_total' => $report->totalRows,
                    'rows_imported' => $report->importedRows,
                    'rows_skipped' => $report->skippedRows,
                    'warnings' => $report->warnings,
                    'finished_at' => now(),
                    'status' => 'completed',
                ]);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                file_put_contents('warnings_dump.json', json_encode($report->warnings, JSON_PARTIAL_OUTPUT_ON_ERROR));
                file_put_contents('warnings_dump.txt', print_r($report->warnings, true));
                throw $e;
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $batch->update([
                'status' => 'failed',
                'finished_at' => now(),
                'warnings' => ['error' => $e->getMessage()],
            ]);
            throw $e;
        }

        return $batch;
    }

    private function processFile(UploadedFile $file, ImportReport $report): void
    {
        $data = Excel::toArray(new GenericImport, $file);
        if (empty($data) || empty($data[0])) {
            throw new RuntimeException("File kosong atau tidak dapat dibaca");
        }
        
        $rows = $data[0];
        $header = array_map('trim', array_filter((array) $rows[0], fn($v) => $v !== null));
        $expectedHeader = ['Employee ID', 'Employee Name', 'Join Date', 'Employment Type', 'Job Level Code', 'Job Title Code', 'Job Title Name', 'Organization Code', 'Organization Name', 'Location Code', 'Location Name', 'Company Code', 'Company Name', 'Birth Date', 'Birth Place', 'Gender', 'Marital Status', 'Religion', 'PTKP Code', 'PTKP Name', 'Group', 'Region'];
        
        $missing = array_diff($expectedHeader, $header);
        if ($missing) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Kolom hilang: ' . implode(', ', $missing));
        }

        $count = count($header);

        $existingEmpIds = DB::table('employees')->pluck('employee_id')->all();
        $importedEmpIds = [];

        // Mulai dari baris ke-2 (index 1)
        for ($i = 1; $i < count($rows); $i++) {
            $r = $rows[$i];
            
            // Skip baris kosong
            if (empty(array_filter($r, fn($val) => $val !== null && $val !== ''))) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $r = array_pad($r, $count, null);
            $row = array_combine($header, array_slice($r, 0, $count));
            
            $report->totalRows++;
            $employeeId = trim((string) $row['Employee ID']);
            if ($employeeId !== '') {
                $importedEmpIds[] = $employeeId;
            }
            $this->processRow($row, $report);
        }

        $missing = array_diff($existingEmpIds, $importedEmpIds);
        if ($missing) {
            $report->addWarning('missing_from_file', 'Karyawan ada di DB tapi tidak ada di file baru', count($missing) . ' karyawan, misal: ' . implode(', ', array_slice($missing, 0, 5)));
        }
    }

    private function processRow(array $r, ImportReport $report): void
    {
        $now = now();
        $employeeId = trim((string) $r['Employee ID']);
        
        if ($employeeId === '') {
            $report->skippedRows++;
            $report->addWarning('missing_employee_id', 'Baris tanpa Employee ID');
            return;
        }

        $companyCode = trim((string) $r['Company Code']);
        if (!isset($this->companiesCache[$companyCode])) {
            $id = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId([
                'code' => $companyCode,
                'name' => trim((string) $r['Company Name']),
                'group' => trim((string) $r['Group']),
                'region' => trim((string) $r['Region']),
                'created_at' => $now,
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]);
            $this->companiesCache[$companyCode] = $id;
        } else {
            DB::table('companies')->where('id', $this->companiesCache[$companyCode])->update([
                'name' => trim((string) $r['Company Name']),
                'group' => trim((string) $r['Group']),
                'region' => trim((string) $r['Region']),
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]);
        }
        $companyId = $this->companiesCache[$companyCode];

        $locationCode = trim((string) $r['Location Code']);
        if (!isset($this->locationsCache[$locationCode])) {
            $id = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId([
                'code' => $locationCode,
                'name' => trim((string) $r['Location Name']),
                'created_at' => $now,
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]);
            $this->locationsCache[$locationCode] = $id;
        } else {
            DB::table('locations')->where('id', $this->locationsCache[$locationCode])->update([
                'name' => trim((string) $r['Location Name']),
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]);
        }
        $locationId = $this->locationsCache[$locationCode];

        $birth = Clean::birth($r['Birth Date']);
        $join = Clean::join($r['Join Date']);

        if (!$birth || !$join || $join->lt($birth->copy()->addYears(15)) || $join->isFuture()) {
            $report->addWarning('suspicious_dates', 'Tanggal lahir/masuk mencurigakan', "Employee ID: $employeeId");
        }

        DB::table('employees')->updateOrInsert(
            ['employee_id' => $employeeId],
            [
                'name' => trim((string) $r['Employee Name']),
                'join_date' => $join?->toDateString(),
                'birth_date' => $birth?->toDateString(),
                'birth_place' => trim((string) $r['Birth Place']) ?: null,
                'employment_type' => trim((string) $r['Employment Type']),
                'job_level_code' => trim((string) $r['Job Level Code']),
                'job_title_code' => trim((string) $r['Job Title Code']),
                'job_title_name' => trim((string) $r['Job Title Name']),
                'organization_code' => trim((string) $r['Organization Code']),
                'organization_name' => trim((string) $r['Organization Name']),
                'company_id' => $companyId,
                'location_id' => $locationId,
                'gender' => trim((string) $r['Gender']),
                'marital_status' => trim((string) $r['Marital Status']),
                'religion' => trim((string) $r['Religion']),
                'ptkp_code' => trim((string) $r['PTKP Code']),
                'ptkp_name' => trim((string) $r['PTKP Name']),
                'group' => trim((string) $r['Group']),
                'region' => trim((string) $r['Region']),
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ]
        );
        
        $report->importedRows++;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Import;

class ImportReport
{
    public int $totalRows = 0;
    public int $importedRows = 0;
    public int $skippedRows = 0;
    public array $warnings = [];

    public function addWarning(string $category, string $message, ?string $sample = null): void
    {
        if (!isset($this->warnings[$category])) {
            $this->warnings[$category] = ['message' => $message, 'count' => 0, 'samples' => []];
        }
        $this->warnings[$category]['count']++;
        if ($sample) {
            if (!mb_check_encoding($sample, 'UTF-8')) {
                $sample = mb_convert_encoding($sample, 'UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1');
            }
            if (count($this->warnings[$category]['samples']) < 20) {
                $this->warnings[$category]['samples'][] = $sample;
            }
        }
    }

    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'total_rows' => $this->totalRows,
            'imported_rows' => $this->importedRows,
            'skipped_rows' => $this->skippedRows,
            'warnings' => $this->warnings,
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Import;

use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Support\Clean;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use App\Imports\GenericImport;

class TrainingImporter
{
    private array $companyByKey = [];
    private array $aliasMap = [];
    private array $employeeIds = [];

    public function import(UploadedFile $file, ?int $userId = null): ImportBatch
    {
        $batch = ImportBatch::create([
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'type' => 'training',
            'filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
            'status' => 'running',
            'started_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $report = new ImportReport();

        try {
            DB::transaction(function () use ($file, $report) {
                // Delete existing records
                DB::table('training_records')->delete();
                
                $this->companyByKey = DB::table('companies')->get()->keyBy(fn($c) => Clean::companyKey($c->name))->map->id->all();
                $this->aliasMap = DB::table('company_aliases')->pluck('company_id', 'alias')->all();
                $this->employeeIds = DB::table('employees')->pluck('id', 'employee_id')->all();
                
                $this->processFile($file, $report);
            });

            $batch->update([
                'rows_total' => $report->totalRows,
                'rows_imported' => $report->importedRows,
                'rows_skipped' => $report->skippedRows,
                'warnings' => $report->warnings,
                'finished_at' => now(),
                'status' => 'completed',
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $batch->update([
                'status' => 'failed',
                'finished_at' => now(),
                'warnings' => ['error' => $e->getMessage()],
            ]);
            throw $e;
        }

        return $batch;
    }

    private function processFile(UploadedFile $file, ImportReport $report): void
    {
        $data = Excel::toArray(new GenericImport, $file);
        if (empty($data) || empty($data[0])) {
            throw new RuntimeException("File kosong atau tidak dapat dibaca");
        }
        
        $rows = $data[0];
        $header = array_map('trim', array_filter((array) $rows[0], fn($v) => $v !== null));
        $expectedHeader = ['NIK', 'Nama', 'Jenis Kelamin', 'Nama PT', 'Department', 'lokasi Kerja', 'Group', 'REGION', 'GOL', 'Jabatan', 'Tgl', 'Bln', 'Thn', 'Jml Hari', 'Jam Pelatihan', 'Nama Pelatihan', 'Instruktur', 'Tempat Pelatihan', 'Reg / Non Reg', 'Keterangan', 'Internal/Eksternal', 'Level', 'Periode'];
        
        $missing = array_diff($expectedHeader, $header);
        if ($missing) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Kolom hilang: ' . implode(', ', $missing));
        }

        $count = count($header);
        $insertBatch = [];

        for ($i = 1; $i < count($rows); $i++) {
            $r = $rows[$i];
            
            if (empty(array_filter($r, fn($val) => $val !== null && $val !== ''))) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $r = array_pad($r, $count, null);
            $row = array_combine($header, array_slice($r, 0, $count));
            
            $report->totalRows++;
            
            $month = Clean::month($row['Bln']);
            $year = (int) trim((string) $row['Thn']);
            if (!$month || !$year) {
                $report->skippedRows++;
                $report->addWarning('missing_date', 'Tanpa bulan/tahun', "Baris {$report->totalRows}");
                continue;
            }

            $nikRaw = substr(trim((string) $row['NIK']), 0, 40) ?: null;
            $nikStatus = Clean::nikStatus($row['NIK']);
            $nik = Clean::nik($row['NIK']);
            
            if ($nikStatus === 'empty') $report->addWarning('nik_empty', 'NIK kosong atau "-"', $nikRaw);
            elseif ($nikStatus === 'corrupt') $report->addWarning('nik_corrupt', 'NIK rusak (notasi ilmiah)', $nikRaw);
            elseif ($nikStatus === 'invalid') $report->addWarning('nik_invalid', 'NIK tidak valid (huruf)', $nikRaw);

            $empId = $nik ? ($this->employeeIds[$nik] ?? null) : null;
            if ($nik && !$empId) {
                $report->addWarning('nik_unmatched', 'NIK rapi tetapi tidak ditemukan di data Karyawan', $nik);
            }

            $rawPt = trim((string) $row['Nama PT']);
            $key = Clean::companyKey($rawPt);
            $companyId = $this->aliasMap[$key] ?? $this->companyByKey[$key] ?? null;
            
            if ($key !== '' && !array_key_exists($key, $this->aliasMap)) {
                DB::table('company_aliases')->insertOrIgnore([
                    'alias' => $key,
                    'company_id' => $companyId,
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ]);
                $this->aliasMap[$key] = $companyId;
            }
            
            if (!$companyId && $key !== '') {
                $report->addWarning('company_unmapped', 'Alias PT belum terpetakan', $rawPt);
            }

            $insertBatch[] = [
                'nik' => $nik,
                'nik_raw' => $nikRaw,
                'nik_status' => $nikStatus,
                'employee_id' => $empId,
                'company_id' => $companyId,
                'participant_name' => trim((string) $row['Nama']),
                'gender' => trim((string) $row['Jenis Kelamin']) ?: null,
                'company_name_raw' => $rawPt ?: null,
                'department' => trim((string) $row['Department']) ?: null,
                'work_location' => trim((string) $row['lokasi Kerja']) ?: null,
                'group' => trim((string) $row['Group']) ?: null,
                'region' => Clean::region($row['REGION']),
                'grade' => trim((string) $row['GOL']) ?: null,
                'position' => trim((string) $row['Jabatan']) ?: null,
                'year' => $year,
                'month' => $month,
                'days' => is_numeric($row['Jml Hari']) ? (int) $row['Jml Hari'] : null,
                'hours' => is_numeric($row['Jam Pelatihan']) ? (float) $row['Jam Pelatihan'] : 0,
                'training_name' => trim((string) $row['Nama Pelatihan']),
                'instructor' => trim((string) $row['Instruktur']) ?: null,
                'venue' => trim((string) $row['Tempat Pelatihan']) ?: null,
                'regularity' => Clean::regularity($row['Reg / Non Reg']),
                'note' => trim((string) $row['Keterangan']) ?: null,
                'source_type' => trim((string) $row['Internal/Eksternal']) ?: null,
                'level' => Clean::level($row['Level']),
                'period' => trim((string) $row['Periode']) ?: null,
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ];

            if (count($insertBatch) >= 500) {
                DB::table('training_records')->insert($insertBatch);
                $insertBatch = [];
            }
            $report->importedRows++;
        }

        if ($insertBatch) {
            DB::table('training_records')->insert($insertBatch);
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

class InsightBuilder
{
    /**
     * Menghasilkan teks ringkasan (PRD 4.7)
     * "Mayoritas karyawan adalah generasi {gen_terbanyak} ({gen_pct}%) dan berada di usia produktif (rata-rata {avg_age} tahun). Risiko kehilangan pengetahuan cukup {tingkat_risiko} dengan {pensiun_count} karyawan ({pensiun_pct}%) yang akan pensiun dalam 5 tahun ke depan."
     */
    public static function build(array $rawTotals, float $avgAge, int $totalHc): ?string
    {
        if ($totalHc === 0 || empty($rawTotals['generations'])) {
            return null;
        }

        $generations = $rawTotals['generations'];
        arsort($generations);
        $topGen = array_key_first($generations);
        $topGenCount = $generations[$topGen];
        $genPct = round(($topGenCount / $totalHc) * 100, 1);

        $pensiunCount = $rawTotals['pensiun'];
        $pensiunPct = round(($pensiunCount / $totalHc) * 100, 1);
        
        $tingkatRisiko = $pensiunPct > 10 ? 'tinggi' : ($pensiunPct > 5 ? 'sedang' : 'rendah');

        return "Mayoritas karyawan adalah generasi {$topGen} ({$genPct}%) dan berada di usia produktif (rata-rata {$avgAge} tahun). Risiko kehilangan pengetahuan cukup {$tingkatRisiko} dengan {$pensiunCount} karyawan ({$pensiunPct}%) yang akan segera memasuki batas usia pensiun (55).";
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class RetirementMetrics
{
    public function getMetrics(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = \App\Models\Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $employees = $query->get([
            'birth_date', 'region', 'job_level_code', 'organization_name', 'company_id', 'job_title_name'
        ]);

        if ($employees->isEmpty()) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }

        $asOf = $request->input('as_of') ? Carbon::parse($request->input('as_of')) : Carbon::today();
        $retireAge = config('sdm.retirement_age', 55);

        $kpi = [
            'now' => 0,
            '1_year' => 0,
            '3_years' => 0,
            '5_years' => 0,
        ];

        $projection = [];
        $currentYear = $asOf->year;
        for ($i = 0; $i <= 5; $i++) {
            $projection[$currentYear + $i] = 0;
        }

        $byLevel = [];
        $byDept = [];
        $byRegion = [];
        $byCompanyId = [];
        
        $concentratedPositions = [];

        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            if (!$e->birth_date) continue;

            $birth = Carbon::parse($e->birth_date);
            $ageFloat = $birth->diffInMonths($asOf) / 12;

            $retireDate = $birth->copy()->addYears($retireAge);
            $yearsToRetireFloat = $asOf->diffInMonths($retireDate, false) / 12; 
            
            $isRetireNow = $ageFloat >= $retireAge;
            $in1Year = $yearsToRetireFloat <= 1; 
            $in3Years = $yearsToRetireFloat <= 3;
            $in5Years = $yearsToRetireFloat <= 5;

            if ($isRetireNow) $kpi['now']++;
            if ($in1Year) $kpi['1_year']++;
            if ($in3Years) $kpi['3_years']++;
            if ($in5Years) $kpi['5_years']++;

            $rYear = $retireDate->year;
            if ($isRetireNow || $rYear <= $currentYear) {
                $projection[$currentYear]++; 
            } elseif ($rYear <= $currentYear + 5) {
                $projection[$rYear]++;
            }

            $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
            $dept = $e->organization_name ?? 'Unknown';
            $reg = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
            $cid = $e->company_id ?? 0;
            $title = $e->job_title_name ?? 'Unknown';

            if (!isset($byLevel[$lvl])) $byLevel[$lvl] = ['total' => 0, 'risk' => 0];
            if (!isset($byDept[$dept])) $byDept[$dept] = ['total' => 0, 'risk' => 0];
            if (!isset($byRegion[$reg])) $byRegion[$reg] = ['total' => 0, 'risk' => 0];
            if (!isset($byCompanyId[$cid])) $byCompanyId[$cid] = ['total' => 0, 'risk' => 0];
            
            if (!isset($concentratedPositions[$title])) {
                $concentratedPositions[$title] = ['total' => 0, 'risk_3y' => 0];
            }

            $byLevel[$lvl]['total']++;
            $byDept[$dept]['total']++;
            $byRegion[$reg]['total']++;
            $byCompanyId[$cid]['total']++;
            $concentratedPositions[$title]['total']++;

            if ($isRetireNow) {
                $byLevel[$lvl]['risk']++;
                $byDept[$dept]['risk']++;
                $byRegion[$reg]['risk']++;
                $byCompanyId[$cid]['risk']++;
            }
            
            if ($ageFloat >= ($retireAge - 3)) {
                $concentratedPositions[$title]['risk_3y']++;
            }
        }

        $companyIds = array_keys($byCompanyId);
        $companyNames = DB::table('companies')->whereIn('id', $companyIds)->pluck('name', 'id');
        
        $byCompany = [];
        foreach ($byCompanyId as $cid => $data) {
            $name = $companyNames[$cid] ?? 'Unknown';
            $byCompany[$name] = ($byCompany[$name] ?? 0) + $data['risk']; 
        }
        
        $regionRisk = [];
        foreach ($byRegion as $reg => $data) {
            $regionRisk[$reg] = $data['risk'];
        }

        $levelTable = [];
        foreach ($byLevel as $lvl => $data) {
            $pct = $data['total'] > 0 ? ($data['risk'] / $data['total']) * 100 : 0;
            $levelTable[] = [
                'name' => $lvl,
                'total' => $data['total'],
                'value' => $data['risk'],
                'pct' => round($pct, 1)
            ];
        }
        usort($levelTable, fn($a, $b) => $b['value'] <=> $a['value']); 

        $deptTable = [];
        foreach ($byDept as $dept => $data) {
            $pct = $data['total'] > 0 ? ($data['risk'] / $data['total']) * 100 : 0;
            $deptTable[] = [
                'name' => $dept,
                'total' => $data['total'],
                'value' => $data['risk'],
                'pct' => round($pct, 1)
            ];
        }
        usort($deptTable, fn($a, $b) => $b['value'] <=> $a['value']);

        $concentratedTable = [];
        foreach ($concentratedPositions as $title => $data) {
            if ($data['risk_3y'] >= 1) {
                $pct = $data['total'] > 0 ? ($data['risk_3y'] / $data['total']) * 100 : 0;
                $concentratedTable[] = [
                    'title' => $title,
                    'total' => $data['total'],
                    'risk' => $data['risk_3y'],
                    'pct' => round($pct, 1)
                ];
            }
        }
        usort($concentratedTable, fn($a, $b) => $b['risk'] <=> $a['risk']);

        return [
            'kpi' => $kpi,
            'projection' => $projection,
            'tables' => [
                'level' => $levelTable,
                'dept' => $deptTable,
                'concentrated' => $concentratedTable,
            ],
            'bars' => [
                'region' => $regionRisk,
                'company' => $byCompany,
            ]
        ];
    }
    
    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [
            'kpi' => ['now' => 0, '1_year' => 0, '3_years' => 0, '5_years' => 0],
            'projection' => [],
            'tables' => ['level' => [], 'dept' => [], 'concentrated' => []],
            'bars' => ['region' => [], 'company' => []],
        ];
    }
}
