<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class TenureMetrics
{
    public function getMetrics(Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = \App\Models\Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $employees = $query->get([
            'birth_date', 'join_date', 'region', 'job_level_code', 'employment_type'
        ]);

        if ($employees->isEmpty()) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }

        $asOf = $request->input('as_of') ? Carbon::parse($request->input('as_of')) : Carbon::today();

        $histogram = [
            '<1 tahun' => 0,
            '1-<3 tahun' => 0,
            '3-<5 tahun' => 0,
            '5-<10 tahun' => 0,
            '10+ tahun' => 0,
        ];

        $joinYearly = [];
        $joinMonthly = []; // Only for last 3 years
        $yearLimit = $asOf->year - 3;

        $tenureByLevelSum = [];
        $tenureByRegionSum = [];
        
        $scatter = [];
        $heatmap = [];
        
        $waves = [];

        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            if (!$e->join_date || !$e->birth_date) continue;

            $join = Carbon::parse($e->join_date);
            $birth = Carbon::parse($e->birth_date);
            
            $ageFloat = $birth->diffInMonths($asOf) / 12;
            $tenureFloat = $join->diffInMonths($asOf) / 12;

            if ($tenureFloat < 1) $histogram['<1 tahun']++;
            elseif ($tenureFloat < 3) $histogram['1-<3 tahun']++;
            elseif ($tenureFloat < 5) $histogram['3-<5 tahun']++;
            elseif ($tenureFloat < 10) $histogram['5-<10 tahun']++;
            else $histogram['10+ tahun']++;

            $jYear = $join->year;
            $joinYearly[$jYear] = ($joinYearly[$jYear] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            if ($jYear >= $yearLimit && $jYear <= $asOf->year) {
                $my = $join->format('Y-m');
                $joinMonthly[$my] = ($joinMonthly[$my] ?? 0) + 1;
            }

            $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
            if (!isset($tenureByLevelSum[$lvl])) {
                $tenureByLevelSum[$lvl] = ['sum' => 0, 'count' => 0];
            }
            $tenureByLevelSum[$lvl]['sum'] += $tenureFloat;
            $tenureByLevelSum[$lvl]['count']++;

            $reg = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
            if (!isset($tenureByRegionSum[$reg])) {
                $tenureByRegionSum[$reg] = ['sum' => 0, 'count' => 0];
            }
            $tenureByRegionSum[$reg]['sum'] += $tenureFloat;
            $tenureByRegionSum[$reg]['count']++;

            $joinAge = $birth->diffInMonths($join) / 12;
            $isAnomaly = ($joinAge < 18 || $joinAge > 55) ? 'yes' : 'no';
            
            $scatter[] = [
                'umur' => round($ageFloat, 1),
                'masa_kerja' => round($tenureFloat, 1),
                'anomali' => $isAnomaly,
                'join_age' => round($joinAge, 1)
            ];

            if (!isset($heatmap[$jYear])) {
                $heatmap[$jYear] = [];
            }
            $heatmap[$jYear][$reg] = ($heatmap[$jYear][$reg] ?? 0) + 1;

            if (!isset($waves[$jYear])) {
                $waves[$jYear] = ['total' => 0, 'types' => []];
            }
            $waves[$jYear]['total']++;
            $etype = $e->employment_type ?? 'Unknown';
            $waves[$jYear]['types'][$etype] = ($waves[$jYear]['types'][$etype] ?? 0) + 1;
        }

        ksort($joinYearly);
        ksort($joinMonthly);

        $levelOrder = ['A','B','C','D','E','F','1','2','3','4','5'];
        $avgByLevel = [];
        foreach ($levelOrder as $lvl) {
            if (isset($tenureByLevelSum[$lvl])) {
                $avgByLevel[$lvl] = round($tenureByLevelSum[$lvl]['sum'] / $tenureByLevelSum[$lvl]['count'], 1);
            }
        }
        foreach ($tenureByLevelSum as $lvl => $data) {
            if (!in_array($lvl, $levelOrder)) {
                $avgByLevel[$lvl] = round($data['sum'] / $data['count'], 1);
            }
        }

        $avgByRegion = [];
        foreach ($tenureByRegionSum as $reg => $data) {
            $avgByRegion[$reg] = round($data['sum'] / $data['count'], 1);
        }
        arsort($avgByRegion);

        krsort($waves);
        $recruitmentWaves = [];
        foreach ($waves as $year => $data) {
            arsort($data['types']);
            $dominant = array_key_first($data['types']);
            $recruitmentWaves[] = [
                'year' => (string) $year,
                'total' => $data['total'],
                'dominant_type' => $dominant
            ];
        }

        ksort($heatmap);
        
        return [
            'histogram' => $histogram,
            'trend' => [
                'yearly' => $joinYearly,
                'monthly' => $joinMonthly
            ],
            'average' => [
                'level' => $avgByLevel,
                'region' => $avgByRegion
            ],
            'scatter' => $scatter,
            'heatmap' => $heatmap,
            'waves' => array_slice($recruitmentWaves, 0, 15)
        ];
    }
    
    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [
            'histogram' => [],
            'trend' => ['yearly' => [], 'monthly' => []],
            'average' => ['level' => [], 'region' => []],
            'scatter' => [],
            'heatmap' => [],
            'waves' => []
        ];
    }
}

File: app/Services/TrainingMetrics.php

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Support\TrainingFilter;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class TrainingMetrics
{
    public function getMetrics(\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, TrainingFilter $filter, \App\Models\User $user)
    {
        $latestBatch = ImportBatch::latest('id')->first();
        $batchId = $latestBatch ? $latestBatch->id : 0;
        
        $filterHash = md5(json_encode($request->all()) . '_' . $user->id);
        $cacheKey = "training_metrics_{$batchId}_{$filterHash}";

        return Cache::remember($cacheKey, 3600, function () use ($request, $filter) {
            return $this->calculate($request, $filter);
        });
    }

    protected function calculate(\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, TrainingFilter $filter)
    {
        $query = DB::table('training_records');
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);

        $trainings = $query->get();

        $totalRows = $trainings->count();
        if ($totalRows === 0) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }

        $uniqueParticipants = [];
        $totalHours = 0;
        $totalDays = 0;
        $uniqueTrainings = [];
        
        $trend = [];
        $participantsTrend = [];
        
        $regularity = ['Reguler' => 0, 'Non Reguler' => 0];
        $sourceType = ['Internal' => 0, 'Eksternal' => 0];
        
        $trainingNames = [];
        $instructors = [];
        $locations = [];
        
        $hoursByRegion = [];
        $hoursByGroup = [];
        $hoursByDept = [];
        $hoursByGol = []; // Staf / Non Staf
        $hoursByLevel = []; // Workers, Middle, Senior
        
        $genderByLevel = []; // Stacked bar gender x Level

        $unlinkedRows = 0;

        foreach ($trainings as $t) {
            $totalHours += $t->hours;
            $totalDays += $t->days;
            $uniqueTrainings[$t->training_name] = true;
            
            if ($t->employee_id) {
                $uniqueParticipants[$t->employee_id] = true;
            } else {
                $unlinkedRows++;
            }
            
            // Trend
            if ($t->year && $t->month) {
                $my = $t->year . '-' . str_pad($t->month, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                $trend[$my] = ($trend[$my] ?? 0) + $t->hours;
                
                if (!isset($participantsTrend[$my])) $participantsTrend[$my] = [];
                if ($t->employee_id) {
                    $participantsTrend[$my][$t->employee_id] = true;
                }
            }
            
            // Donut
            $reg = $t->regularity ?: 'Unknown';
            $regularity[$reg] = ($regularity[$reg] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            $src = $t->source_type ?: 'Unknown';
            $sourceType[$src] = ($sourceType[$src] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            // Top 10
            $tn = $t->training_name ?: 'Unknown';
            $trainingNames[$tn] = ($trainingNames[$tn] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            if ($t->instructor) {
                $instructors[$t->instructor] = ($instructors[$t->instructor] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
            if ($t->venue) {
                $locations[$t->venue] = ($locations[$t->venue] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }

        $participantsCountTrend = [];
        foreach ($participantsTrend as $my => $pArr) {
            $participantsCountTrend[$my] = count($pArr);
        }
        ksort($trend);
        ksort($participantsCountTrend);

        $participantDemographics = [];
        
        foreach ($trainings as $t) {
            $reg = $t->region ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByRegion[$reg] = ($hoursByRegion[$reg] ?? 0) + $t->hours;
            
            $grp = $t->group ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByGroup[$grp] = ($hoursByGroup[$grp] ?? 0) + $t->hours;
            
            $dept = $t->department ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByDept[$dept] = ($hoursByDept[$dept] ?? 0) + $t->hours;
            
            $gol = $t->grade ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByGol[$gol] = ($hoursByGol[$gol] ?? 0) + $t->hours;
            
            $lvlCategory = $t->level ?? 'Unknown';
            $hoursByLevel[$lvlCategory] = ($hoursByLevel[$lvlCategory] ?? 0) + $t->hours;
            
            $uniqueKey = $t->employee_id ?: ($t->nik_raw ?: $t->participant_name);
            if ($uniqueKey && !isset($participantDemographics[$uniqueKey])) {
                $participantDemographics[$uniqueKey] = [
                    'gender' => $t->gender ?? 'Male',
                    'level' => $lvlCategory
                ];
            }
        }
        
        $genderByLevel = [];
        foreach ($participantDemographics as $demo) {
            $lvl = $demo['level'];
            if (!isset($genderByLevel[$lvl])) {
                $genderByLevel[$lvl] = ['Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0];
            }
            $g = $demo['gender'] === 'Female' ? 'Female' : 'Male';
            $genderByLevel[$lvl][$g] += 1;
        }

        return [
            'kpi' => [
                'total_rows' => $totalRows,
                'unique_participants' => count($uniqueParticipants),
                'total_hours' => round($totalHours, 1),
                'avg_hours_per_participant' => count($uniqueParticipants) > 0 ? round($totalHours / count($uniqueParticipants), 1) : 0,
                'total_days' => round($totalDays, 1),
                'unique_trainings' => count($uniqueTrainings),
                'unlinked_rows' => $unlinkedRows
            ],
            'trend' => [
                'hours' => $trend,
                'participants' => $participantsCountTrend
            ],
            'donuts' => [
                'regularity' => $regularity,
                'source_type' => $sourceType
            ],
            'top' => [
                'training_names' => $trainingNames,
                'instructors' => $instructors,
                'locations' => $locations
            ],
            'hours_by' => [
                'region' => $hoursByRegion,
                'group' => $hoursByGroup,
                'dept' => $hoursByDept,
                'gol' => $hoursByGol,
                'level' => $hoursByLevel
            ],
            'gender_by_level' => $genderByLevel
        ];
    }

    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [
            'kpi' => [
                'total_rows' => 0, 'unique_participants' => 0, 'total_hours' => 0,
                'avg_hours_per_participant' => 0, 'total_days' => 0, 'unique_trainings' => 0, 'unlinked_rows' => 0
            ],
            'trend' => ['hours' => [], 'participants' => []],
            'donuts' => ['regularity' => [], 'source_type' => []],
            'top' => ['training_names' => [], 'instructors' => [], 'locations' => []],
            'hours_by' => ['region' => [], 'group' => [], 'dept' => [], 'gol' => [], 'level' => []],
            'gender_by_level' => []
        ];
    }
}

File: app/Services/WorkforceMetrics.php

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Support\Demographics;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class WorkforceMetrics
{
    protected ?Carbon $asOf;

    public function __construct(?Carbon $asOf = null)
    {
        $this->asOf = $asOf ?? Carbon::now();
    }

    public function getMetrics(\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter, \App\Models\User $user)
    {
        // Cache key based on filter hash and latest import batch
        $latestBatch = ImportBatch::latest('id')->first();
        $batchId = $latestBatch ? $latestBatch->id : 0;
        
        $asOfStr = $this->asOf->format('Y-m-d');
        $filterHash = md5(json_encode($request->all()) . '_' . $user->id . '_' . $asOfStr);
        $cacheKey = "metrics_{$batchId}_{$filterHash}";

        return Cache::remember($cacheKey, 3600, function () use ($request, $filter, $user) {
            return $this->calculate($request, $filter, $user);
        });
    }

    protected function calculate(\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, EmployeeFilter $filter, \App\Models\User $user)
    {
        $query = Employee::query();
        $query = $filter->apply($query, $request);
        
        // Single narrow query
        $employees = $query->get([
            'id', 'employee_id', 'company_id', 'location_id', 'region', 'gender', 
            'birth_date', 'join_date', 'employment_type', 'job_level_code',
            'group', 'organization_name', 'marital_status', 'ptkp_code', 'job_title_name', 'birth_place'
        ]);

        $totalHc = $employees->count();
        if ($totalHc === 0) {
            return $this->emptyMetrics();
        }

        $females = 0;
        $perm = 0;
        $pensiun = 0;
        $ages = [];
        $loses = [];
        
        $generations = [];
        $generationsByLevel = [];
        $hcByRegion = [];
        $hcByCompany = [];
        $hcByRegionFacility = [];
        $retireRiskByLevel = [];
        
        $hcByGroup = [];
        $hcByDept = [];
        $agesByDept = [];
        $ageDistribution = ['<25' => 0, '25-29' => 0, '30-34' => 0, '35-39' => 0, '40-44' => 0, '45-49' => 0, '50-54' => 0, '55+' => 0];
        $populationPyramid = [];
        $genByRegion = [];
        $genderByLevel = [];
        $maritalStatus = [];
        $ptkp = [];
        $jobTitles = [];
        $employmentByRegion = [];
        $birthPlaces = [];
        
        $hcByLevel = [];
        
        $locations = \App\Models\Location::pluck('name', 'id');
        
        $employeeIds = [];
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $employeeIds[] = $e->id;
            if ($e->gender === 'Female') $females++;
            if ($e->employment_type === 'PERM') $perm++;
            
            $birthDate = $e->birth_date ? Carbon::parse($e->birth_date) : null;
            $joinDate = $e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null;
            
            if ($birthDate) {
                $ageDec = Demographics::age($birthDate, $this->asOf);
                $ages[] = $ageDec;
                
                $ageFull = Demographics::ageFullYears($birthDate, $this->asOf);
                if ($ageFull >= config('sdm.retirement_age', 55)) {
                    $pensiun++;
                    $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
                    $retireRiskByLevel[$lvl] = ($retireRiskByLevel[$lvl] ?? 0) + 1;
                }
                
                $gen = Demographics::generation($birthDate->year);
                $generations[$gen] = ($generations[$gen] ?? 0) + 1;
                
                $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
                if (!isset($generationsByLevel[$lvl])) $generationsByLevel[$lvl] = [];
                $generationsByLevel[$lvl][$gen] = ($generationsByLevel[$lvl][$gen] ?? 0) + 1;

                // Demographics additions
                $ageBin = match(true) {
                    $ageFull < 25 => '<25',
                    $ageFull < 30 => '25-29',
                    $ageFull < 35 => '30-34',
                    $ageFull < 40 => '35-39',
                    $ageFull < 45 => '40-44',
                    $ageFull < 50 => '45-49',
                    $ageFull < 55 => '50-54',
                    default => '55+'
                };
                $ageDistribution[$ageBin]++;
                
                if (!isset($populationPyramid[$ageBin])) $populationPyramid[$ageBin] = ['Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0];
                $populationPyramid[$ageBin][$e->gender ?? 'Male']++;
                
                $region = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
                if (!isset($genByRegion[$region])) $genByRegion[$region] = [];
                $genByRegion[$region][$gen] = ($genByRegion[$region][$gen] ?? 0) + 1;
                
                $dept = $e->organization_name ?? 'Unknown';
                if (!isset($agesByDept[$dept])) $agesByDept[$dept] = [];
                $agesByDept[$dept][] = $ageDec;
            }
            
            $lvl = $e->job_level_code ?? 'Unknown';
            $hcByLevel[$lvl] = ($hcByLevel[$lvl] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            if ($joinDate) {
                $loses[] = Demographics::los($joinDate, $this->asOf);
            }
            
            $region = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
            $hcByRegion[$region] = ($hcByRegion[$region] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            $locName = $locations[$e->location_id] ?? '';
            // KLASIFIKASI FACILITY (TURUNAN)
            // Karena DB tidak memiliki kolom facility_type, kita menderivasikannya dari Location Name:
            // - HO (Head Office): Jika lokasi mengandung 'office' atau 'jakarta'
            // - Mill: Jika lokasi mengandung 'pabrik', 'mill', 'kcp', 'biodiesel', atau 'bulking'
            // - Estate: Default fallback untuk semua lokasi lainnya (kebun, dsb)
            $facilityType = match(true) {
                stripos($locName, 'office') !== false || stripos($locName, 'jakarta') !== false => 'HO',
                stripos($locName, 'pabrik') !== false || stripos($locName, 'mill') !== false || stripos($locName, 'kcp') !== false || stripos($locName, 'biodiesel') !== false || stripos($locName, 'bulking') !== false => 'Mill',
                default => 'Estate'
            };
            if (!isset($hcByRegionFacility[$region])) {
                $hcByRegionFacility[$region] = ['Estate' => 0, 'Mill' => 0, 'HO' => 0];
            }
            $hcByRegionFacility[$region][$facilityType]++;
            
            $hcByCompany[$e->company_id] = ($hcByCompany[$e->company_id] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            // Demographics additions
            $group = $e->group ?? 'Unknown';
            $hcByGroup[$group] = ($hcByGroup[$group] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            $dept = $e->organization_name ?? 'Unknown';
            $hcByDept[$dept] = ($hcByDept[$dept] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            if (!isset($genderByLevel[$lvl])) $genderByLevel[$lvl] = ['Male' => 0, 'Female' => 0];
            $genderByLevel[$lvl][$e->gender ?? 'Male']++;
            
            $ms = $e->marital_status ?? 'Unknown';
            $maritalStatus[$ms] = ($maritalStatus[$ms] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            $pt = $e->ptkp_code ?? 'Unknown';
            $ptkp[$pt] = ($ptkp[$pt] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            $jt = $e->job_title_name ?? 'Unknown';
            $jobTitles[$jt] = ($jobTitles[$jt] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            if (!isset($employmentByRegion[$region])) $employmentByRegion[$region] = [];
            $employmentByRegion[$region][$e->employment_type ?? 'Unknown'] = ($employmentByRegion[$region][$e->employment_type ?? 'Unknown'] ?? 0) + 1;
            
            if ($e->birth_place) {
                $bp = strtoupper(trim($e->birth_place));
                if ($bp === '(NONE)' || $bp === 'NONE' || $bp === '') {
                    $bp = 'TIDAK DIKETAHUI';
                }
                $birthPlaces[$bp] = ($birthPlaces[$bp] ?? 0) + 1;
            }
        }

        $avgAge = count($ages) > 0 ? array_sum($ages) / count($ages) : 0;
        $avgLos = count($loses) > 0 ? array_sum($loses) / count($loses) : 0;
        
        // --- Training Metrics ---
        // Get training records for the filtered employees ONLY for coverage
        // Coverage uses employees in the current filter who have at least 1 training
        $employeesWithTraining = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('training_records')
            ->whereIn('employee_id', $employeeIds)
            ->distinct('employee_id')
            ->count('employee_id');
            
        $trainingCoverage = $totalHc > 0 ? round(($employeesWithTraining / $totalHc) * 100, 1) : 0;

        // For total hours and trend, PRD 4.5 says use ALL training records (not filtered by employees)
        $allTrainings = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('training_records')
            ->get(['hours', 'month', 'year']);
            
        $totalTrainingHours = $allTrainings->sum('hours');
        
        // Tren jam pelatihan per bulan (year-month) using all trainings
        $trainingTrend = [];
        foreach ($allTrainings as $t) {
            if ($t->year && $t->month) {
                $my = $t->year . '-' . str_pad($t->month, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                $trainingTrend[$my] = ($trainingTrend[$my] ?? 0) + $t->hours;
            }
        }
        ksort($trainingTrend);
        
        // Unlinked training records (nik status tracking for coverage quality)
        // Since we are filtering by employees, unlinked ones won't be here. 
        // We need all training records to report unlinked ones for the whole system, but maybe dashboard just shows total?
        // PRD 4.6 says: Selalu tampilkan dua angka berdampingan: coverage dan "Baris training yang tidak dapat dihubungkan ke karyawan"
        $unlinkedTrainingRows = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('training_records')
            ->whereNull('employee_id')
            ->count();
        $totalTrainingRows = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('training_records')->count();
        $unlinkedPct = $totalTrainingRows > 0 ? round(($unlinkedTrainingRows / $totalTrainingRows) * 100, 1) : 0;
        
        // Get company names for hcByCompany
        $companyNames = \App\Models\Company::whereIn('id', array_keys($hcByCompany))->pluck('name', 'id');
        $hcByCompanyNamed = [];
        foreach ($hcByCompany as $cid => $hc) {
            $hcByCompanyNamed[$companyNames[$cid] ?? 'Unknown'] = $hc;
        }
        
        $avgAgeByDept = [];
        foreach ($agesByDept as $dept => $agArr) {
            if (count($agArr) >= 5) {
                $avgAgeByDept[$dept] = round(array_sum($agArr) / count($agArr), 1);
            }
        }
        arsort($avgAgeByDept);

        return [
            'total_hc' => $totalHc,
            'avg_age' => round($avgAge, 1),
            'avg_los' => round($avgLos, 1),
            'female_pct' => round(($females / $totalHc) * 100, 1),
            'perm_pct' => round(($perm / $totalHc) * 100, 1),
            'pensiun' => $pensiun,
            'generations' => $generations,
            'generations_by_level' => $generationsByLevel,
            'hc_by_region' => $hcByRegion,
            'hc_by_region_facility' => $hcByRegionFacility,
            'hc_by_company' => $hcByCompanyNamed,
            'hc_by_level' => $hcByLevel,
            'retire_risk_by_level' => $retireRiskByLevel,
            'hc_by_group' => $hcByGroup,
            'hc_by_dept' => $hcByDept,
            'age_distribution' => $ageDistribution,
            'population_pyramid' => $populationPyramid,
            'gen_by_region' => $genByRegion,
            'avg_age_by_dept' => $avgAgeByDept,
            'gender_by_level' => $genderByLevel,
            'marital_status' => $maritalStatus,
            'ptkp' => $ptkp,
            'job_titles' => $jobTitles,
            'employment_by_region' => $employmentByRegion,
            'birth_places' => $birthPlaces,
            'level_order' => config('sdm.level_order', []),
            'training' => [
                'total_hours' => $totalTrainingHours,
                'coverage_pct' => $trainingCoverage,
                'unlinked_rows' => $unlinkedTrainingRows,
                'unlinked_pct' => $unlinkedPct,
                'trend' => $trainingTrend
            ],
            'new_hire_no_training' => \App\Support\MetricsHelper::countNewHireNoTraining($employees, $this->asOf),
            'new_hire_this_year' => \App\Support\MetricsHelper::countNewHireThisYear($employees, $this->asOf),
            'raw_totals' => [
                'total_hc' => $totalHc,
                'generations' => $generations,
                'pensiun' => $pensiun,
            ]
        ];
    }

    private function emptyMetrics()
    {
        return [
            'total_hc' => 0, 'avg_age' => 0, 'avg_los' => 0, 'female_pct' => 0, 'perm_pct' => 0, 'pensiun' => 0,
            'generations' => [], 'generations_by_level' => [], 'hc_by_region' => [], 'hc_by_region_facility' => [], 'hc_by_company' => [], 'hc_by_level' => [], 'retire_risk_by_level' => [],
            'hc_by_group' => [], 'hc_by_dept' => [], 'age_distribution' => [], 'population_pyramid' => [], 'gen_by_region' => [],
            'avg_age_by_dept' => [], 'gender_by_level' => [], 'marital_status' => [], 'ptkp' => [], 'job_titles' => [],
            'employment_by_region' => [], 'birth_places' => [],
            'level_order' => config('sdm.level_order', []),
            'training' => ['total_hours' => 0, 'coverage_pct' => 0, 'unlinked_rows' => 0, 'unlinked_pct' => 0, 'trend' => []],
            'new_hire_no_training' => 0,
            'new_hire_this_year' => 0,
            'raw_totals' => ['total_hc' => 0, 'generations' => [], 'pensiun' => 0]
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Carbon\Carbon;

/**
 * Aturan pembersihan data berdasarkan hasil profiling CSV asli.
 */
class Clean
{
    /** "04-Dec-06" -> Carbon. Tahun 2 digit: yy <= $pivot => 20yy, selain itu 19yy. */
    public static function date2(?string $value, int $pivot): ?Carbon
    {
        $value = trim((string) $value);
        if ($value === '') {
            return null;
        }

        if (is_numeric($value)) {
            try {
                return Carbon::instance(\PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Date::excelToDateTimeObject($value))->startOfDay();
            } catch (\Throwable) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        if (! preg_match('/^(\d{1,2})-([A-Za-z]{3})-(\d{2}|\d{4})$/', $value, $m)) {
            return null;
        }

        $year = (int) $m[3];
        if (strlen($m[3]) === 2) {
            $year += $year <= $pivot ? 2000 : 1900;
        }

        try {
            return Carbon::createFromFormat('d-M-Y', "{$m[1]}-{$m[2]}-{$year}")->startOfDay();
        } catch (\Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Karyawan termuda di data lahir 2006, jadi pivot 15 aman untuk tanggal lahir. */
    public static function birth(?string $v): ?Carbon
    {
        return self::date2($v, 15);
    }

    /** Join date: pivot = tahun berjalan (2 digit) supaya tidak jatuh ke masa depan. */
    public static function join(?string $v): ?Carbon
    {
        return self::date2($v, (int) now()->format('y'));
    }

    public static function month(?string $v): ?int
    {
        static $map = [
            'JAN' => 1, 'FEB' => 2, 'MAR' => 3, 'APR' => 4, 'MAY' => 5, 'MEI' => 5,
            'JUN' => 6, 'JUL' => 7, 'AUG' => 8, 'AGT' => 8, 'AGU' => 8, 'AGS' => 8, 'SEP' => 9,
            'OCT' => 10, 'OKT' => 10, 'NOV' => 11, 'DEC' => 12, 'DES' => 12,
        ];

        return $map[strtoupper(substr(trim((string) $v), 0, 3))] ?? null;
    }

    public static function region(?string $v): ?string
    {
        $k = strtolower(trim((string) $v));
        if ($k === '') return null;
        if ($k === 'kaltim') return 'Kaltim';
        return ucfirst($k);
    }

    public static function regularity(?string $v): ?string
    {
        $k = strtolower(trim((string) $v));
        if ($k === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return str_contains($k, 'non') ? 'Non Reguler' : 'Reguler';
    }

    public static function level(?string $v): ?string
    {
        $k = strtolower(trim((string) $v));

        return $k === '' ? null : ucfirst($k);
    }

    /**
     * Status NIK dari sumber training:
     *  - empty   : kosong atau "-"
     *  - corrupt : rusak notasi ilmiah Excel, mis. "2,01407E+13"
     *  - invalid : bukan angka murni, mis. "Promosi"
     *  - ok      : angka murni
     */
    public static function nikStatus(?string $v): string
    {
        $v = trim((string) $v);

        return match (true) {
            $v === '' || $v === '-' => 'empty',
            (bool) preg_match('/^\d+[,.]?\d*E\+\d+$/i', $v) => 'corrupt',
            ! ctype_digit($v) => 'invalid',
            default => 'ok',
        };
    }

    /** NIK yang bisa dipakai (status ok), selain itu null. */
    public static function nik(?string $v): ?string
    {
        return self::nikStatus($v) === 'ok' ? trim((string) $v) : null;
    }

    /** "PT. Panca Surya Garden" dan "PANCA SURYA GARDEN" => "PANCA SURYA GARDEN" */
    public static function companyKey(?string $v): string
    {
        $v = strtoupper(trim((string) $v));
        $v = preg_replace('/^(PT\.?|CV\.?)\s+/', '', $v);
        $v = preg_replace('/[^A-Z0-9 ]/', ' ', $v);

        return trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $v));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Carbon\Carbon;

class Demographics
{
    public static function age(?Carbon $birthDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): ?float
    {
        if (!$birthDate) return null;
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();
        return $birthDate->diffInDays($asOf) / 365.25;
    }

    public static function los(?Carbon $joinDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): ?float
    {
        if (!$joinDate) return null;
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();
        return $joinDate->diffInDays($asOf) / 365.25;
    }

    public static function ageFullYears(?Carbon $birthDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): ?int
    {
        if (!$birthDate) return null;
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();
        return (int) $birthDate->diffInYears($asOf);
    }

    public static function losFullYears(?Carbon $joinDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): ?int
    {
        if (!$joinDate) return null;
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();
        return (int) $joinDate->diffInYears($asOf);
    }

    public static function ageGroup(?int $age): string
    {
        if ($age === null) return 'Unknown';
        if ($age < 25) return '<25';
        if ($age < 35) return '25-34';
        if ($age < 45) return '35-44';
        if ($age < 55) return '45-54';
        return '55+';
    }

    public static function losGroup(?int $los): string
    {
        if ($los === null) return 'Unknown';
        if ($los < 1) return '<1';
        if ($los < 3) return '1-<3';
        if ($los < 5) return '3-<5';
        if ($los < 10) return '5-<10';
        return '10+';
    }

    public static function generation(?int $birthYear): string
    {
        if ($birthYear === null) return 'Unknown';
        $config = config('sdm.generations', [
            'Boomers' => 1964,
            'Gen X' => 1980,
            'Gen Y' => 1996,
        ]);
        if ($birthYear <= $config['Boomers']) return 'Boomers';
        if ($birthYear <= $config['Gen X']) return 'Gen X';
        if ($birthYear <= $config['Gen Y']) return 'Gen Y';
        return 'Gen Z';
    }

    public static function isRetirementRisk(?Carbon $birthDate, ?Carbon $asOf = null): bool
    {
        if (!$birthDate) return false;
        $age = self::ageFullYears($birthDate, $asOf);
        return $age >= config('sdm.retirement_age', 55);
    }

    public static function retiresInYears(?Carbon $birthDate, int $years, ?Carbon $asOf = null): bool
    {
        if (!$birthDate) return false;
        $asOf = $asOf ?? now();
        $targetDate = $asOf->copy()->addYears($years);
        
        $currentAge = self::ageFullYears($birthDate, $asOf);
        $futureAge = self::ageFullYears($birthDate, $targetDate);
        $retirementAge = config('sdm.retirement_age', 55);
        
        return $currentAge < $retirementAge && $futureAge >= $retirementAge;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class EmployeeFilter
{
    public static function apply(Builder $query, Request $request): Builder
    {

        if ($request->filled('region')) {
            $query->whereIn('region', (array) $request->input('region'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('group')) {
            $query->whereIn('group', (array) $request->input('group'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('company_id')) {
            $query->whereIn('company_id', (array) $request->input('company_id'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('location_id')) {
            $query->whereIn('location_id', (array) $request->input('location_id'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('organization_name')) {
            $query->whereIn('organization_name', (array) $request->input('organization_name'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('job_level_code')) {
            $query->whereIn('job_level_code', (array) $request->input('job_level_code'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('employment_type')) {
            $query->whereIn('employment_type', (array) $request->input('employment_type'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('gender')) {
            $query->whereIn('gender', (array) $request->input('gender'));
        }
        // Generation filter requires filtering by birth_date logic, which might be tricky in pure SQL.
        // It's usually better handled locally, or we compute the min/max birth dates for generations.
        if ($request->filled('generation')) {
            $generations = (array) $request->input('generation');
            $config = config('sdm.generations', [
                'Boomers' => 1964,
                'Gen X' => 1980,
                'Gen Y' => 1996,
            ]);
            
            $query->where(function($q) use ($generations, $config) {
                foreach ($generations as $gen) {
                    if ($gen === 'Boomers') {
                        $q->orWhereYear('birth_date', '<=', $config['Boomers']);
                    } elseif ($gen === 'Gen X') {
                        $q->orWhereBetween(DB::raw('YEAR(birth_date)'), [$config['Boomers'] + 1, $config['Gen X']]);
                    } elseif ($gen === 'Gen Y') {
                        $q->orWhereBetween(DB::raw('YEAR(birth_date)'), [$config['Gen X'] + 1, $config['Gen Y']]);
                    } elseif ($gen === 'Gen Z') {
                        $q->orWhereYear('birth_date', '>', $config['Gen Y']);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        return $query;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use App\Support\Demographics;

class MetricsHelper
{
    /**
     * Menghitung jumlah karyawan dengan masa kerja < 1 tahun yang TIDAK punya training.
     * Menggunakan logika yang persis sama dengan CombinedMetrics.
     * 
     * @param \Illuminate\Support\Collection $employees Koleksi object karyawan (minimal punya id, join_date)
     * @param \Carbon\Carbon $asOf
     * @param array|null $empHours Array assoc [employee_id => total_hours] (opsional untuk optimalisasi)
     * @return int
     */
    public static function countNewHireNoTraining(Collection $employees, Carbon $asOf, ?array $empHours = null): int
    {
        if ($empHours === null) {
            $empIds = $employees->pluck('id')->toArray();
            $trainings = DB::table('training_records')
                ->whereNotNull('employee_id')
                ->whereIn('employee_id', $empIds)
                ->get(['employee_id', 'hours']);

            $empHours = [];
            foreach ($trainings as $t) {
                if (!isset($empHours[$t->employee_id])) $empHours[$t->employee_id] = 0;
                $empHours[$t->employee_id] += $t->hours;
            }
        }

        $count = 0;
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $hasTraining = isset($empHours[$e->id]);
            $join = $e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null;
            $tenureFloat = Demographics::los($join, $asOf);
            
            if ($tenureFloat !== null && $tenureFloat < 1 && !$hasTraining) {
                $count++;
            }
        }

        return $count;
    }

    /**
     * Menghitung karyawan yang masuk di tahun yang sama dengan $asOf.
     */
    public static function countNewHireThisYear(Collection $employees, Carbon $asOf): int
    {
        $count = 0;
        $targetYear = $asOf->year;
        
        foreach ($employees as $e) {
            $join = $e->join_date ? Carbon::parse($e->join_date) : null;
            if ($join !== null && $join->year === $targetYear) {
                $count++;
            }
        }
        
        return $count;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Database\Query\Builder;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class TrainingFilter
{
    public static function apply(Builder $query, Request $request): Builder
    {

        if ($request->filled('year')) {
            $query->whereIn('year', (array) $request->input('year'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('month')) {
            $query->whereIn('month', (array) $request->input('month'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('training_name')) {
            $query->where('training_name', 'like', '%' . $request->input('training_name') . '%');
        }
        if ($request->filled('regularity')) {
            $query->whereIn('regularity', (array) $request->input('regularity'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('source_type')) {
            $query->whereIn('source_type', (array) $request->input('source_type'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('company_id')) {
            $query->whereIn('company_id', (array) $request->input('company_id'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('region')) {
            $query->whereIn('region', (array) $request->input('region'));
        }

        return $query;
    }
}

<?php

use App\Models\User;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Defaults
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option defines the default authentication "guard" and password
    | reset "broker" for your application. You may change these values
    | as required, but they're a perfect start for most applications.
    |
    */

    'defaults' => [
        'guard' => env('AUTH_GUARD', 'web'),
        'passwords' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_BROKER', 'users'),
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Guards
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Next, you may define every authentication guard for your application.
    | Of course, a great default configuration has been defined for you
    | which utilizes session storage plus the Eloquent user provider.
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | Supported: "session"
    |
    */

    'guards' => [
        'web' => [
            'driver' => 'session',
            'provider' => 'users',
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | User Providers
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | If you have multiple user tables or models you may configure multiple
    | providers to represent the model / table. These providers may then
    | be assigned to any extra authentication guards you have defined.
    |
    | Supported: "database", "eloquent"
    |
    */

    'providers' => [
        'users' => [
            'driver' => 'eloquent',
            'model' => env('AUTH_MODEL', User::class),
        ],

        // 'users' => [
        //     'driver' => 'database',
        //     'table' => 'users',
        // ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Resetting Passwords
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | These configuration options specify the behavior of Laravel's password
    | reset functionality, including the table utilized for token storage
    | and the user provider that is invoked to actually retrieve users.
    |
    | The expiry time is the number of minutes that each reset token will be
    | considered valid. This security feature keeps tokens short-lived so
    | they have less time to be guessed. You may change this as needed.
    |
    | The throttle setting is the number of seconds a user must wait before
    | generating more password reset tokens. This prevents the user from
    | quickly generating a very large amount of password reset tokens.
    |
    */

    'passwords' => [
        'users' => [
            'provider' => 'users',
            'table' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TABLE', 'password_reset_tokens'),
            'expire' => 60,
            'throttle' => 60,
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Password Confirmation Timeout
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may define the number of seconds before a password confirmation
    | window expires and users are asked to re-enter their password via the
    | confirmation screen. By default, the timeout lasts for three hours.
    |
    */

    'password_timeout' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_TIMEOUT', 10800),

];

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

    /*

            'lock_path' => storage_path('framework/cache/data'),
        ],

            'driver' => 'storage',

        ],

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    | persist session data. Database storage is a great default choice.
    |
    | Supported: "file", "cookie", "database", "memcached",
    |            "redis", "dynamodb", "array"
    |
    */

    'driver' => env('SESSION_DRIVER', 'database'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Lifetime
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may specify the number of minutes that you wish the session
    | to be allowed to remain idle before it expires. If you want them
    | to expire immediately when the browser is closed then you may
    | indicate that via the expire_on_close configuration option.
    |
    */

    'lifetime' => (int) env('SESSION_LIFETIME', 120),

    'expire_on_close' => env('SESSION_EXPIRE_ON_CLOSE', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Encryption
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option allows you to easily specify that all of your session data
    | should be encrypted before it's stored. All encryption is performed
    | automatically by Laravel and you may use the session like normal.
    |
    */

    'encrypt' => env('SESSION_ENCRYPT', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session File Location
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When utilizing the "file" session driver, the session files are placed
    | on disk. The default storage location is defined here; however, you
    | are free to provide another location where they should be stored.
    |
    */

    'files' => storage_path('framework/sessions'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Database Connection
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using the "database" or "redis" session drivers, you may specify a
    | connection that should be used to manage these sessions. This should
    | correspond to a connection in your database configuration options.
    |
    */

    'connection' => env('SESSION_CONNECTION'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Database Table
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using the "database" session driver, you may specify the table to
    | be used to store sessions. Of course, a sensible default is defined
    | for you; however, you're welcome to change this to another table.
    |
    */

    'table' => env('SESSION_TABLE', 'sessions'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cache Store
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using one of the framework's cache driven session backends, you may
    | define the cache store which should be used to store the session data
    | between requests. This must match one of your defined cache stores.
    |
    | Affects: "dynamodb", "memcached", "redis"
    |
    */

    'store' => env('SESSION_STORE'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Sweeping Lottery
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Some session drivers must manually sweep their storage location to get
    | rid of old sessions from storage. Here are the chances that it will
    | happen on a given request. By default, the odds are 2 out of 100.
    |
    */

    'lottery' => [2, 100],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cookie Name
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may change the name of the session cookie that is created by
    | the framework. Typically, you should not need to change this value
    | since doing so does not grant a meaningful security improvement.
    |
    */

    'cookie' => env(
        'SESSION_COOKIE',
        Str::slug((string) env('APP_NAME', 'laravel')).'-session'
    ),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    | be regarded as available. Typically, this will be the root path of
    | your application, but you're free to change this when necessary.
    |
    */

    'path' => env('SESSION_PATH', '/'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cookie Domain
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This value determines the domain and subdomains the session cookie is
    | available to. By default, the cookie will be available to the root
    | domain without subdomains. Typically, this shouldn't be changed.
    |
    */

    'domain' => env('SESSION_DOMAIN'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | HTTPS Only Cookies
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | By setting this option to true, session cookies will only be sent back
    | to the server if the browser has a HTTPS connection. This will keep
    | the cookie from being sent to you when it can't be done securely.
    |
    */

    'secure' => env('SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | HTTP Access Only

    'http_only' => env('SESSION_HTTP_ONLY', true),

    | See: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Set-Cookie#samesitesamesite-value
    |
    | Supported: "lax", "strict", "none", null

    */

    'same_site' => env('SESSION_SAME_SITE', 'lax'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Setting this value to true will tie the cookie to the top-level site for

    | when flagged "secure" and the Same-Site attribute is set to "none".
    |
    */

    'partitioned' => env('SESSION_PARTITIONED_COOKIE', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This value controls the serialization strategy for session data, which
    | is JSON by default. Setting this to "php" allows the storage of PHP
    | objects in the session but can make an application vulnerable to

    |
    | Supported: "json", "php"
    |
    */

    'serialization' => 'json',

File: database/factories/UserFactory.php
================
<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<User>
 */
class UserFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * The current password being used by the factory.
     */
    protected static ?string $password;

    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->name(),
            'email' => fake()->unique()->safeEmail(),
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'password' => static::$password ??= Hash::make('password'),
            'remember_token' => Str::random(10),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Indicate that the model's email address should be unverified.
     */
    public function unverified(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'email_verified_at' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

File: docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md

# Assumptions

- **Tabel pivot `company_user` ditunda**: Tabel ini tidak dibuat pada Fase 0 karena tabel `companies` baru akan dibuat pada Fase 1. Pada Fase 0, sistem auth dasar dibuat dengan `Role` Enum dan middleware terkait.
- **Instalasi Inertia + React**: Dilakukan secara manual (bukan via starter kit) untuk memastikan tidak ada konflik atau *overwrite* terhadap konfigurasi `package.json` dan Tailwind v4 yang sudah ada. Registrasi di-disable.
- **Seeder**: User demo mengambil sandi dari `.env` dan hanya dijalankan pada environment `local`.
- **Lokalisasi**: `APP_TIMEZONE=Asia/Jakarta` dan `APP_LOCALE=id` ditetapkan pada `.env` dan `config/app.php`.
- **Tema Visual**: Tailwind v4 di-extend pada `app.css` untuk menyediakan variabel tema (`--color-corporate-dark`, `--color-corporate-light`, `--color-panel-bg`, `--color-app-bg`) serta *font family* `Plus Jakarta Sans`.
- **Region Training**: "Kaltim" dipertahankan sebagai "Kaltim" dan tidak dikonversi ke "Kubar" sesuai instruksi revisi pada Fase 1.
- **Akun & Role**: Mengikuti keputusan terbaru pemilik (PRD Bagian 0.1), aplikasi hanya menggunakan SATU AKUN TANPA ROLE. Semua logika `Role`, pengecekan scope per perusahaan, tabel `company_user`, serta penyensoran `PrivacyMasker` dihapus total. Kolom `users.role` dan `users.is_active` dihapus dari database lewat migrasi baru. Semua halaman dan endpoint dilindungi middleware auth biasa.
- **Kualitas Data & Import File Excel Asli**: File CSV lama terbukti rusak dari sumbernya (NIK notasi ilmiah). Sekarang HR **diwajibkan** untuk memberikan file mentah `.xlsx` asli untuk import. NIK 14+ digit (atau 10-15 digit) adalah format NIK yang sah untuk pekerja Non-Staf dan berhasil diimpor sebagai teks murni secara akurat tanpa hilang presisi berkat modifikasi `GenericImport` dengan *Custom Value Binder*. Fitur konversi tanggal numeric bawaan Excel kini didukung di `Clean::date2`.
- **Klasifikasi Facility Turunan (Estate/Mill/HO)**: Karena DB mentah tidak menyediakan kolom klasifikasi operasional (Hanya ada Organization Name dan Location Name), klasifikasi diturunkan (derived) berdasarkan pengecekan kata kunci secara case-insensitive pada nilai *Location Name*: 
  1. Jika mengandung kata 'office' atau 'jakarta', dikategorikan sebagai **HO (Head Office)**.
  2. Jika mengandung kata 'pabrik', 'mill', 'kcp', 'biodiesel', atau 'bulking', dikategorikan sebagai **Mill**.
  3. Sisanya secara *default fallback* dikategorikan sebagai **Estate**. Logika ini diimplementasikan terpusat pada service layer backend (`WorkforceMetrics.php`).

# Open Questions

1. Apakah usia pensiun kebijakan perusahaan = 55? *(default 55, konfigurabel)*
2. Apakah `Kaltim` (training) = `Kubar` (employee)? *(default: dibiarkan terpisah, menunggu konfirmasi HR)*
3. Arti pasti kode level A–F dan 1–5. *(default: tabel 3.5)*
4. Bisakah HR mengekspor ulang Training Record dengan NIK berformat Teks? Apakah export employee akan dilengkapi non-staf yang NIK-nya 14 digit? *(default: tampilkan apa adanya dengan banner kualitas data)*
5. Karyawan yang hilang dari file employee terbaru: dianggap resign atau dibiarkan? *(default: dibiarkan, dengan peringatan)*
6. Apakah `hr_company` boleh melihat lebih dari satu perusahaan? *(default: ya, lewat pivot)*
7. Apakah manajemen boleh melihat nama staf pada level tertentu? *(default: tidak)*
8. Apakah ada kebijakan retensi audit log? *(default: simpan 24 bulan)*
9. Apakah aplikasi di-host di server internal atau cloud? *(server internal)*
10. Sumber logo dan panduan merek resmi. *(default: public/logofr.png)*

File: docs/PRD-Peta-SDM-Operasional.md

# PRD — Peta SDM Operasional

| | |
|---|---|
| **Versi** | 1.0 (28 September 2026) |
| **Status** | Siap dikerjakan |
| **Stack** | Laravel + Inertia.js + React + Tailwind CSS |
| **Bahasa antarmuka** | Bahasa Indonesia |
| **Bahasa kode** | Inggris (nama class, variabel, tabel, kolom) |

---

## 0. Cara memakai dokumen ini (WAJIB dibaca agent AI)

Dokumen ini adalah satu-satunya sumber kebenaran untuk proyek. Ikuti aturan kerja berikut.

1. **Jangan berasumsi versi atau konfigurasi.** Sebelum menulis kode, baca `composer.json`, `package.json`, `.env`, dan struktur folder. Catat versi Laravel, PHP, Node, dan database yang dipakai. Jika ada konflik dengan dokumen ini, ikuti kenyataan di repo lalu catat di `docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md`.
2. **Kerjakan per fase (Bagian 14).** Jangan loncat fase. Di akhir setiap fase: jalankan test, jalankan `npm run build`, lalu tulis ringkasan singkat apa yang selesai, apa yang belum, dan keputusan yang diambil.
3. **Jangan mengarang data.** Hanya tampilkan field yang benar-benar ada di kedua dataset (Bagian 3). Fitur di Bagian 2.3 ("Di luar cakupan") tidak boleh dibangun.
4. **Jika ada hal ambigu, catat sebagai pertanyaan** di `docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md` dan ambil keputusan paling aman (paling konservatif untuk privasi). Jangan berhenti total kecuali blocker nyata.
5. **Data pribadi karyawan tidak boleh masuk git.** File CSV sumber disimpan di `storage/app/imports/` yang harus ada di `.gitignore`. Jangan pernah menulis data nyata ke seeder, test, atau fixture. Pakai data sintetis.
6. **Tidak ada nilai hardcode untuk metrik.** Semua angka di dashboard berasal dari query. Konstanta bisnis (usia pensiun, batas generasi, ambang privasi) hidup di `config/sdm.php`.
7. **Semua teks UI dalam Bahasa Indonesia**, format angka `id-ID` (titik ribuan, koma desimal), tanggal `dd MMM yyyy`. Timezone aplikasi `Asia/Jakarta`, locale `id`.
8. **Kualitas minimum:** Form Request untuk validasi, Policy untuk otorisasi, Eloquent Resource/DTO untuk output, tidak ada query N+1, semua endpoint data terlindungi autentikasi.
9. Repo prototipe lama (React + Vite + Supabase) hanyalah **referensi desain visual**. Jangan salin kodenya, jangan pakai Supabase, jangan pakai `mockData`. Bagian 9 menjelaskan apa yang dipertahankan dari desainnya.

---

## 0.1 KEPUTUSAN PEMILIK: SATU AKUN, TANPA ROLE (menggantikan isi lain di dokumen ini)

Keputusan ini **mengalahkan** setiap bagian lain yang bertentangan. Jika ada kalimat di bawah yang menyebut role, scope, atau `management`, abaikan.

**Berlaku:**
- Aplikasi dipakai lewat **satu akun login** yang melihat **semua data** (semua perusahaan, semua halaman, semua detail karyawan, export, dan seluruh menu admin).
- Login tetap **wajib** (data pribadi karyawan). Tidak ada registrasi publik, tidak ada lupa-password lewat email publik bila tidak dikonfigurasi. Akun dibuat lewat seeder/perintah artisan dengan password dari `.env` atau prompt.
- Halaman Admin (Import, Koordinat Lokasi, Pemetaan Nama PT, Kualitas Data) tetap ada dan bisa dibuka akun tersebut.

**Dihapus dari cakupan:**
- Role (`super_admin`, `hr_admin`, `hr_company`, `management`), matriks akses 10.2, enum `Role`, middleware `EnsureRole`, Policy berbasis role.
- Scope per perusahaan, tabel pivot `company_user`, dan semua filter yang membatasi perusahaan berdasarkan user.
- Penyamaran angka kecil (`PrivacyMasker`, Bagian 10.4) dan ambang privasi di `config/sdm.php`.
- Halaman User & Akses (`/admin/users`, 11.5).
- Semua respons 403/404 berbasis role. Rute cukup dilindungi middleware `auth`.
- Kolom `users.role` dan `users.is_active` tidak dipakai (boleh dibiarkan atau dihapus lewat migrasi baru).

**Tetap berlaku:**
- Login wajib pada semua rute, HTTPS di produksi, `APP_DEBUG=false` di produksi, throttle login.
- Data sensitif tidak masuk git, CSV di `storage/app/imports/`.
- **Agama tetap tidak dibuatkan grafik/agregat** (hanya tampil di detail karyawan).
- `AuditLogger` yang sudah ada boleh dipertahankan untuk mencatat import, export, dan pembukaan detail karyawan. Halaman `/admin/audit-log` bersifat opsional dan tidak diprioritaskan.
- Semua aturan bisnis, definisi, halaman, grafik, filter, dan kualitas data tetap sama. Yang hilang hanya lapisan role dan penyamaran.

**Catatan risiko yang diterima pemilik:** satu akun bersama berarti siapa pun yang mengetahui passwordnya melihat seluruh data pribadi. Mitigasi minimal: password kuat, hanya diakses lewat jaringan/hosting yang dipercaya, dan ganti password bila ada orang yang tidak lagi berhak.

---

## 1. Ringkasan produk

### 1.1 Latar belakang
Tim HR grup perkebunan (First Resources dan anak perusahaannya) ingin melihat kondisi sumber daya manusia operasional dalam satu tempat: siapa saja karyawannya, tersebar di perusahaan dan lokasi mana, komposisi usia dan generasinya, siapa yang mendekati pensiun, dan seberapa jauh pelatihan sudah menjangkau mereka. Saat ini data ada di dua file Excel/CSV dan dianalisis manual.

### 1.2 Tujuan
| # | Tujuan | Ukuran keberhasilan |
|---|---|---|
| G1 | Satu dashboard eksekutif berisi KPI SDM dan insight otomatis | Manajemen bisa menjawab "berapa HC, berapa yang berisiko pensiun, bagaimana komposisi generasi" tanpa membuka Excel |
| G2 | Peta interaktif: peta → perusahaan → staf → detail pribadi | Dari peta sampai profil satu karyawan ≤ 3 klik |
| G3 | Analisis pelatihan dan hubungannya dengan profil karyawan | Coverage, jam pelatihan, dan tren per perusahaan/level/generasi tersedia |
| G4 | Data pribadi terlindungi | Role, scope per perusahaan, audit log, dan penyamaran angka kecil berfungsi |
| G5 | Update data mudah dan aman | HR bisa mengunggah CSV baru dan melihat laporan kualitas data tanpa developer |

### 1.3 Pengguna
| Role | Contoh | Akses |
|---|---|---|
| `super_admin` | IT / pemilik sistem | Semua, termasuk manajemen user |
| `hr_admin` | HR korporat | Semua data semua perusahaan, termasuk detail pribadi, import, export |
| `hr_company` | HR unit/perusahaan | Hanya perusahaan yang di-assign, termasuk detail pribadi perusahaan itu |
| `management` | Direksi, GM | Hanya angka agregat semua/sebagian perusahaan, **tanpa** daftar nama staf dan detail pribadi |

### 1.4 Non-goals
Aplikasi mobile native, penggajian, absensi, rekrutmen, dan integrasi HRIS real-time. Data dimasukkan lewat unggah file berkala.

## 2. Ruang lingkup

### 2.1 Di dalam cakupan
Halaman: Ringkasan Eksekutif, Peta Perusahaan, Demografi & Headcount, Masa Kerja & Rekrutmen, Risiko Pensiun, Pelatihan, Analisis Gabungan, Direktori Karyawan. Modul admin: Import Data, Pemetaan Nama PT, Koordinat Lokasi, Kualitas Data, User & Akses, Audit Log. Filter global, export Excel, insight otomatis berbasis aturan.

### 2.2 Kondisi proyek saat ini
- Project Laravel **sudah dibuat**. React, Inertia, Tailwind, dan library grafik/peta **belum dipasang** (dikerjakan di Fase 0).
- Tersedia tiga file starter dari analisis awal (bila ada di repo, **review dulu, jangan percaya buta**, belum pernah dijalankan):
  - `database/migrations/2026_09_28_000001_create_sdm_tables.php`
  - `app/Support/Clean.php`
  - `app/Console/Commands/ImportSdm.php`
- Dua file CSV sumber: `Data Employee.csv` dan `Training Record.csv` (delimiter `;`, CRLF).

### 2.3 Di luar cakupan (jangan dibangun)
Field/fitur berikut ada di prototipe lama tetapi **tidak ada di data**: target posisi, progress IDP, histori pekerjaan, prestasi, foto karyawan, status Cuti/Aktif, fasilitas perusahaan, suksesor/talent pool/heat-map suksesi, masa jabatan (LOP), turnover/resign (belum ada data resign), menu "Laporan" dan "Alat" dari prototipe. Jika kelak dibutuhkan, itu PRD terpisah.

---

## 3. Data

### 3.1 Dataset A — Employee (`Data Employee.csv`)
23 kolom, 1.746 baris, delimiter `;`.

`No; Employee ID; Employee Name; Join Date; Employment Type; Job Level Code; Job Title Code; Job Title Name; Organization Code; Organization Name; Location Code; Location Name; Company Code; Company Name; Birth Date; Birth Place; Gender; Marital Status; Religion; PTKP Code; PTKP Name; Group; Region`

| Kolom sumber | Kolom DB | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| Employee ID | `employees.employee_id` | String 10 digit, unik. **Jangan diubah jadi integer** (bisa berawalan angka nol) |
| Employee Name | `name` | |
| Join Date | `join_date` | Format `04-Dec-06` (tahun 2 digit). Lihat 3.4 |
| Employment Type | `employment_type` | PERMANENT, TRAINEE, PROBATION, CONTRACT, ACTING |
| Job Level Code | `job_level_code` | A–F dan 1–5. Lihat 3.5 |
| Job Title Code / Name | `job_title_code/name` | |
| Organization Code / Name | `organization_code/name` | Departemen (mis. LOGISTIC RIAU, AGRONOMY RIAU) |
| Location Code / Name | `locations` | 92 lokasi, relasi 1:1 kode↔nama |
| Company Code / Name | `companies` | 44 perusahaan, relasi 1:1 kode↔nama |
| Birth Date | `birth_date` | Tahun 2 digit. Lihat 3.4 |
| Birth Place | `birth_place` | 8 kosong |
| Gender | `gender` | Male / Female |
| Marital Status | `marital_status` | Nikah, Belum Nikah, Janda, Duda |
| Religion | `religion` | Islam, Christian, Catholic, Buddha, Hindu |
| PTKP Code / Name | `ptkp_code/name` | TK/0, K/0–K/3, TK/1, TK/2 |
| Group | `group` | FR, PO2, NON GROUP |
| Region | `region` | Riau, Kalbar, Kubar, Corp, Non |

**Kolom yang tidak ada di Dataset A:** Umur, Lama Bekerja, Kategori, Bulan, Tahun. Semuanya dihitung dari `birth_date` dan `join_date`. Jangan minta atau simpan umur manual.

### 3.2 Dataset B — Training Record (`Training Record.csv`)
24 kolom, 5.190 baris, delimiter `;`.

`No; NIK; Nama; Jenis Kelamin; Nama PT; Department; lokasi Kerja; Group; REGION; GOL; Jabatan; Tgl; Bln; Thn; Jml Hari; Jam Pelatihan; Nama Pelatihan; Instruktur; Tempat Pelatihan; Reg / Non Reg; Keterangan; Internal/Eksternal; Level; Periode`

Pemetaan kolom ke `training_records` mengikuti migrasi starter. Kunci ke Dataset A: `NIK` = `Employee ID`.

### 3.3 Temuan kualitas data (hasil profiling — WAJIB ditangani)

| # | Temuan | Angka | Penanganan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | Tanggal tahun 2 digit | Parser standar salah abad: 35 orang "lahir 2068" | Aturan pivot di 3.4 |
| Q2 | `NIK` berisi `-` atau kosong di training | 754 dari 5.190 baris (14,5%): 689 berisi `-`, 65 kosong | Simpan `nik = NULL`, `employee_id = NULL`. Tetap dihitung di statistik pelatihan, **tidak** di analisis gabungan |
| Q3 | `NIK` terisi tetapi tidak ada di Dataset A | Sebagian besar NIK 14 digit (pekerja non-staf) memang tidak ada di employee data. | Simpan `nik` apa adanya bila rapi, `employee_id = NULL`. Lihat catatan di bawah |
| Q4 | `Nama PT` tidak baku | 151 varian setelah normalisasi; hanya 7 yang otomatis cocok dengan 44 perusahaan resmi (1.240 baris) | Tabel `company_aliases` + UI pemetaan manual (Bagian 11.3) |
| Q5 | Region training hanya beda huruf besar/kecil. Sebenarnya hanya **3 region**: Riau, Kalbar (`KALBAR`=`Kalbar`), Kaltim (`KALTIM`=`Kaltim`=`kaltim`) | 2.816 / 1.824 / 550 baris | Samakan huruf besar/kecil (mis. `strtolower` lalu kapital di awal). **Keputusan pemilik: `Kaltim` TIDAK diubah menjadi `Kubar`.** Region training tetap Riau, Kalbar, Kaltim. Konsekuensi: lihat Bagian 6 (filter region) dan 7.6 |
| Q6 | `Reg / Non Reg` 4 ejaan | Reguler, Non Reguler, NON REGULER, NOn Reguler | Normalisasi ke dua nilai |
| Q7 | `Level` training tidak seragam | workers/Workers/Middle/Senior | Kapitalisasi seragam |
| Q8 | `Tgl` berisi campuran | `Jan-31`, `19-20`, `5` | **Abaikan `Tgl`.** Pakai `Bln` + `Thn` |
| Q9 | Duplikat mencurigakan di training | 1.704 baris dengan kombinasi (NIK, Nama Pelatihan, Tgl) sama | **Jangan dihapus.** Tandai di laporan kualitas data (sebagian besar karena NIK `-`) |
| Q10 | Cakupan tahun training | 5.152 baris tahun 2026, 38 baris 2025; periode Q1–Q3 | Filter tahun wajib ada; default = tahun terbaru |
| Q11 | Grup di employee ada `PO2` dan `NON GROUP`; Region `Corp` dan `Non` | 188 dan 25 karyawan | Tampilkan apa adanya; `Corp` = kantor pusat |
| Q12 | **NIK rusak karena Excel** (notasi ilmiah) | Sebelumnya terjadi di file CSV lama akibat export lossy (angka 14 digit terpotong jadi notasi ilmiah). Sekarang menggunakan `.xlsx` asli sehingga baris rusak = 0. | HR **WAJIB** menyerahkan file `.xlsx` asli (jangan di-save ke CSV) agar aplikasi membaca *numeric value* NIK 14 digit dengan `StringValueBinder` secara utuh. NIK 14+ digit adalah SAH untuk Non-Staf. Deteksi pola `E+` tetap dipertahankan sebagai jaring pengaman. |
| Q13 | NIK non-numerik | 14 baris berisi `Promosi` | Perlakukan sebagai NIK tidak valid (`NULL`) |

**Catatan penting Q3/Q12.** Karyawan yang tidak cocok dengan data Employee mayoritas bertipe `Non Staf` (mandor panen/pemeliharaan, tenaga keamanan, trainee) yang memiliki format **NIK 14 digit** sah. Dengan menggunakan file `.xlsx` asli, aplikasi berhasil memulihkan integritas data yang sebelumnya dianggap rusak oleh CSV. Jika "training coverage" dihitung naif, angkanya (sekitar 34%) tampak rendah padahal penyebabnya adalah banyaknya pekerja non-staf yang ikut training namun tak ada di database Employee inti, bukan kurangnya pelatihan staf. Aturan di 4.6 mengatasinya. Aplikasi harus menampilkan panel **"Kualitas Data"** yang menjelaskan hal ini secara transparan.

### 3.4 Aturan parsing tanggal (kritis)
- Format sumber `dd-MMM-yy`, contoh `04-Dec-06`.
- **Birth Date:** `yy <= 15` → `20yy`, selain itu `19yy`. (Karyawan termuda lahir 2006.)
- **Join Date:** `yy <= (tahun berjalan mod 100)` → `20yy`, selain itu `19yy`.
- Validasi setelah parsing: join date tidak boleh di masa depan; join date harus ≥ birth date + 15 tahun. Data yang melanggar **tetap diimpor** tetapi dihitung di laporan "tanggal mencurigakan".
- Hasil profiling dengan aturan ini (per 28 Sep 2026): 0 pelanggaran, umur 20,5–70,6 tahun.
- Jika file sumber baru memakai tahun 4 digit, parser harus tetap bisa membacanya.

### 3.5 Kode level jabatan (hasil inferensi, perlu konfirmasi HR)
| Kode | Jabatan paling umum | HC |
|---|---|---|
| A | Driver | 91 |
| B | Trainee | 118 |
| C | Asisten Kebun | 989 |
| D | Askep Kebun | 264 |
| E | Manager Kebun | 166 |
| F | Group Manager Kebun | 59 |
| 1 | Cleaning Service | 4 |
| 2 | Pegawai Tata Usaha Sekolah | 5 |
| 3 | Guru Sekolah | 42 |
| 4 | Wakil Kepala Sarpras | 6 |
| 5 | Kepala Sekolah | 2 |

Kode 1–5 hanya muncul di **Yayasan Inti Kasih Abadi (U03)**, yaitu jalur karier sekolah. Simpan mapping ini di `config/sdm.php` (`level_labels`, `level_tracks`) supaya bisa diubah tanpa migrasi. Di grafik, level diurutkan: A, B, C, D, E, F, lalu 1–5 (kelompok "Yayasan/Sekolah") dan ditampilkan dengan label, bukan hanya kode. Kode 1–5 **dikecualikan** dari analisis "piramida jabatan perkebunan" tetapi tetap ada di total HC.

Dihitung dari data nyata dengan aturan 3.4 dan tanggal acuan **28 September 2026**. Dipakai sebagai acceptance test saat data nyata diimpor di lingkungan pengembang (test otomatis tetap memakai data sintetis).

| Metrik | Nilai |
|---|---|

| Gender | Male 1.524, Female 222 |
| Rata-rata umur | 34,0 tahun |
| Rata-rata masa kerja | 6,4 tahun |
| Umur ≥ 55 | 61 orang |
| Generasi | Boomers 11, Gen X 202, Gen Y 835, Gen Z 698 |

| Region | Riau 1.022, Kalbar 334, Corp 188, Kubar 177, Non 25 |
| Jumlah perusahaan / lokasi | 44 / 92 |
| Baris training | 5.190; NIK kosong/`-`: 754; NIK rusak notasi ilmiah: 2.461; NIK rapi: 1.975 (cocok ke employee: 1.635 baris) |

## 4. Definisi bisnis (satu tempat, dipakai konsisten di semua halaman)

Semua konstanta ada di `config/sdm.php`. Semua perhitungan memakai `as_of` = hari ini (bisa dioverride lewat parameter `?as_of=YYYY-MM-DD` untuk keperluan test/laporan).

### 4.1 Umur dan masa kerja
- **Umur** = selisih tahun penuh `as_of − birth_date`. **Masa kerja (LOS)** = selisih `as_of − join_date`, disajikan dalam tahun dengan 1 desimal untuk rata-rata, dan tahun penuh untuk pengelompokan.
- **Kelompok umur:** `<25`, `25–34`, `35–44`, `45–54`, `55+`.
- **Kelompok masa kerja:** `<1`, `1–<3`, `3–<5`, `5–<10`, `10+` tahun.

### 4.2 Generasi (berdasarkan tahun lahir)
| Generasi | Tahun lahir |
|---|---|
| Baby Boomers | ≤ 1964 |
| Gen X | 1965–1980 |
| Gen Y / Milenial | 1981–1996 |
| Gen Z | ≥ 1997 |

Warna tetap di semua grafik: Boomers `#94A3B8`, Gen X `#F59E0B`, Gen Y `#0EA5E9`, Gen Z `#10B981`.

### 4.3 Risiko pensiun
- Usia pensiun = `config('sdm.retirement_age')`, default **55**.
- **Berisiko pensiun** = umur ≥ usia pensiun pada `as_of`.
- **Proyeksi pensiun N tahun** = jumlah karyawan yang mencapai usia pensiun dalam `(as_of, as_of + N tahun]`. Tampilkan untuk N = 1, 3, 5, dan per tahun kalender 5 tahun ke depan.
- **Posisi terkonsentrasi risiko** = kombinasi `job_title_name` dengan ≥ 1 orang berusia ≥ (usia pensiun − 3), diurutkan jumlah.

### 4.4 Headcount (HC)
Jumlah baris `employees`. Filter mempengaruhi HC. Tidak ada status aktif/nonaktif pada data.

### 4.5 Pelatihan
- **Sesi/Baris pelatihan** = 1 baris `training_records` (satu peserta di satu pelatihan).
- **Peserta unik** = `COUNT(DISTINCT nik)` untuk NIK tidak kosong, **plus** dijelaskan bahwa baris NIK `-` tidak bisa diidentifikasi (tampilkan angka baris tanpa NIK terpisah).
- **Total jam** = `SUM(hours)`. **Rata-rata jam per peserta** = total jam baris ber-NIK ÷ peserta unik.
- **Reg / Non Reg**, **Internal / Eksternal** = pengelompokan langsung dari kolom yang sudah dinormalisasi.

### 4.6 Training coverage (definisi ketat, ini yang paling mudah salah)
`coverage = karyawan di employees yang punya ≥ 1 baris training yang ter-link (employee_id terisi) ÷ total karyawan di employees` (dalam filter aktif).
- Selalu tampilkan **dua** angka berdampingan: coverage dan **"Baris training yang tidak dapat dihubungkan ke karyawan (NIK kosong, rusak, atau tidak ada di data karyawan): X (Y%)"** dengan tooltip penjelasan (lihat catatan Q3).
- Coverage hanya dihitung pada rentang tahun pelatihan yang dipilih (default: tahun terbaru).
- Jangan pernah menyebut karyawan "belum pernah dilatih" tanpa keterangan "belum tercatat di data pelatihan".

### 4.7 Insight otomatis (berbasis template, tanpa LLM)
Kelas `App\Services\InsightBuilder` menghasilkan 3–6 kalimat Indonesia dari angka yang sudah dihitung. Template contoh:
- "{Generasi terbesar} adalah kelompok terbesar: {n} orang ({p}%)."
- "Gen Y dan Gen Z mencapai {n} orang ({p}%)."
- "{n} karyawan ({p}%) berusia {retirement_age}+ tahun; konsentrasi terbesar di level {level}."
- "Dalam 3 tahun ke depan {n} karyawan mencapai usia pensiun."
- "Rasio karyawan perempuan {p}%; terendah di level {level}."
- "Coverage pelatihan {tahun}: {p}% karyawan tercatat mengikuti minimal satu pelatihan."
Aturan: kalimat hanya muncul jika datanya cukup (mis. denominator ≥ 10), dan insight mengikuti filter aktif.

## 6. Filter global

| Filter | Sumber | Tipe | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Region | `employees.region` | multi-select | |
| Group | `employees.group` | multi-select | |
| Perusahaan | `companies` | multi-select, searchable | Untuk `hr_company` hanya perusahaan miliknya |
| Lokasi | `locations` | multi-select, searchable | Bergantung pilihan perusahaan |
| Departemen | `employees.organization_name` | multi-select | |
| Level jabatan | `job_level_code` | multi-select | Tampil dengan label |
| Employment type | `employment_type` | multi-select | |
| Generasi | dihitung | multi-select | |
| Gender | `gender` | multi-select | |
| Periode pelatihan | `year`, `month` | tahun + rentang bulan | Hanya halaman Pelatihan/Analisis Gabungan/Ringkasan (KPI training) |

Perilaku:
- State filter ada di **query string** (`?region[]=Riau&company_id[]=12`) sehingga bisa dibagikan/bookmark dan tahan refresh.
- Filter diterapkan lewat satu class `App\Support\EmployeeFilter` dan `TrainingFilter` yang dipakai semua query. **Tidak boleh** ada halaman yang menulis logika filter sendiri.
- Filter berlaku lintas halaman (dipertahankan saat pindah halaman), kecuali Peta.
- Tombol "Reset filter" dan chip filter aktif di atas konten.
- **Filter Region bekerja di dua dunia yang berbeda.** Employee memakai Riau, Kalbar, Kubar, Corp, Non; training memakai Riau, Kalbar, Kaltim. Aturan: (a) di halaman berbasis employee (Ringkasan, Demografi, Masa Kerja, Pensiun, Peta, Direktori) dan di Analisis Gabungan, filter Region memakai `employees.region`; (b) di halaman Pelatihan (yang membaca `training_records` langsung), filter Region memakai `training_records.region` dan opsinya diambil dari nilai training. Beri keterangan kecil di UI: "Region pada data pelatihan memakai penamaan sendiri (Kaltim)." Saat filter perusahaan dipilih di halaman Pelatihan, gunakan `company_id` hasil pemetaan alias, bukan region.
- Scope role (Bagian 10) diterapkan **setelah** filter dan tidak bisa dilepas dari UI maupun query string.
