import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';

export function RegionalMapWidget({ data, total }) {
    // data is already grouped by geo-region from the backend:
    // { 'Sumatera': { Estate: x, Mill: y, HO: z }, 'Kalimantan': ..., 'Jawa / HO': ..., 'Lainnya': ... }

    // Hardcode positions for the regions for the SVG overlay
    const regionPositions = {
        'Riau': { top: '35%', left: '20%' },
        'Kalbar': { top: '35%', left: '42%' },
        'Kubar': { top: '40%', left: '55%' },
        'Corp': { top: '70%', left: '35%' },
        'Non': { top: '70%', left: '75%' },
    };

    const displayRegions = ['Riau', 'Kalbar', 'Kubar', 'Corp', 'Non'];

    const getRegionData = (name) => {
        const d = data?.[name] || { Estate: 0, Mill: 0, HO: 0 };
        const regionTotal = (d.Estate || 0) + (d.Mill || 0) + (d.HO || 0);
        const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((regionTotal / total) * 100) : 0;
        return { Estate: d.Estate || 0, Mill: d.Mill || 0, HO: d.HO || 0, total: regionTotal, pct };
    };

    return (
        <div className="relative w-full h-[400px] flex items-center justify-center bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
            {/* SVG representation of Indonesia map for background */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none p-4">
                <img src="/indonesia-map.svg" alt="Peta Indonesia" className="w-[90%] h-auto opacity-15 grayscale object-contain" />
            </div>

            {displayRegions.map(region => {
                const stat = getRegionData(region);
                if (stat.total === 0) return null; // Don't show empty cards

                const pos = regionPositions[region] || { top: '50%', left: '50%' };
                
                return (
                    <div 
                        key={region} 
                        className="absolute bg-white/95 backdrop-blur shadow-sm border border-gray-100 rounded-xl p-3 flex gap-3 items-center"
                        style={{ top: pos.top, left: pos.left, transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)', minWidth: '160px' }}
                    >
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-corporate-dark text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold shrink-0 shadow-inner">
                            {stat.pct}%
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1">
                            <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-800 text-sm mb-1">{region === 'Non' ? 'Non / Lainnya' : region}</h4>
                            <div className="space-y-1 text-xs">
                                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-corporate-dark"></div> Estate</span>
                                    <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700">{formatNumber(stat.Estate)}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-500"></div> Mill</span>
                                    <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700">{formatNumber(stat.Mill)}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></div> HO</span>
                                    <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700">{formatNumber(stat.HO)}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                );
            })}
        </div>
    );
}

export function ScatterChart({ data, xKey = 'umur', yKey = 'masa_kerja', zKey = 'anomali', xLabel = 'X', yLabel = 'Y' }) {

    const CustomTooltip = ({ active, payload }) => {

                        <p className="text-red-600 mt-1 font-bold text-xs">

                    type="number" 
                    dataKey={yKey} 
                    name={yLabel} 
                    tick={{ fontSize: 12 }} 
                    axisLine={false} 
                    tickLine={false} 
                />
                <Tooltip content={<CustomTooltip />} cursor={{ strokeDasharray: '3 3' }} />
                <Scatter name="Karyawan" data={data}>
                    {data.map((entry, index) => (
                        <Cell 
                            key={`cell-${index}`} 
                            fill={entry[zKey] === 'yes' ? '#EF4444' : '#60A5FA'} 
                            fillOpacity={entry[zKey] === 'yes' ? 1 : 0.6}
                        />
                    ))}
                </Scatter>
            </RechartsScatter>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );

import { Treemap as RechartsTreemap, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip } from 'recharts';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';

const CustomizedContent = (props) => {
    const { root, depth, x, y, width, height, index, payload, colors, rank, name } = props;
    
    // Only render for leaf nodes or if they are large enough
    if (depth < 1) return null;

    return (
        <g>
            <rect
                x={x}
                y={y}
                width={width}
                height={height}
                style={{
                    fill: defaultPalette[index % defaultPalette.length],
                    stroke: '#fff',
                    strokeWidth: 2 / (depth + 1e-10),
                    strokeOpacity: 1 / (depth + 1e-10),
                }}
            />
            {width > 50 && height > 30 ? (
                <text x={x + 8} y={y + 18} fill="#fff" fontSize={12} fontWeight="bold" className="truncate">
                    {name}
                </text>
            ) : null}
            {width > 50 && height > 45 ? (
                <text x={x + 8} y={y + 34} fill="#fff" fontSize={11} opacity={0.9}>
                    {formatNumber(props.value)}
                </text>
            ) : null}
        </g>
    );
};

            </div>
        );
    }
    return null;
};

        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/react';

export function FilterBar({ availableFilters }) {
    const { filters } = usePage().props;
    const [localFilters, setLocalFilters] = useState(filters || {});

    const apply = () => {
        router.get(route(route().current()), localFilters, { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
    };

    const reset = () => {
        setLocalFilters({});
        router.get(route(route().current()), {}, { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
    };

    return (
        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded shadow mb-4 flex gap-4 flex-wrap items-end">
            <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1">Region</label>
                <select 
                    className="border p-2 rounded text-sm w-40"
                    value={localFilters.region || ''}
                    onChange={e => setLocalFilters({...localFilters, region: e.target.value})}
                >
                    <option value="">Semua</option>
                    <option value="Sumatera">Sumatera</option>
                    <option value="Kalimantan">Kalimantan</option>
                    <option value="Riau">Riau</option>
                    <option value="Kalbar">Kalbar</option>
                    <option value="Kaltim">Kaltim</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            {/* Add more filters similarly: Group, Company, Location, Dept, Level, Emp Type, Gen, Gender */}
            <div>
                <button onClick={apply} className="bg-corporate-light text-white px-4 py-2 rounded text-sm font-bold mr-2">Terapkan</button>
                <button onClick={reset} className="bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 px-4 py-2 rounded text-sm font-bold">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Search } from 'lucide-react';

export function CompanyList({ companies, locations, totalLocations, selectedLocation, onSelectCompany }) {
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

    const filtered = companies.filter(c => 
        c.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || 
        c.code.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
        c.region.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
    );

    // Group by region
    const grouped = filtered.reduce((acc, c) => {
        const r = c.region || 'Lainnya';
        if (!acc[r]) acc[r] = [];
        acc[r].push(c);
        return acc;
    }, {});

    const totalHc = filtered.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.employee_count === '<5' ? 0 : parseInt(c.employee_count) || 0), 0);

    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-white">
            <div className="p-4 border-b">
                <div className="relative mb-4">
                    <Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400 w-5 h-5" />
                    <input 
                        type="text" 
                        placeholder="Cari perusahaan, lokasi, atau region..." 
                        className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none"
                        value={search}
                        onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                    />
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-4 text-sm text-gray-600">
                    <div><span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{totalHc.toLocaleString()}</span> HC</div>
                    <div><span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{filtered.length}</span> Perusahaan</div>
                    <div><span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{totalLocations}</span> Lokasi</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-6">
                {Object.keys(grouped).sort().map(region => (
                    <div key={region}>

                                <button 
                                    key={c.id}

                                    </div>
                                </button>

                        </div>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>
        </div>
    );

export function CompanyPanel({ company, location, onBack, onLocationSelect }) {
    const { auth } = usePage().props;
    const [tab, setTab] = useState('profil');

                setLoading(false);
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error(err);
                setLoading(false);
            });
    }, [company.id]);

    const COLORS = ['#0088FE', '#00C49F', '#FFBB28', '#FF8042', '#8884d8'];

    const renderPie = (dataObj) => {
        if (!dataObj) return null;
        const data = Object.entries(dataObj).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value: value === '<5' ? 5 : value }));
        return (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={200}>
                <PieChart>
                    <Pie data={data} cx="50%" cy="50%" innerRadius={60} outerRadius={80} fill="#8884d8" paddingAngle={5} dataKey="value">
                        {data.map((entry, index) => (
                            <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={COLORS[index % COLORS.length]} />
                        ))}
                    </Pie>
                    <RechartsTooltip formatter={(value, name, props) => [dataObj[props.payload.name], name]} />
                </PieChart>

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Tooltip, useMap } from 'react-leaflet';
import MarkerClusterGroup from 'react-leaflet-cluster';
import { LeafletIcon } from '../LeafletIcon';
import L from 'leaflet';
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';
import 'react-leaflet-cluster/dist/assets/MarkerCluster.css';
import 'react-leaflet-cluster/dist/assets/MarkerCluster.Default.css';

function MapEffect({ locations, selectedCompanyId, selectedLocationId }) {
    const map = useMap();
    
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!locations || locations.length === 0) return;
        
        let bounds = [];
        
        if (selectedCompanyId) {
            const locs = locations.filter(l => l.companies && l.companies.includes(selectedCompanyId) && l.latitude);
            if (locs.length > 0) {
                locs.forEach(l => bounds.push([l.latitude, l.longitude]));
            }
        } else if (selectedLocationId) {
            const loc = locations.find(l => l.id === selectedLocationId);
            if (loc && loc.latitude) {
                map.flyTo([loc.latitude, loc.longitude], 12, { animate: true, duration: 1.5 });
                return;
            }
        } else {
            // All locations
            locations.filter(l => l.latitude).forEach(l => bounds.push([l.latitude, l.longitude]));
        }

        if (bounds.length === 1) {
            map.flyTo(bounds[0], 12, { animate: true, duration: 1.5 });
        } else if (bounds.length > 1) {
            map.flyToBounds(bounds, { animate: true, duration: 1.5, padding: [50, 50], maxZoom: 12 });
        }
    }, [selectedCompanyId, selectedLocationId, locations, map]);

    return null;
}

export function SdmMap({ locations, selectedCompanyId, selectedLocationId, onSelectLocation }) {
    const validLocs = locations.filter(l => l.latitude && l.longitude);

    // region colors
    const regionColors = {
        'Sumatera': '#ef4444', // red
        'Kalimantan': '#3b82f6', // blue
        'Riau': '#eab308', // yellow
        'Kalbar': '#22c55e', // green
        'Kaltim': '#a855f7', // purple
        'Kubar': '#ec4899', // pink
        'Corp': '#111827', // dark for Corp
        'Non': '#64748b',
        'Unknown': '#9ca3af' // gray
    };

    const createCustomIcon = (region, hc, isCorp, source) => {
        const bgStyle = isCorp 
            ? 'background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a8a 0%, #172554 100%);' 
            : `background-color: ${regionColors[region] || regionColors['Unknown']};`;
            
        const shape = isCorp ? 'border-radius: 8px;' : 'border-radius: 50%;';
        const label = isCorp ? '🏢' : (hc === '<5' ? hc : hc);
        const borderStyle = source === 'pendekatan' ? '2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.9)' : '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
        const shadow = isCorp ? 'box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(23, 37, 84, 0.5);' : 'box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);';

        return L.divIcon({
            html: `<div style="${bgStyle} width: 32px; height: 32px; ${shape} border: ${borderStyle}; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: white; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; ${shadow} transition: all 0.3s ease;">${label}</div>`,
            className: 'custom-leaflet-icon',
            iconSize: [32, 32],
            iconAnchor: [16, 16]
        });
    };

    return (
        <MapContainer 
            center={[-2.5, 118.0]} 
            zoom={5} 
            className="h-full w-full z-0" 
            zoomControl={false}
            preferCanvas={true}
            zoomSnap={1}
            wheelPxPerZoomLevel={60}
        >
            <TileLayer
                url={import.meta.env.VITE_MAP_TILE_URL || "https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=m&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}"}
                attribution={import.meta.env.VITE_MAP_ATTRIBUTION || '&copy; Google Maps'}
            />
            <MarkerClusterGroup 
                chunkedLoading={true} 
                maxClusterRadius={40}
                spiderfyOnMaxZoom={true}
                removeOutsideVisibleBounds={true}
            >
                {validLocs.map(loc => (
                    <Marker 
                        key={loc.id} 
                        position={[loc.latitude, loc.longitude]}
                        icon={createCustomIcon(loc.region || 'Unknown', loc.employee_count, loc.name.includes('Corporate Office'), loc.coordinate_source)}
                        eventHandlers={{
                            click: () => {
                                const companies = loc.companies || [];
                                onSelectLocation(loc.id, companies.length === 1 ? companies[0] : null);
                            }
                        }}
                    >
                        <Tooltip>
                            <div className="text-sm">
                                <p className="font-bold">{loc.name}</p>
                                <p>HC: {loc.employee_count}</p>
                                <p>Perusahaan: {(loc.companies || []).length}</p>
                                {loc.coordinate_source === 'pendekatan' && (
                                    <p className="text-xs text-orange-500 font-bold">Lokasi perkiraan</p>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </Tooltip>
                    </Marker>
                ))}
            </MarkerClusterGroup>
            
            <MapEffect 
                locations={locations} 
                selectedCompanyId={selectedCompanyId} 
                selectedLocationId={selectedLocationId} 
            />
        </MapContainer>
    );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';

export function StaffDetailModal({ employeeId, onClose }) {
    const [detail, setDetail] = useState(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        axios.get(`/data/employees/${employeeId}`)
            .then(res => {
                setDetail(res.data);
                setLoading(false);
            })
            .catch(err => {
                setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Gagal memuat data');
                setLoading(false);
            });
    }, [employeeId]);

    // Handle escape key
    useEffect(() => {
        const handleEsc = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
        };
        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
    }, [onClose]);

    return (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-[9999] flex justify-center items-center p-4">
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative"
                 onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
                <div className="p-4 border-b flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50">
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800">Detail Karyawan</h2>
                    <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 p-2 text-xl leading-none">&times;</button>
                </div>
                
                <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
                    {loading ? (
                        <div className="text-center py-10">Memuat detail...</div>
                    ) : error ? (
                        <div className="text-center py-10 text-red-500">{error}</div>
                    ) : detail && (
                        <div className="space-y-8">
                            <section>
                                <h3 className="font-bold text-corporate-dark border-b pb-2 mb-4">Identitas & Organisasi</h3>
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';
import { Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { StaffDetailModal } from './StaffDetailModal';

export function StaffList({ company, location }) {
    const [employees, setEmployees] = useState(null);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [selectedEmp, setSelectedEmp] = useState(null);

    const loadData = () => {
        setLoading(true);
        const locParam = location ? `&location_id=${location.id}` : '';
        axios.get(`/data/companies/${company.id}/employees?page=${page}&search=${search}${locParam}`)
            .then(res => {
                setEmployees(res.data);
                setLoading(false);
            });
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        loadData();
    }, [company.id, page, location]);

    useEffect(() => {
        setPage(1);
        const timer = setTimeout(loadData, 500);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }, [search]);

    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col h-full space-y-4">
            <div className="relative">
                <Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400 w-5 h-5" />
                <input 
                    type="text" 
                    placeholder="Cari nama, NIK, jabatan..." 
                    className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light"
                    value={search}
                    onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                />
            </div>

            {loading ? (
                <div className="text-center py-10 text-gray-500">Memuat staf...</div>
            ) : employees?.data.length > 0 ? (
                <>
                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-3">
                        {employees.data.map(emp => (
                            <button 
                                key={emp.employee_id}
                                onClick={() => setSelectedEmp(emp.employee_id)}
                                className="w-full text-left p-3 border rounded-lg hover:border-corporate-light hover:bg-gray-50 flex items-center gap-3"
                            >
                                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-corporate-light text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                                    {emp.name.charAt(0)}
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                    <div className="font-bold text-gray-900 truncate">{emp.name}</div>
                                    <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 truncate">{emp.job_title_name}</div>
                                </div>
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center py-4 border-t">
                        <button 
                            disabled={page === 1}
                            onClick={() => setPage(p => p - 1)}
                            className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded disabled:opacity-50"
                        >Prev</button>
                        <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">Hal {employees.current_page} dari {employees.last_page}</span>
                        <button 
                            disabled={page === employees.last_page}
                            onClick={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}
                            className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded disabled:opacity-50"
                        >Next</button>
                    </div>
                </>
            ) : (
                <div className="text-center py-10 text-gray-500">Tidak ada staf ditemukan.</div>
            )}

            {selectedEmp && (
                <StaffDetailModal 
                    employeeId={selectedEmp} 
                    onClose={() => setSelectedEmp(null)} 
                />
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import { Skeleton } from './Skeleton';
import { EmptyState } from './EmptyState';
import { useCopyAsImage } from '@/hooks/useCopyAsImage';
import { CopyButton } from './CopyButton';

export function ChartCard({ title, loading, isEmpty, children, className = '', height = "h-72" }) {
    const { ref: cardRef, isCopying, status, handleCopy } = useCopyAsImage({ title });

    return (
        <div ref={cardRef} className={`bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)] border-0 transition-all duration-300 [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(6,78,59,0.12)] [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col relative ${className}`}>
            <CopyButton handleCopy={handleCopy} status={status} isCopying={isCopying} loading={loading} />

            <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-800 pb-3 mb-4 pr-12 border-b border-gray-100/60">{title}</h3>
            <div className={`relative w-full min-h-[18rem] ${height}`}>
                {loading ? (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-end justify-between gap-2 p-4">
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-1/3" />
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-2/3" />
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-1/2" />
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-full" />
                        <Skeleton className="w-1/6 h-3/4" />
                    </div>
                ) : isEmpty ? (
                    <EmptyState />
                ) : (
                    children
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import { Check, Image as ImageIcon } from 'lucide-react';

export function CopyButton({ handleCopy, status, isCopying, loading }) {
    return (
        <div className="hide-from-export absolute top-4 right-4 z-10 flex items-center gap-2">
            {status === 'copied' && <span className="text-xs font-medium text-green-700 bg-green-50 border border-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded shadow-sm">Disalin ke clipboard!</span>}
            {status === 'downloaded' && <span className="text-xs font-medium text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded shadow-sm max-w-48 text-right leading-tight">Browser tidak mendukung salin gambar, file diunduh sebagai gantinya.</span>}
            
            <button
                onClick={handleCopy}
                disabled={loading || isCopying}
                title={loading ? 'Memuat...' : 'Salin sebagai Gambar'}
                className={`p-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors ${loading ? 'opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed text-gray-300' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100'}`}
            >
                {status === 'copied' ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" /> : <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}

import { formatNumber, formatDecimal } from '@/lib/format';
import { TrendingUp, Users, Activity, BarChart2, Calendar, Target, GraduationCap, Briefcase } from 'lucide-react';

export function KpiCard({ title, value, unit = '', note = '', highlight = false, isDecimal = false, secondaryText = '', icon: CustomIcon }) {
    const displayValue = isDecimal ? formatDecimal(value) : formatNumber(value);
    
    // Choose icon based on title
    let Icon = CustomIcon || BarChart2;
    if (!CustomIcon) {
        const tl = title.toLowerCase();
        if (tl.includes('karyawan') || tl.includes('perempuan') || tl.includes('gen')) {
            Icon = Users;
        } else if (tl.includes('umur') || tl.includes('masa kerja')) {
            Icon = Activity;
        } else if (tl.includes('pensiun')) {
            Icon = TrendingUp;
        } else if (tl.includes('pelatihan') || tl.includes('training')) {
            Icon = GraduationCap;
        }
    }

    const tlLower = title.toLowerCase();
    const needsAttention = tlLower.includes('risiko') || tlLower.includes('belum dilatih') || tlLower.includes('anomali') || highlight;
    const borderClass = needsAttention ? 'border border-amber-500' : 'border border-[#40826D]/40';
    const iconBgClass = needsAttention ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600' : 'bg-green-50 text-[#40826D]';

    return (
        <div className={`bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)] ${borderClass} transition-all duration-300 [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(6,78,59,0.12)] [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col justify-between h-full relative overflow-hidden group`}>
            {/* Subtle background decoration for highlight */}
            {highlight && (
                <div className="absolute -right-6 -top-6 w-24 h-24 bg-amber-500 rounded-full blur-3xl opacity-10 pointer-events-none transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"></div>
            )}
            
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4 relative z-10">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider pr-2">{title}</h3>
                <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 ${iconBgClass}`}>
                    <Icon size={22} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="relative z-10">
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                    <span className={`text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight ${highlight ? 'text-gray-900' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>
                        {displayValue}
                    </span>
                    {unit && <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-400 ml-1">{unit}</span>}
                </div>
                
                {(note || secondaryText) && (
                    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center">
                        {note && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center text-[11px] font-medium bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-gray-100">
                                {note}
                            </span>
                        )}
                        {secondaryText && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center text-[11px] font-medium text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                                {secondaryText}
                            </span>
                        )}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

================
File: resources/js/Components/ui/MultiSelect.jsx

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, Check, X } from 'lucide-react';

export function MultiSelect({ options = [], value = [], onChange, placeholder, disabled = false, labelKey = 'name', valueKey = 'id' }) {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
    const containerRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
            if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
                setIsOpen(false);
            }
        };
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
        return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }, []);

    const toggleOption = (optValue) => {
        if (value.includes(optValue)) {
            onChange(value.filter(v => v !== optValue));
        } else {
            onChange([...value, optValue]);
        }
    };

    const clearAll = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onChange([]);
    };

    const selectedCount = value.length;

    return (
        <div className={`relative ${disabled ? 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none' : ''}`} ref={containerRef}>
            <div 
                className="flex items-center justify-between min-h-[38px] px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:border-corporate-light transition-colors"
                onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
            >
                <div className="flex-1 truncate text-sm">
                    {selectedCount > 0 ? (
                        <span className="font-semibold text-corporate-dark">{selectedCount} terpilih</span>
                    ) : (
                        <span className="text-gray-400">{placeholder}</span>
                    )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-gray-400">
                    {selectedCount > 0 && (
                        <button onClick={clearAll} className="p-0.5 hover:text-red-500 rounded-full hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors">
                            <X size={14} />
                        </button>
                    )}
                    <ChevronDown size={16} />
                </div>
            </div>

            {isOpen && (
                <div className="absolute z-[100] w-full min-w-[200px] mt-1 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-lg max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
                    {options.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="p-3 text-sm text-gray-500 text-center">Tidak ada opsi</div>
                    ) : (
                        <div className="p-1">
                            {options.map((opt) => {
                                const optVal = typeof opt === 'object' ? opt[valueKey] : opt;
                                const optLabel = typeof opt === 'object' ? opt[labelKey] : opt;
                                const isSelected = value.includes(String(optVal));
                                return (
                                    <div 
                                        key={optVal} 
                                        className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded hover:bg-gray-50 cursor-pointer"
                                        onClick={() => toggleOption(String(optVal))}
                                    >
                                        <div className={`w-4 h-4 rounded border flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 transition-colors ${isSelected ? 'bg-corporate-light border-corporate-light text-white' : 'border-gray-300'}`}>
                                            {isSelected && <Check size={12} strokeWidth={3} />}
                                        </div>
                                        <span className="truncate">{optLabel}</span>
                                    </div>
                                );
                            })}
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { toBlob, toPng } from 'html-to-image';

export function useCopyAsImage({ title = 'export', onBeforeCapture = null, onAfterCapture = null } = {}) {
    const ref = useRef(null);
    const [isCopying, setIsCopying] = useState(false);
    const [status, setStatus] = useState(''); // 'copied', 'downloaded', ''

    const handleCopy = async () => {
        if (!ref.current) return;
        
        setIsCopying(true);
        setStatus('');
        
        // Optional pre-capture operations (like expanding scrollable elements)
        if (onBeforeCapture) {
            await onBeforeCapture(ref.current);
            // wait a tiny bit for DOM changes to render
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); 
        }

        // Filter out the button container
        const filter = (node) => {
            return !(node.classList && node.classList.contains('hide-from-export'));
        };
        
        try {
            const blob = await toBlob(ref.current, { backgroundColor: '#ffffff', filter });
            
            if (navigator.clipboard && window.ClipboardItem) {
                try {
                    await navigator.clipboard.write([
                        new window.ClipboardItem({ 'image/png': blob })
                    ]);
                    setStatus('copied');
                } catch (err) {
                    throw err; // Fallback to download
                }
            } else {
                throw new Error('Clipboard API not supported'); // Fallback to download
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('Failed to copy to clipboard, falling back to download', error);
            try {
                const dataUrl = await toPng(ref.current, { backgroundColor: '#ffffff', filter });
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.download = `${title.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_').toLowerCase()}.png`;
                link.href = dataUrl;
                link.click();
                setStatus('downloaded');
            } catch (dlError) {
                console.error('Failed to download image', dlError);
            }
        } finally {
            if (onAfterCapture) {
                await onAfterCapture(ref.current);
            }
            setIsCopying(false);
            setTimeout(() => setStatus(''), 2500);
        }
    };

    return { ref, isCopying, status, handleCopy };
}

import { useFilters } from './useFilters';

export function useCrossFilter(isTrainingPage = false) {
    const { filters, updateFilter } = useFilters(isTrainingPage);

    // Adds a value to an array filter if it doesn't exist, removes if it does
    const toggleFilter = (key, value) => {
        const currentVals = filters[key] || [];
        if (Array.isArray(currentVals)) {
            if (currentVals.includes(String(value)) || currentVals.includes(value)) {
                // Remove
                updateFilter(key, currentVals.filter(v => String(v) !== String(value)));
            } else {
                // Add
                updateFilter(key, [...currentVals, String(value)]);
            }
        }
    };

    const hasFilter = (key, value) => {
        const currentVals = filters[key] || [];
        return Array.isArray(currentVals) && (currentVals.includes(String(value)) || currentVals.includes(value));
    };

    return { toggleFilter, hasFilter };
}

================
File: resources/js/hooks/useFilters.js
================
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/react';
import axios from 'axios';

let cachedOptions = null;
let fetchPromise = null;

export function useFilters(isTrainingPage = false) {
    const { url } = usePage();
    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(url.split('?')[1] || '');
    
    const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
        region: searchParams.getAll('region[]'),
        group: searchParams.getAll('group[]'),
        company_id: searchParams.getAll('company_id[]'),
        location_id: searchParams.getAll('location_id[]'),
        organization_name: searchParams.getAll('organization_name[]'),
        job_level_code: searchParams.getAll('job_level_code[]'),
        employment_type: searchParams.getAll('employment_type[]'),
        generation: searchParams.getAll('generation[]'),
        gender: searchParams.getAll('gender[]'),
        marital_status: searchParams.getAll('marital_status[]'),
        year: searchParams.get('year') || '',
        month: searchParams.get('month') || '',
        nik_status: searchParams.get('nik_status') || '',
        job_category: searchParams.getAll('job_category[]'),
        is_regular: searchParams.get('is_regular') || '',
        is_internal: searchParams.get('is_internal') || '',
        level: searchParams.getAll('level[]'),
    });

    const [options, setOptions] = useState(cachedOptions || null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!cachedOptions);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (cachedOptions) return;

        if (!fetchPromise) {
            fetchPromise = axios.get('/data/filter-options').then(res => res.data);
        }

        fetchPromise.then(data => {
            cachedOptions = data;
            setOptions(data);
            setLoading(false);
        });
    }, []);

    const updateFilter = (key, value) => {
        const newFilters = { ...filters, [key]: value };
        setFilters(newFilters);
        applyFilters(newFilters);
    };

    const applyFilters = (currentFilters) => {
        const query = {};
        for (const key in currentFilters) {
            if (Array.isArray(currentFilters[key]) && currentFilters[key].length > 0) {
                query[`${key}[]`] = currentFilters[key];
            } else if (!Array.isArray(currentFilters[key]) && currentFilters[key] !== '') {
                query[key] = currentFilters[key];
            }
        }
        
        router.get(window.location.pathname, query, { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true, replace: true });
    };

    const resetFilters = () => {
        const emptyFilters = {
            region: [], group: [], company_id: [], location_id: [],
            organization_name: [], job_level_code: [], employment_type: [],
            generation: [], gender: [], marital_status: [], year: '', month: '',
            nik_status: '', job_category: [], is_regular: '', is_internal: '', level: []
        };
        setFilters(emptyFilters);
        applyFilters(emptyFilters);
    };

    const getActiveCount = () => {
        let count = 0;
        for (const key in filters) {
            if (Array.isArray(filters[key])) {
                count += filters[key].length;
            } else if (filters[key]) {
                count += 1;
            }
        }
        return count;
    };

    return { filters, options, loading, updateFilter, applyFilters, resetFilters, getActiveCount, isTrainingPage };
}

File: resources/js/lib/format.js

export function formatNumber(num) {
    if (num === null || num === undefined) return '-';
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID').format(num);
}

export function formatDecimal(num) {
    if (num === null || num === undefined) return '-';
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 1, maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(num);
}

export function formatDate(dateStr) {
    if (!dateStr) return '-';
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }).format(d);
}

                                    File Training yang diupload harus berupa <strong>REKAP LENGKAP</strong> dari awal (bukan cuma data bulan berjalan). 
                                    Setiap import training akan <strong>MENGGANTI SELURUH data lama</strong> di sistem, bukan menambahkannya.
                                </p>
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <input 
                            type="file" 
                            accept=".csv,.txt,.xlsx,.xls"
                            onChange={e => setData('file', e.target.files[0])}
                            className="w-full border border-gray-300 p-2 rounded-md"
                        />
                        {errors.file && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-1">{errors.file}</p>}
                    </div>
                    <button 
                        type="submit" 
                        disabled={processing || !data.file}
                        className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                        {processing ? 'Mengimpor...' : 'Jalankan Import'}
                    </button>
                </form>
            </div>

            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Riwayat Import</h2>
            <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                    <thead className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
                        <tr>
                            <th className="p-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">ID</th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Tipe</th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">File</th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Total/Import/Skip</th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Waktu</th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">Status</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                        {batches?.map(b => (
                            <tr key={b.id}>
                                <td className="p-3 text-sm">{b.id}</td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-sm capitalize">{b.type}</td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-sm">{b.filename}</td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-sm">{b.rows_total} / {b.rows_imported} / {b.rows_skipped}</td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-sm">{new Date(b.started_at).toLocaleString('id-ID')}</td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-sm">{b.status}</td>
                            </tr>
                        ))}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </AppLayout>
    );

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Head, usePage, router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout';
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, useMapEvents } from 'react-leaflet';
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';
import { LeafletIcon } from '@/Components/LeafletIcon'; // Custom icon to avoid default image issue

function MiniMap({ lat, lng, onChange }) {
    const defaultCenter = [ -2.5, 118.0 ]; // Center of Indonesia
    const center = (lat && lng) ? [lat, lng] : defaultCenter;

    function LocationMarker() {
        useMapEvents({
            click(e) {
                onChange(e.latlng.lat, e.latlng.lng);
            },
        });

        return lat && lng ? (
            <Marker position={[lat, lng]} icon={LeafletIcon} />
        ) : null;
    }

    return (
        <MapContainer center={center} zoom={4} className="h-64 w-full rounded-md z-0">
            <TileLayer
                url={import.meta.env.VITE_MAP_TILE_URL || "https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"}
                attribution={import.meta.env.VITE_MAP_ATTRIBUTION || '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors'}
            />
            <LocationMarker />
        </MapContainer>
    );
}

export default function LocationAdmin({ locations }) {
    const { flash, errors: pageErrors } = usePage().props;
    const [selectedLoc, setSelectedLoc] = useState(null);
    const { data, setData, post, processing, errors, reset, clearErrors } = useForm({
        latitude: '',
        longitude: ''
    });

    const [importFile, setImportFile] = useState(null);

    const openEdit = (loc) => {
        setSelectedLoc(loc);
        setData({ latitude: loc.latitude || '', longitude: loc.longitude || '' });
        clearErrors();
    };

    const submitEdit = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        post(`/admin/lokasi/${selectedLoc.id}`, {
            onSuccess: () => setSelectedLoc(null),
        });
    };

    const [previewData, setPreviewData] = useState(null);

    const handleFileChange = (e) => {
        const file = e.target.files[0];
        setImportFile(file);
        if (!file) {
            setPreviewData(null);
            return;
        }

        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = (e) => {
            const text = e.target.result;
            const lines = text.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim() !== '');
            if (lines.length > 0) {
                const header = lines[0].split(';');
                const codeIdx = header.indexOf('code');
                const latIdx = header.indexOf('latitude');
                const lngIdx = header.indexOf('longitude');
                
                if (codeIdx > -1 && latIdx > -1 && lngIdx > -1) {
                    const previews = lines.slice(1, 6).map(line => {
                        const cols = line.split(';');
                        return {
                            code: cols[codeIdx],
                            lat: cols[latIdx],
                            lng: cols[lngIdx]
                        };
                    });
                    setPreviewData({
                        total: lines.length - 1,
                        rows: previews
                    });
                }
            }
        };
        reader.readAsText(file);
    };

    const submitImport = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', importFile);
        router.post('/admin/lokasi-import', formData, {
            forceFormData: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                setImportFile(null);
                setPreviewData(null);
            }
        });
    };

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Master Lokasi">
            <Head title="Koordinat Lokasi" />
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-corporate-dark">Koordinat Lokasi</h1>
            </div>

            {flash?.success && <div className="bg-green-100 p-4 rounded text-green-800">{flash.success}</div>}
            {flash?.warning && <div className="bg-orange-100 p-4 rounded text-orange-800">{flash.warning}</div>}
            {pageErrors.file && <div className="bg-red-100 p-4 rounded text-red-800">{pageErrors.file}</div>}

            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow border border-gray-100">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Impor CSV Koordinat</h2>
                <form onSubmit={submitImport} className="space-y-4">
                    <div className="flex gap-4 items-center">
                        <input type="file" accept=".csv,.txt" onChange={handleFileChange} className="border p-2 rounded" />
                        <button type="submit" disabled={!importFile} className="bg-corporate-light text-white px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-corporate-dark disabled:opacity-50">
                            Konfirmasi Impor
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    {previewData && (
                        <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded text-sm border">
                            <p className="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">Preview (Menampilkan hingga 5 baris pertama dari total {previewData.total} baris):</p>
                            <table className="w-full text-left">
                                <thead>
                                    <tr className="border-b"><th className="pb-1">Code</th><th className="pb-1">Latitude</th><th className="pb-1">Longitude</th></tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody>
                                    {previewData.rows.map((r, i) => (
                                        <tr key={i} className="border-b last:border-0"><td className="py-1">{r.code}</td><td>{r.lat}</td><td>{r.lng}</td></tr>
                                    ))}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </form>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">Format: code;latitude;longitude</p>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow border border-gray-100 overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left">
                    <thead>
                        <tr className="border-b">
                            <th className="p-2">Kode</th>
                            <th className="p-2">Nama</th>
                            <th className="p-2">Headcount</th>
                            <th className="p-2">Lat, Lng</th>
                            <th className="p-2">Status</th>
                            <th className="p-2">Aksi</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {locations.map(loc => (
                            <tr key={loc.id} className="border-b hover:bg-gray-50">
                                <td className="p-2">{loc.code}</td>
                                <td className="p-2">{loc.name}</td>
                                <td className="p-2">{loc.employees_count}</td>
                                <td className="p-2">{loc.latitude ? `${loc.latitude}, ${loc.longitude}` : '-'}</td>
                                <td className="p-2">
                                    {loc.latitude ? 
                                        <span className="text-white bg-green-600 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold">Ada</span> : 
                                        <span className="text-white bg-red-600 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold">Belum</span>}
                                </td>
                                <td className="p-2">
                                    <button onClick={() => openEdit(loc)} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">Edit</button>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        ))}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>

            {selectedLoc && (
                <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
                        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Edit Koordinat: {selectedLoc.name}</h2>
                        <form onSubmit={submitEdit} className="space-y-4">
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                                <div>
                                    <label className="block text-sm">Latitude (-11 s.d 6)</label>
                                    <input type="number" step="any" value={data.latitude} onChange={e => setData('latitude', e.target.value)} className="border p-2 w-full rounded" />
                                    {errors.latitude && <p className="text-red-600 text-sm">{errors.latitude}</p>}
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <label className="block text-sm">Longitude (95 s.d 141)</label>
                                    <input type="number" step="any" value={data.longitude} onChange={e => setData('longitude', e.target.value)} className="border p-2 w-full rounded" />
                                    {errors.longitude && <p className="text-red-600 text-sm">{errors.longitude}</p>}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <MiniMap 
                                lat={data.latitude} 
                                lng={data.longitude} 
                                onChange={(lat, lng) => setData({ latitude: lat.toFixed(6), longitude: lng.toFixed(6) })} 
                            />

                            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                                <button type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedLoc(null)} className="px-4 py-2 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded">Batal</button>
                                <button type="submit" disabled={processing} className="px-4 py-2 bg-corporate-light text-white rounded hover:bg-corporate-dark">Simpan</button>
                            </div>
                        </form>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

function CombinedSkeleton() {
    return (

            <div className="h-16 bg-blue-100 rounded-lg"></div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">

export default function Combined({ metrics }) {
    const { toggleFilter } = useCrossFilter();
    const { options } = useFilters();
    const hasData = metrics && metrics.banner;
    const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState('coverage');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState('desc');

    const handleSort = (key) => {
        if (sortKey === key) {
            setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSortKey(key);
            setSortOrder('desc'); // Default to desc when changing columns
        }
    };

    const companyRanking = hasData ? [...metrics.company_ranking].sort((a, b) => {
        let valA = a[sortKey];
        let valB = b[sortKey];
        
        if (typeof valA === 'string') valA = valA.toLowerCase();
        if (typeof valB === 'string') valB = valB.toLowerCase();
        
        if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        return 0;
    }) : [];

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Analisis Gabungan">
            <Head title="Analisis Gabungan" />

            <div className="mb-6">
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Analisis Gabungan</h1>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                    Korelasi antara demografi karyawan dan partisipasi pelatihan.
                </p>
            </div>

            <FilterBar />

            <Deferred data="metrics" fallback={<CombinedSkeleton />}>
                {hasData ? (
                    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500 mt-6">
                        
                        {/* Permanent Banner */}
                        <div className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex gap-3 shadow-sm">

                                    <span className="font-bold ml-1">{formatNumber(metrics.banner.unlinked_count)} baris ({metrics.banner.unlinked_pct}%)</span> dari total {formatNumber(metrics.banner.total_count)} baris pelatihan.
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                                    onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('job_level_code', entry.name)}

                                                <tr className="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
                                                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900">16+ jam</td>
                                                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-green-600 font-bold">{formatNumber(metrics.retirement_training['16_plus_jam'])}</td>
                                                </tr>
                                            </tbody>
                                        </table>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 4: Scatter */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Korelasi Masa Kerja vs Total Jam Pelatihan" height="h-96">
                                <ScatterChart data={metrics.scatter} xKey="masa_kerja" yKey="jam_pelatihan" zKey="none" xLabel="Masa Kerja" yLabel="Total Jam Pelatihan" />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 5: Company Ranking */}
                        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
                            <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-800 mb-4">Peringkat Kinerja Perusahaan</h3>
                            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                <table className="w-full text-sm text-left">
                                    <thead className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase bg-gray-50/50 border-b border-gray-200">
                                        <tr>
                                            <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition" onClick={() => handleSort('name')}>
                                                Perusahaan {sortKey === 'name' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition" onClick={() => handleSort('hc')}>
                                                Total HC {sortKey === 'hc' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition" onClick={() => handleSort('avg_age')}>
                                                Rata Umur {sortKey === 'avg_age' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition" onClick={() => handleSort('coverage')}>
                                                Coverage (%) {sortKey === 'coverage' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition" onClick={() => handleSort('avg_hours')}>
                                                Jam/Org {sortKey === 'avg_hours' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition" onClick={() => handleSort('risk_pct')}>
                                                Risiko Pensiun (%) {sortKey === 'risk_pct' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
                                            </th>
                                        </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                                        {companyRanking.map(row => (
                                            <tr key={row.name} className="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
                                                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900">{row.name}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">{formatNumber(row.hc)}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">{formatDecimal(row.avg_age)}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium text-blue-600">{formatDecimal(row.coverage)}%</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">{formatDecimal(row.avg_hours)}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">{formatDecimal(row.risk_pct)}%</td>
                                            </tr>
                                        ))}
                                        {companyRanking.length === 0 && (
                                            <tr>
                                                <td colSpan="6" className="text-center py-6 text-gray-500">Tidak ada data</td>
                                            </tr>
                                        )}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="bg-white p-12 text-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm mt-6">
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">Tidak Ada Data</h3>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Sesuaikan filter Anda untuk melihat data.</p>
                    </div>
                )}
            </Deferred>
        </AppLayout>
    );
}
