import AppLayout from '../Layouts/AppLayout';
import { Head, Deferred } from '@inertiajs/react';
import FilterBar from '@/Components/ui/FilterBar';
import { KpiCard } from '@/Components/ui/KpiCard';
import { ChartCard } from '@/Components/ui/ChartCard';
import { DonutChart } from '@/Components/charts/DonutChart';
import { StackedBar } from '@/Components/charts/StackedBar';
import { HorizontalBar } from '@/Components/charts/HorizontalBar';
import { LineTrend } from '@/Components/charts/LineTrend';
import { RegionalMapWidget } from '@/Components/charts/RegionalMapWidget';
import { generationColors } from '@/lib/colors';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { levelLabels } from '@/lib/constants';
import { UserPlus, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCopyAsImage } from '@/hooks/useCopyAsImage';
import { CopyButton } from '@/Components/ui/CopyButton';
import { useCrossFilter } from '@/hooks/useCrossFilter';
import { useFilters } from '@/hooks/useFilters';

export default function Dashboard({ metrics, insight }) {
    
    const { toggleFilter } = useCrossFilter();
    const { options } = useFilters();
    
    // Transform metrics for charts
    const hasData = metrics && metrics.total_hc > 0;
    
    const genData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.generations).map(([name, value]) => ({
        name, value, fill: generationColors[name] || '#ccc'
    })) : [];

    const stackedKeys = ['Boomers', 'Gen X', 'Gen Y', 'Gen Z'];
    const levelOrder = hasData && metrics.level_order ? metrics.level_order : [];

    const stackedData = hasData ? levelOrder.map(level => {
        const gens = metrics.generations_by_level?.[level] || {};
        return {
            name: levelLabels[level] ? `${level} - ${levelLabels[level]}` : level,
            ...gens
        };
    }) : [];

    const regionData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.hc_by_region)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];

    const companyData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.hc_by_company)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
        .slice(0, 10) : [];
        
    const facilityData = hasData ? [
        { name: 'Estate', value: Object.values(metrics.hc_by_region_facility || {}).reduce((s, r) => s + (r.Estate || 0), 0), fill: '#111827' },
        { name: 'Mill', value: Object.values(metrics.hc_by_region_facility || {}).reduce((s, r) => s + (r.Mill || 0), 0), fill: '#22c55e' },
        { name: 'HO', value: Object.values(metrics.hc_by_region_facility || {}).reduce((s, r) => s + (r.HO || 0), 0), fill: '#f59e0b' },
    ] : [];
        
    const trainingTrendData = hasData && metrics.training?.trend ? Object.entries(metrics.training.trend).map(([my, val]) => ({
        name: my, value: val
    })) : [];

    const retireRiskData = hasData ? levelOrder.map(level => {
        const pensiun = metrics.retire_risk_by_level?.[level] || 0;
        const total = metrics.hc_by_level?.[level] || 0;
        const pct = total > 0 ? (pensiun / total) * 100 : 0;
        return {
            name: levelLabels[level] ? `${level} - ${levelLabels[level]}` : level,
            value: pensiun,
            pct: pct,
            total: total
        };
    }).filter(row => row.total > 0).sort((a, b) => b.pct - a.pct) : [];

    const { ref: sectionRef, isCopying, status, handleCopy } = useCopyAsImage({ title: 'Distribusi Tenaga Kerja per Operasional' });
    const { ref: retireRef, isCopying: retireCopying, status: retireStatus, handleCopy: handleRetireCopy } = useCopyAsImage({ 
        title: 'Risiko Pensiun per Level Jabatan',
        onBeforeCapture: (el) => {
            const scroller = el.querySelector('.overflow-x-auto');
            if(scroller) scroller.style.overflow = 'visible';
        },
        onAfterCapture: (el) => {
            const scroller = el.querySelector('.overflow-x-auto');
            if(scroller) scroller.style.overflow = '';
        }
    });

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Dashboard">
            <Head title="Dashboard" />
            
            <FilterBar />

            <Deferred data="metrics" fallback={<DashboardSkeleton />}>
                {hasData ? (
                    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
                        {/* KPI Grid */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                            <KpiCard title="Total Karyawan" value={metrics.total_hc} highlight={true} />
                            <KpiCard title="Rata-rata Umur" value={metrics.avg_age} isDecimal={true} unit="Tahun" />
                            <KpiCard title="Rata-rata Masa Kerja" value={metrics.avg_los} isDecimal={true} unit="Tahun" />
                            <KpiCard title="Risiko Pensiun" value={metrics.pensiun} note="Usia >= 55 tahun" />
                            
                            <KpiCard title="Karyawan Baru Belum Dilatih (<1 Tahun)" value={metrics.new_hire_no_training || 0} note="Perlu onboarding pelatihan" icon={UserPlus} />
                            <KpiCard title="Karyawan Baru Masuk Tahun Ini" value={metrics.new_hire_this_year || 0} note={`Sejak Januari ${new Date().getFullYear()}`} icon={UserCheck} />
                            <KpiCard title="Total Jam Pelatihan" value={metrics.training?.total_hours || 0} isDecimal={true} unit="Jam" secondaryText={`Unlinked: ${metrics.training?.unlinked_rows || 0}`} />
                            <KpiCard title="Training Coverage" value={metrics.training?.coverage_pct || 0} isDecimal={true} unit="%" />
                        </div>

                        {/* Insight Builder Card */}
                        <Deferred data="insight" fallback={<div className="h-16 bg-gray-50 rounded animate-pulse"></div>}>
                            <InsightCard insight={insight} />
                        </Deferred>

                        {/* Charts Grid */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Komposisi Generasi" loading={!metrics}>
                                <DonutChart data={genData} dataKey="value" onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('generation', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>

                            <ChartCard title="Generasi per Level Jabatan" loading={!metrics} className="lg:col-span-2">
                                <StackedBar data={stackedData} keys={stackedKeys} xAxisKey="name" onClick={(key) => toggleFilter('generation', key)} />
                            </ChartCard>

                            <div ref={sectionRef} className="lg:col-span-3 bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)] border-0 flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-6 relative transition-all duration-300 [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(6,78,59,0.12)] [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:-translate-y-1">
                                <CopyButton handleCopy={handleCopy} status={status} isCopying={isCopying} />
                                <div className="flex-1">
                                    <div className="mb-4">
                                        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">Distribusi Tenaga Kerja per Operasional</h3>
                                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Estate, Mill dan Head Office</p>
                                    </div>
                                    {hasData && <RegionalMapWidget data={metrics.hc_by_region_facility} total={metrics.total_hc} />}
                                </div>
                                <div className="w-full lg:w-72 shrink-0 border-t lg:border-t-0 lg:border-l border-gray-100 pt-6 lg:pt-0 lg:pl-6 flex flex-col">
                                    <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Total per Operasional</h3>
                                    <div className="flex-1 min-h-[250px]">
                                        {hasData && <DonutChart data={facilityData} dataKey="value" />}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 text-xs">
                                        {facilityData.map(item => (
                                            <div key={item.name} className="flex justify-between items-center">
                                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                                    <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: item.fill }}></div>
                                                    <span className="text-gray-700">{item.name}</span>
                                                </div>
                                                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                                    <span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{formatNumber(item.value)}</span>
                                                    <span className="text-gray-400 w-8 text-right">{metrics.total_hc ? Math.round((item.value/metrics.total_hc)*100) : 0}%</span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        ))}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <ChartCard title="Top 10 Perusahaan (HC)" loading={!metrics}>
                                <HorizontalBar 
                                    data={companyData} 
                                    dataKey="value" 
                                    yAxisKey="name" 
                                    onClick={(entry) => {
                                        const comp = options?.companies?.find(c => c.name === entry.name || c.code === entry.name);
                                        if (comp) toggleFilter('company_id', String(comp.id));
                                        else toggleFilter('company_id', entry.name);
                                    }} 
                                />
                            </ChartCard>

                            <ChartCard title="Tren Jam Pelatihan" loading={!metrics}>
                                <LineTrend data={trainingTrendData} lines={[{ dataKey: 'value', name: 'Jam', stroke: '#10B981' }]} xAxisKey="name" />
                            </ChartCard>
                            
                            {/* Table Risiko Pensiun */}
                            <div ref={retireRef} className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)] border-0 lg:col-span-3 relative transition-all duration-300 [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(6,78,59,0.12)] [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:-translate-y-1">
                                <CopyButton handleCopy={handleRetireCopy} status={retireStatus} isCopying={retireCopying} />
                                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-800 pb-3 mb-4 pr-12 border-b border-gray-100/60">Risiko Pensiun per Level Jabatan</h3>
                                {retireRiskData.length > 0 ? (
                                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                        <table className="w-full text-sm text-left">
                                            <thead className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 font-medium">
                                                <tr>
                                                    <th className="px-4 py-3 rounded-l-lg">Level Jabatan</th>
                                                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Total HC</th>
                                                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Risiko Pensiun</th>
                                                    <th className="px-4 py-3 rounded-r-lg text-right">% Risiko</th>
                                                </tr>
                                            </thead>
                                            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                                                {retireRiskData.map(row => {
                                                    let badgeClass = "bg-gray-200 text-gray-800";
                                                    if (row.pct > 15) badgeClass = "bg-red-600 text-white";
                                                    else if (row.pct >= 5) badgeClass = "bg-amber-500 text-white";
                                                    else if (row.pct > 0) badgeClass = "bg-green-600 text-white";

                                                    return (
                                                        <tr key={row.name} className="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
                                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-800 font-medium">{row.name}</td>
                                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600">{formatNumber(row.total)}</td>
                                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600">{formatNumber(row.value)}</td>
                                                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                                                <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold ${badgeClass}`}>
                                                                    {row.pct.toFixed(1)}%
                                                                </span>
                                                            </td>
                                                        </tr>
                                                    );
                                                })}
                                            </tbody>
                                        </table>
                                    </div>
                                ) : (
                                    <div className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">Tidak ada risiko pensiun di filter ini.</div>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="bg-white p-12 text-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm mt-6">
                        <div className="text-gray-400 mb-2">
                            <svg className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M20 13V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v7m16 0v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5m16 0h-2.586a1 1 0 00-.707.293l-2.414 2.414a1 1 0 01-.707.293h-3.172a1 1 0 01-.707-.293l-2.414-2.414A1 1 0 006.586 13H4" />
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">Tidak Ada Data</h3>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Sesuaikan filter Anda untuk melihat data.</p>
                    </div>
                )}
            </Deferred>
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

function roundPct(val, total) {
    if (!total) return 0;
    return (val / total) * 100;
}

function InsightCard({ insight }) {
    if (!insight) return null;
    return (
        <div className="relative overflow-hidden text-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-md flex gap-4 items-start bg-corporate-dark">
            {/* Background Image */}
            <div 
                className="absolute inset-0 bg-cover bg-center mix-blend-overlay opacity-40"
                style={{ backgroundImage: `url('/PALM%20TREE_Panorama1.png')` }}
            />
            {/* Gradient Overlay for readability */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-corporate-dark/90 to-corporate/40" />
            
            <div className="p-3 bg-white/20 rounded-full shrink-0 relative z-10 backdrop-blur-sm">
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z" />
                </svg>
            </div>
            <div className="relative z-10">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-1 opacity-100 drop-shadow-md">Key Insight</h3>
                <p className="text-sm opacity-100 leading-relaxed font-medium drop-shadow-md">{insight}</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function DashboardSkeleton() {
    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                {[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8].map(i => <div key={i} className="h-28 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />)}
            </div>
            <div className="h-24 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl lg:col-span-2" />
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
                <div className="h-80 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import AppLayout from '../Layouts/AppLayout';
import { Head, Deferred } from '@inertiajs/react';
import FilterBar from '@/Components/ui/FilterBar';
import { ChartCard } from '@/Components/ui/ChartCard';
import { HorizontalBar } from '@/Components/charts/HorizontalBar';
import { Treemap } from '@/Components/charts/Treemap';
import { Histogram } from '@/Components/charts/Histogram';
import { PopulationPyramid } from '@/Components/charts/PopulationPyramid';
import { Heatmap } from '@/Components/charts/Heatmap';
import { StackedBar } from '@/Components/charts/StackedBar';
import { DonutChart } from '@/Components/charts/DonutChart';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';
import { useCopyAsImage } from '@/hooks/useCopyAsImage';
import { CopyButton } from '@/Components/ui/CopyButton';
import { useCrossFilter } from '@/hooks/useCrossFilter';

export default function Demographics({ metrics }) {
    const { toggleFilter } = useCrossFilter();
    const hasData = metrics && metrics.total_hc > 0;
    
    // Derived datasets
    const groupData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.hc_by_group)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];
        
    const regionData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.hc_by_region)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];

    const deptData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.hc_by_dept)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];
        
    // Treemap structure: root with children
    const deptTreemapData = hasData ? [{
        name: 'Departments',
        children: deptData
    }] : [];

    // Histogram data (Age)
    const ageBins = ['<25', '25-29', '30-34', '35-39', '40-44', '45-49', '50-54', '55+'];
    const ageDistData = hasData ? ageBins.map(bin => ({
        name: bin,
        value: metrics.age_distribution[bin] || 0
    })) : [];

    // Population Pyramid (Age x Gender)
    const popPyramidData = hasData ? ageBins.map(bin => ({
        name: bin,
        Male: (metrics.population_pyramid[bin]?.Male || 0) * -1, // Negative for left side
        Female: metrics.population_pyramid[bin]?.Female || 0
    })) : [];

    // Heatmap (Gen x Region)
    const regionNames = hasData ? Object.keys(metrics.hc_by_region).sort() : [];
    const genNames = ['Boomers', 'Gen X', 'Gen Y', 'Gen Z'];
    const heatmapData = hasData ? regionNames.flatMap(region => 
        genNames.map(gen => ({
            y: region,
            x: gen,
            value: metrics.gen_by_region[region]?.[gen] || 0
        }))
    ) : [];

    // Avg Age by Dept
    const avgAgeDeptData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.avg_age_by_dept)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .slice(0, 15) : [];

    // HC per level
    const levelOrder = hasData && metrics.level_order ? metrics.level_order : [];
    const levelData = hasData ? levelOrder.map(lvl => ({
        name: lvl,
        value: metrics.hc_by_level[lvl] || 0
    })).filter(d => d.value > 0) : [];

    // Gender by Level (Stacked)
    const genderLevelData = hasData ? levelOrder.map(lvl => ({
        name: lvl,
        Male: metrics.gender_by_level[lvl]?.Male || 0,
        Female: metrics.gender_by_level[lvl]?.Female || 0
    })).filter(d => d.Male > 0 || d.Female > 0) : [];

    // Gender Donut
    const genderData = hasData ? [
        { name: 'Laki-laki', value: Object.values(metrics.gender_by_level).reduce((sum, g) => sum + (g.Male || 0), 0), fill: '#3B82F6' },
        { name: 'Perempuan', value: Object.values(metrics.gender_by_level).reduce((sum, g) => sum + (g.Female || 0), 0), fill: '#EC4899' }
    ] : [];

    // Marital Status
    const maritalData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.marital_status)
        .map(([name, value], i) => ({ name, value, fill: defaultPalette[i % defaultPalette.length] }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];

    // PTKP
    const ptkpData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.ptkp)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value) : [];

    // Job Titles (Top 10)
    const topJobTitles = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.job_titles)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
        .slice(0, 10) : [];

    // Birth Places (Top 10)
    const topBirthPlaces = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.birth_places)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
        .slice(0, 10) : [];

    // Employment by Region (Stacked)
    const empTypes = hasData ? [...new Set(Object.values(metrics.employment_by_region).flatMap(Object.keys))] : [];
    const empRegionData = hasData ? regionNames.map(region => {
        const row = { name: region };
        empTypes.forEach(type => {
            row[type] = metrics.employment_by_region[region]?.[type] || 0;
        });
        return row;
    }) : [];

    const { ref: top10Ref, isCopying: top10Copying, status: top10Status, handleCopy: handleTop10Copy } = useCopyAsImage({ 
        title: 'Top 10 Jabatan (HC)',
        onBeforeCapture: (el) => {
            el.style.height = 'max-content';
            const scroller = el.querySelector('.overflow-y-auto');
            if(scroller) scroller.style.overflow = 'visible';
        },
        onAfterCapture: (el) => {
            el.style.height = '';
            const scroller = el.querySelector('.overflow-y-auto');
            if(scroller) scroller.style.overflow = '';
        }
    });

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Demografi & Headcount">
            <Head title="Demografi & Headcount" />
            <FilterBar />

            <Deferred data="metrics" fallback={<DemographicsSkeleton />}>
                {hasData ? (
                    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
                        {/* Section 1: HC Overview */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="HC per Region">
                                <HorizontalBar data={regionData} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('region', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="HC per Group">
                                <HorizontalBar data={groupData} color={defaultPalette[1]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('group', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="HC per Departemen (Treemap)" className="h-96">
                                <Treemap data={deptTreemapData} dataKey="value" nameKey="name" />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 2: Age & Gender */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Distribusi Umur (Histogram)" className="lg:col-span-1">
                                <Histogram data={ageDistData} xAxisKey="name" dataKey="value" />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Piramida Umur × Gender" className="lg:col-span-2">
                                <PopulationPyramid data={popPyramidData} yAxisKey="name" leftKey="Male" rightKey="Female" />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 3: Generations & Dept Age */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Generasi × Region (Heatmap)">
                                <Heatmap data={heatmapData} xLabels={genNames} yLabels={regionNames} />

                                <DonutChart data={genderData} colors={{ 'Laki-laki': '#3B82F6', 'Perempuan': '#EC4899' }} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('gender', entry.name)} />

                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 6: Top Titles, Employment, Birth Place */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <div ref={top10Ref} className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)] border-0 flex flex-col h-80 relative transition-all duration-300 [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(6,78,59,0.12)] [@media(hover:hover)]:hover:-translate-y-1">
                                <CopyButton handleCopy={handleTop10Copy} status={top10Status} isCopying={top10Copying} />
                                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-800 pb-3 mb-4 pr-12 border-b border-gray-100/60">Top 10 Jabatan (HC)</h3>
                                <div className="space-y-3 overflow-y-auto pr-2">
                                    {topJobTitles.map((jt, idx) => (
                                        <div key={idx} className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm border-b pb-2 last:border-0">
                                            <span className="text-gray-700 truncate mr-2">{jt.name}</span>
                                            <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 bg-gray-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">{formatNumber(jt.value)}</span>
                                        </div>
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <ChartCard title="Status Karyawan per Region">
                                <StackedBar data={empRegionData} keys={empTypes} xAxisKey="name" onClick={(key) => toggleFilter('employment_type', key)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            
                            <ChartCard title="Top 10 Tempat Lahir">
                                <HorizontalBar data={topBirthPlaces} color={defaultPalette[5]} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>
                        
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="bg-white p-12 text-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm mt-6">
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">Tidak Ada Data</h3>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Sesuaikan filter Anda untuk melihat data.</p>
                    </div>
                )}
            </Deferred>
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout';
import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import FilterBar from '@/Components/ui/FilterBar';
import { Search, Download, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { StaffDetailModal } from '@/Components/Map/StaffDetailModal';
import { formatDecimal } from '@/lib/format';

export default function EmployeeIndex({ employees, filters }) {
    const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(filters.search || '');
    const [selectedEmployeeId, setSelectedEmployeeId] = useState(null);

    const handleSearch = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        router.get(
            '/karyawan',
            { ...filters, search: searchTerm, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const handleSort = (column) => {
        const currentSort = filters.sort || 'name';
        const currentOrder = filters.order || 'asc';
        
        let newOrder = 'asc';
        if (currentSort === column) {
            newOrder = currentOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        }

        router.get(
            '/karyawan',
            { ...filters, sort: column, order: newOrder, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const handlePerPageChange = (e) => {
        router.get(
            '/karyawan',
            { ...filters, per_page: e.target.value, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const SortIcon = ({ column }) => {
        const currentSort = filters.sort || 'name';
        const currentOrder = filters.order || 'asc';
        
        if (currentSort !== column) {
            return <span className="text-gray-300 ml-1">↕</span>;
        }
        
        return currentOrder === 'asc' ? 
            <ChevronUp className="inline w-4 h-4 ml-1 text-blue-600" /> : 
            <ChevronDown className="inline w-4 h-4 ml-1 text-blue-600" />;
    };

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Direktori Karyawan">
            <Head title="Direktori Karyawan" />

            <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-6">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Direktori Karyawan</h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                        Daftar lengkap data karyawan perusahaan ({employees.total} total).
                    </p>
                </div>
                
                <a 
                    href={`/karyawan/export?${new URLSearchParams(filters).toString()}`}
                    className="flex items-center px-4 py-2 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 transition-colors font-medium text-sm shadow-sm"
                >
                    <Download className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Export Excel
                </a>
            </div>

            <FilterBar />

            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
                <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50/50">
                    <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="flex relative w-72">
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="Cari nama, NIK, atau jabatan..."
                            value={searchTerm}
                            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 text-sm"
                        />
                        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 absolute left-3 top-3" />
                        <button type="submit" className="hidden">Search</button>
                    </form>
                    
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
                        <span>Tampilkan:</span>
                        <select 
                            value={filters.per_page || 25} 
                            onChange={handlePerPageChange}
                            className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 text-sm bg-white"
                        >
                            <option value="25">25</option>
                            <option value="50">50</option>
                            <option value="100">100</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full text-sm text-left">
                        <thead className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase bg-gray-50/80 border-b border-gray-100">
                            <tr>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('employee_id')}>
                                    NIK <SortIcon column="employee_id" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('name')}>
                                    Nama Karyawan <SortIcon column="name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('company_name')}>
                                    Perusahaan <SortIcon column="company_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('location_name')}>
                                    Lokasi <SortIcon column="location_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('organization_name')}>
                                    Departemen <SortIcon column="organization_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('job_title_name')}>
                                    Jabatan <SortIcon column="job_title_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('job_level_code')}>
                                    Level <SortIcon column="job_level_code" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('generasi')}>
                                    Generasi <SortIcon column="generasi" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right" onClick={() => handleSort('umur')}>
                                    Umur <SortIcon column="umur" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap text-right" onClick={() => handleSort('masa_kerja')}>
                                    Masa Kerja <SortIcon column="masa_kerja" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('employment_type')}>
                                    Status <SortIcon column="employment_type" />
                                </th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                            {employees.data.length > 0 ? (
                                employees.data.map((emp) => (
                                    <tr 
                                        key={emp.id} 
                                        onClick={() => setSelectedEmployeeId(emp.employee_id)}
                                        className="hover:bg-blue-50/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                    >
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900 whitespace-nowrap">{emp.employee_id}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{emp.name}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{emp.company_name}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{emp.location_name}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{emp.department}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{emp.job_title}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-center">
                                            <span className="bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded-full">{emp.level}</span>
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-center">{emp.generasi}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-right">{formatDecimal(emp.umur)}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-right">{formatDecimal(emp.masa_kerja)}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-center">
                                            <span className={`text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-white ${emp.employment_type === 'Permanent' ? 'bg-green-600' : 'bg-amber-500'}`}>
                                                {emp.employment_type}
                                            </span>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                ))
                            ) : (
                                <tr>
                                    <td colSpan="11" className="px-4 py-12 text-center text-gray-500">
                                        Tidak ada data karyawan yang ditemukan dengan filter saat ini.
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            )}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
                
                {/* Pagination */}
                {employees.total > 0 && (
                    <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between bg-white">
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                            Menampilkan <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{employees.from}</span> - <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{employees.to}</span> dari <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{employees.total}</span> karyawan
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            {employees.links.map((link, i) => {
                                let label = link.label;
                                if (String(link.label).toLowerCase().includes('previous')) {
                                    label = <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />;
                                } else if (String(link.label).toLowerCase().includes('next')) {
                                    label = <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />;
                                }
                                
                                return link.url ? (
                                    <Link
                                        key={i}
                                        href={link.url}
                                        preserveScroll
                                        preserveState
                                        className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
                                            link.active 
                                                ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' 
                                                : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
                                        }`}
                                    >
                                        {label}
                                    </Link>
                                ) : (
                                    <span key={i} className="px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-300">
                                        {label}
                                    </span>
                                );
                            })}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>

            {selectedEmployeeId && (
                <StaffDetailModal 
                    employeeId={selectedEmployeeId} 
                    onClose={() => setSelectedEmployeeId(null)} 
                />
            )}
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Head } from '@inertiajs/react';
import axios from 'axios';
import { SdmMap } from '@/Components/Map/SdmMap';
import { CompanyPanel } from '@/Components/Map/CompanyPanel';
import { CompanyList } from '@/Components/Map/CompanyList';
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout';

export default function MapIndex() {
    const [locations, setLocations] = useState([]);
    const [companies, setCompanies] = useState([]);
    const [selectedCompanyId, setSelectedCompanyId] = useState(null);
    const [selectedLocationId, setSelectedLocationId] = useState(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [totalLocations, setTotalLocations] = useState(0);
    
    useEffect(() => {
        Promise.all([
            axios.get('/data/map/locations'),
            axios.get('/data/companies')
        ]).then(([locRes, compRes]) => {
            setLocations(locRes.data);
            setCompanies(compRes.data.data);
            setTotalLocations(compRes.data.total_locations);
            setLoading(false);
        });
    }, []);

    const selectedCompany = selectedCompanyId ? companies.find(c => c.id === selectedCompanyId) : null;
    const selectedLocation = selectedLocationId ? locations.find(l => l.id === selectedLocationId) : null;

    const noCoordCount = locations.filter(l => !l.latitude || !l.longitude).length;

    return (
        <AppLayout fullHeight={true} title="Peta Perusahaan">
            <Head title="Peta Perusahaan" />
            <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row h-full w-full bg-app-bg overflow-hidden relative">
                
                <div className="flex-1 relative z-0 h-full">
                    <SdmMap 
                        locations={locations} 
                        selectedCompanyId={selectedCompanyId}
                        selectedLocationId={selectedLocationId}
                        onSelectLocation={(locId, singleCompanyId) => {
                            setSelectedLocationId(locId);
                            if (singleCompanyId) setSelectedCompanyId(singleCompanyId);
                        }}
                    />
                    
                    {noCoordCount > 0 && (
                        <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 bg-orange-100 border border-orange-300 text-orange-800 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm z-[1000]">
                            <p className="text-sm font-medium">{noCoordCount} lokasi belum punya koordinat</p>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="w-full lg:w-[420px] bg-panel-bg shadow-[-4px_0_15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] z-10 flex flex-col h-full transition-transform duration-300">
                    {selectedCompany ? (
                        <CompanyPanel 
                            company={selectedCompany} 
                            location={selectedLocation}
                            onBack={() => {
                                setSelectedCompanyId(null);
                                setSelectedLocationId(null);
                            }} 
                            onLocationSelect={setSelectedLocationId}
                        />
                    ) : (
                        <CompanyList 
                            companies={companies} 
                            locations={locations}
                            totalLocations={totalLocations}
                            selectedLocation={selectedLocation}
                            onSelectCompany={setSelectedCompanyId}
                        />
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { KeyRound } from 'lucide-react';

export default function UpdatePasswordForm({ className = '' }) {
    const passwordInput = useRef();
    const currentPasswordInput = useRef();

    const { data, setData, errors, put, reset, processing, recentlySuccessful } = useForm({
        current_password: '',
        password: '',
        password_confirmation: '',
    });

    const updatePassword = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();

        put('/pengaturan/password', {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => reset(),
            onError: (errors) => {
                if (errors.password) {
                    reset('password', 'password_confirmation');
                    passwordInput.current.focus();
                }

                if (errors.current_password) {
                    reset('current_password');
                    currentPasswordInput.current.focus();
                }
            },
        });
    };

    return (
        <section className={className}>
            <header>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">Ubah Password</h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-600">
                    Pastikan akun Anda menggunakan password yang panjang (minimal 12 karakter) dan acak agar tetap aman.
                </p>
            </header>

            <form onSubmit={updatePassword} className="mt-6 space-y-6 max-w-xl">
                <div>
                    <label htmlFor="current_password" className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">Password Saat Ini</label>
                    <input
                        id="current_password"
                        ref={currentPasswordInput}
                        value={data.current_password}
                        onChange={(e) => setData('current_password', e.target.value)}
                        type="password"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none transition-all"
                        autoComplete="current-password"
                    />
                    {errors.current_password && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-2">{errors.current_password}</p>}
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">Password Baru (Min. 12 karakter)</label>
                    <input
                        id="password"
                        ref={passwordInput}
                        value={data.password}
                        onChange={(e) => setData('password', e.target.value)}
                        type="password"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none transition-all"
                        autoComplete="new-password"
                    />
                    {errors.password && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-2">{errors.password}</p>}
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label htmlFor="password_confirmation" className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">Konfirmasi Password Baru</label>
                    <input
                        id="password_confirmation"
                        value={data.password_confirmation}
                        onChange={(e) => setData('password_confirmation', e.target.value)}
                        type="password"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light focus:border-corporate-light outline-none transition-all"
                        autoComplete="new-password"
                    />

function RetirementSkeleton() {
    return (
        <div className="space-y-6 animate-pulse">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                {[1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => <div key={i} className="h-24 bg-gray-200 rounded-xl"></div>)}

function HeatCell({ pct }) {
    // Heat colors: Green < 10, Yellow 10-25, Orange 25-50, Red > 50
    let bg = 'bg-gray-100';
    let text = 'text-gray-800';
    
    if (pct > 50) {
        bg = 'bg-red-600'; text = 'text-white';
    } else if (pct > 25) {
        bg = 'bg-orange-500'; text = 'text-white';
    } else if (pct > 10) {
        bg = 'bg-amber-500'; text = 'text-white';
    } else if (pct > 0) {
        bg = 'bg-green-600'; text = 'text-white';
    }

    return (
        <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold ${bg} ${text}`}>
            {pct}%
        </span>
    );
}

export default function Tenure({ metrics }) {
    const { toggleFilter } = useCrossFilter();
    const hasData = metrics && metrics.histogram && Object.keys(metrics.histogram).length > 0;
    const [trendType, setTrendType] = useState('yearly');

    const histogramData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.histogram).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value })) : [];
    
    const trendData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.trend[trendType]).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value })) : [];
    
    const avgLevelData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.average.level).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value })) : [];
    
    const avgRegionData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.average.region).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value })) : [];
    
    const regionNames = hasData ? Array.from(new Set(
        Object.values(metrics.heatmap).flatMap(r => Object.keys(r))
    )).sort() : [];
    
    const yearNames = hasData ? Object.keys(metrics.heatmap).sort() : [];

    const heatmapData = hasData ? yearNames.flatMap(year => 
        regionNames.map(region => ({
            x: year,
            y: region,
            value: metrics.heatmap[year]?.[region] || 0
        }))
    ) : [];

    const scatterData = hasData ? metrics.scatter : [];
    const wavesData = hasData ? metrics.waves : [];

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Masa Kerja & Rekrutmen">
            <Head title="Masa Kerja & Rekrutmen" />

            <div className="mb-6">
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Masa Kerja & Rekrutmen</h1>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                    Distribusi masa bakti, pola rekrutmen, dan anomali umur bergabung.
                </p>
                <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100 rounded-lg text-blue-800 text-sm flex items-center shadow-sm">
                    <span className="mr-2">ℹ️</span>
                    Turnover/resign belum dapat dianalisis karena data resign belum tersedia.
                </div>
            </div>

            <FilterBar />

            <Deferred data="metrics" fallback={<TenureSkeleton />}>
                {hasData ? (
                    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500 mt-6">
                        
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Distribusi Masa Kerja">
                                <Histogram data={histogramData} xAxisKey="name" dataKey="value" color={defaultPalette[0]} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            
                            <ChartCard 
                                title={
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full">
                                        <span>Tren Rekrutmen Masuk</span>
                                        <select 
                                            value={trendType} 
                                            onChange={(e) => setTrendType(e.target.value)}
                                            className="text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md py-1 pl-2 pr-8"
                                        >
                                            <option value="yearly">Per Tahun (Semua)</option>
                                            <option value="monthly">Per Bulan (3 Tahun Terakhir)</option>
                                        </select>
                                    </div>
                                }
                            >
                                <LineTrend data={trendData} xAxisKey="name" keys={['value']} colors={{ value: defaultPalette[1] }} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Rata-rata Masa Kerja per Region (Tahun)">
                                <HorizontalBar data={avgRegionData} color={defaultPalette[2]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('region', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Rata-rata Masa Kerja per Level (Tahun)">
                                <HorizontalBar data={avgLevelData} color={defaultPalette[3]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('job_level_code', entry.name)} />

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import AppLayout from '../Layouts/AppLayout';
import { Head, Deferred } from '@inertiajs/react';
import FilterBar from '@/Components/ui/FilterBar';
import { ChartCard } from '@/Components/ui/ChartCard';
import { HorizontalBar } from '@/Components/charts/HorizontalBar';
import { LineTrend } from '@/Components/charts/LineTrend';
import { DonutChart } from '@/Components/charts/DonutChart';
import { StackedBar } from '@/Components/charts/StackedBar';
import { formatNumber } from '@/lib/format';
import { defaultPalette } from '@/lib/colors';
import { Search, ChevronDown, ChevronUp } from 'lucide-react';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useCrossFilter } from '@/hooks/useCrossFilter';

export default function Training({ metrics, filters }) {
    const { toggleFilter } = useCrossFilter();
    const hasData = metrics && metrics.kpi && metrics.kpi.total_rows > 0;
    
    // KPI Data
    const kpi = metrics?.kpi || {};
    
    // Line Trend
    const trendData = hasData ? Object.keys(metrics.trend.hours).map(my => ({
        name: my,
        hours: metrics.trend.hours[my] || 0,
        participants: metrics.trend.participants[my] || 0
    })) : [];

    // Donuts
    const regularityData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.donuts.regularity).map(([name, value], i) => ({
        name, value, fill: defaultPalette[i % defaultPalette.length]
    })) : [];
    
    const sourceData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.donuts.source_type).map(([name, value], i) => ({
        name, value, fill: defaultPalette[i % defaultPalette.length]
    })) : [];

    // Tops
    const topTrainings = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.top.training_names)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value).slice(0, 10) : [];
        
    const topInstructors = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.top.instructors)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value).slice(0, 10) : [];
        
    const topLocations = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.top.locations)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value).slice(0, 10) : [];

    // Hours By
    const formatHoursData = (obj) => Object.entries(obj)
        .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

    const hoursRegion = hasData ? formatHoursData(metrics.hours_by.region) : [];
    const hoursGroup = hasData ? formatHoursData(metrics.hours_by.group) : [];
    const hoursDept = hasData ? formatHoursData(metrics.hours_by.dept).slice(0, 15) : [];
    const hoursGol = hasData ? formatHoursData(metrics.hours_by.gol) : [];
    const hoursLevel = hasData ? formatHoursData(metrics.hours_by.level) : [];
    
    const genderLevelData = hasData ? Object.entries(metrics.gender_by_level).map(([name, genders]) => ({
        name, Male: genders.Male || 0, Female: genders.Female || 0
    })) : [];

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Pelatihan">
            <Head title="Pelatihan" />
            <FilterBar />

            <Deferred data="metrics" fallback={<TrainingSkeleton />}>
                {hasData ? (
                    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
                        
                        {/* Data Quality Warning */}
                        {kpi.unlinked_rows > 0 && (
                            <div className="bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 text-yellow-800 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm">
                                <div>
                                    <h4 className="font-bold">Kualitas Data Pelatihan</h4>
                                    <p className="text-sm opacity-90">Terdapat {formatNumber(kpi.unlinked_rows)} baris data pelatihan yang NIK-nya tidak ditemukan di data master karyawan (tidak dapat dihubungkan ke demografi).</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {/* KPIs */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
                            <KPICard title="Total Baris" value={kpi.total_rows} />
                            <KPICard title="Peserta Unik" value={kpi.unique_participants} />
                            <KPICard title="Total Jam" value={kpi.total_hours} format="decimal" />
                            <KPICard title="Jam / Peserta" value={kpi.avg_hours_per_participant} format="decimal" />
                            <KPICard title="Total Hari" value={kpi.total_days} format="decimal" />
                            <KPICard title="Jenis Pelatihan" value={kpi.unique_trainings} />
                        </div>

                        {/* Trend */}
                        <ChartCard title="Tren Jam & Peserta Pelatihan" className="h-96">
                            <LineTrend data={trendData} xAxisKey="name" keys={['hours', 'participants']} colors={{ hours: defaultPalette[0], participants: defaultPalette[1] }} />
                        </ChartCard>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Reguler vs Non Reguler">
                                <DonutChart data={regularityData} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('is_regular', entry.name === 'Reguler' ? '1' : '0')} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Internal vs Eksternal">
                                <DonutChart data={sourceData} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('is_internal', entry.name === 'Internal' ? '1' : '0')} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Gender x Level (Peserta)">
                                <StackedBar data={genderLevelData} keys={['Male', 'Female']} xAxisKey="name" colors={{ Male: '#3B82F6', Female: '#EC4899' }} onClick={(key) => toggleFilter('gender', key === 'Male' ? 'Laki-laki' : 'Perempuan')} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>

                        {/* Tops */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Top 10 Pelatihan">
                                <HorizontalBar data={topTrainings} color={defaultPalette[0]} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Top 10 Instruktur">
                                <HorizontalBar data={topInstructors} color={defaultPalette[1]} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Top 10 Tempat">
                                <HorizontalBar data={topLocations} color={defaultPalette[2]} />
                            </ChartCard>
                        </div>
                        
                        {/* Hours Breakdowns */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                            <ChartCard title="Total Jam per Region">
                                <HorizontalBar data={hoursRegion} color={defaultPalette[3]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('region', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Total Jam per Group">
                                <HorizontalBar data={hoursGroup} color={defaultPalette[4]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('group', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <ChartCard title="Total Jam per Departemen (Top 15)" className="h-full" height="flex-1 min-h-[500px]">
                                <HorizontalBar data={hoursDept} color={defaultPalette[5]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('organization_name', entry.name)} />
                            </ChartCard>
                            <div className="grid grid-rows-2 gap-6">
                                <ChartCard title="Total Jam - Golongan">
                                    <HorizontalBar data={hoursGol} color={defaultPalette[0]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('job_category', entry.name)} />
                                </ChartCard>
                                <ChartCard title="Total Jam - Level">
                                    <HorizontalBar data={hoursLevel} color={defaultPalette[1]} onClick={(entry) => toggleFilter('job_level_code', entry.name)} />
                                </ChartCard>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Datatable */}
                        <TrainingTable filters={filters} />
                        
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="bg-white p-12 text-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm mt-6">
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">Tidak Ada Data</h3>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Sesuaikan filter Anda untuk melihat data.</p>
                    </div>
                )}
            </Deferred>
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

function KPICard({ title, value, format = 'number' }) {
    const formatted = format === 'number' ? formatNumber(value) : value.toLocaleString('id-ID');
    return (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 flex flex-col justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">{title}</h3>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-corporate-dark mt-2">{formatted}</p>
        </div>
    );
}

function TrainingTable({ filters }) {
    const [data, setData] = useState([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    const [lastPage, setLastPage] = useState(1);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [sort, setSort] = useState('year');
    const [dir, setDir] = useState('desc');
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        setLoading(true);
        // Build query string
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if (search) params.append('search', search);
        params.append('page', page);
        params.append('sort', sort);
        params.append('direction', dir);
        
        // Append active filters
        Object.entries(filters || {}).forEach(([k, v]) => {
            if (Array.isArray(v)) {
                v.forEach(val => params.append(`${k}[]`, val));
            } else if (v) {
                params.append(k, v);
            }
        });

        axios.get(`/data/trainings?${params.toString()}`).then(res => {
            setData(res.data.data);
            setLastPage(res.data.last_page);
            setLoading(false);
        }).catch(err => {
            console.error(err);
            setLoading(false);
        });
    }, [page, search, sort, dir, filters]);

    const handleSort = (field) => {
        if (sort === field) {
            setDir(dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSort(field);
            setDir('asc');
        }
    };

    return (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50/50">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-800">Daftar Pelatihan</h3>
                <div className="relative">
                    <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                    <input 
                        type="text" 
                        placeholder="Cari nama pelatihan..." 
                        className="pl-9 pr-4 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg text-sm w-64 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-corporate-light/20"
                        value={search}
                        onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }}
                    />
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="overflow-x-auto relative min-h-[300px]">
                {loading && (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/60 flex items-center justify-center z-10">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-corporate-light border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                    </div>
                )}
                <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-600">
                    <thead className="text-xs uppercase bg-gray-50 text-gray-500">
                        <tr>
                            <th className="px-6 py-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100" onClick={() => handleSort('training_name')}>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">Pelatihan {sort==='training_name' && (dir==='asc'?<ChevronUp size={14}/>:<ChevronDown size={14}/>)}</div>
                            </th>
                            <th className="px-6 py-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100" onClick={() => handleSort('month')}>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">Bulan {sort==='month' && (dir==='asc'?<ChevronUp size={14}/>:<ChevronDown size={14}/>)}</div>
                            </th>
                            <th className="px-6 py-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 text-right" onClick={() => handleSort('participants')}>
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">Peserta {sort==='participants' && (dir==='asc'?<ChevronUp size={14}/>:<ChevronDown size={14}/>)}</div>
                            </th>
                            <th className="px-6 py-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 text-right" onClick={() => handleSort('total_hours')}>
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">Total Jam {sort==='total_hours' && (dir==='asc'?<ChevronUp size={14}/>:<ChevronDown size={14}/>)}</div>
                            </th>
                            <th className="px-6 py-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100" onClick={() => handleSort('source_type')}>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">Tipe {sort==='source_type' && (dir==='asc'?<ChevronUp size={14}/>:<ChevronDown size={14}/>)}</div>
                            </th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                        {data.length > 0 ? data.map((row, idx) => (
                            <tr key={idx} className="hover:bg-gray-50/50">
                                <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-gray-900">{row.training_name}</td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-4">{row.month}/{row.year}</td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">{formatNumber(row.participants)}</td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">{formatNumber(row.total_hours)}</td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-4">
                                    <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium ${row.source_type === 'Internal' ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700' : 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700'}`}>
                                        {row.source_type || 'Unknown'}
                                    </span>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        )) : (
                            <tr>
                                <td colSpan="5" className="px-6 py-8 text-center text-gray-500">
                                    {!loading && "Tidak ada data pelatihan ditemukan."}
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        )}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
            
            <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-gray-500">Halaman {page} dari {lastPage}</span>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <button 
                        disabled={page === 1}
                        onClick={() => setPage(p => p - 1)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 border rounded hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                    >Sebelumnya</button>
                    <button 
                        disabled={page === lastPage || lastPage === 0}
                        onClick={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 border rounded hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                    >Selanjutnya</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function TrainingSkeleton() {
    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
                {[1,2,3,4,5,6].map(i => <div key={i} className="h-24 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />)}
            </div>
            <div className="h-96 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />
        </div>
    );
}
