import { useState } from 'react';
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout';
import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import FilterBar from '@/Components/ui/FilterBar';
import { Search, Download, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { StaffDetailModal } from '@/Components/Map/StaffDetailModal';

export default function TrainingData({ records, filters }) {
    const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(filters.search || '');
    const [selectedEmployee, setSelectedEmployee] = useState(null);

    const handleSearch = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        router.get(
            '/pelatihan/data',
            { ...filters, search: searchTerm, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const handleSort = (column) => {
        const currentSort = filters.sort || 'participant_name';
        const currentOrder = filters.order || 'asc';
        
        let newOrder = 'asc';
        if (currentSort === column) {
            newOrder = currentOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        }

        router.get(
            '/pelatihan/data',
            { ...filters, sort: column, order: newOrder, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const handlePerPageChange = (e) => {
        router.get(
            '/pelatihan/data',
            { ...filters, per_page: e.target.value, page: 1 },
            { preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }
        );
    };

    const SortIcon = ({ column }) => {
        const currentSort = filters.sort || 'participant_name';
        const currentOrder = filters.order || 'asc';
        
        if (currentSort !== column) {
            return <span className="text-gray-300 ml-1">↕</span>;
        }
        
        return currentOrder === 'asc' ? 
            <ChevronUp className="inline w-4 h-4 ml-1 text-blue-600" /> : 
            <ChevronDown className="inline w-4 h-4 ml-1 text-blue-600" />;
    };

    const renderNikBadge = (status) => {
        if (status === 'ok') return <span className="bg-green-100 text-green-700 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ml-2">OK</span>;
        if (status === 'empty') return <span className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ml-2">KOSONG</span>;
        if (status === 'corrupt') return <span className="bg-red-100 text-red-700 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ml-2">RUSAK</span>;
        return <span className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ml-2">TIDAK VALID</span>;
    };

    const renderConnectionBadge = (isLinked) => {
        if (isLinked) {
            return <span className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full whitespace-nowrap">TERHUBUNG KE KARYAWAN</span>;
        }
        return <span className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full whitespace-nowrap">TIDAK TERHUBUNG</span>;
    };

    return (
        <AppLayout title="Data Training Mentah">
            <Head title="Data Training Mentah" />

            <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-6">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Data Training Mentah</h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                        Daftar lengkap rekam data pelatihan ({records.total} baris).
                    </p>
                </div>
                
                <a 
                    href={`/pelatihan/data/export?${new URLSearchParams(filters).toString()}`}
                    className="flex items-center px-4 py-2 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 transition-colors font-medium text-sm shadow-sm"
                >
                    <Download className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    Export Excel
                </a>
            </div>

            <FilterBar />

            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
                <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50/50">
                    <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="flex relative w-80">
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="Cari peserta, NIK, pelatihan, PT..."
                            value={searchTerm}
                            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500/20 focus:border-amber-500 text-sm"
                        />
                        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 absolute left-3 top-3" />
                        <button type="submit" className="hidden">Search</button>
                    </form>
                    
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
                        <span>Tampilkan:</span>
                        <select 
                            value={filters.per_page || 25} 
                            onChange={handlePerPageChange}
                            className="border-gray-200 rounded text-sm py-1 pl-2 pr-6 focus:ring-amber-500 focus:border-amber-500"
                        >
                            <option value="25">25</option>
                            <option value="50">50</option>
                            <option value="100">100</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full text-sm text-left text-gray-600">
                        <thead className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase bg-gray-50/50 border-b border-gray-100">
                            <tr>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('nik')}>
                                    NIK / NIK Mentah <SortIcon column="nik" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('participant_name')}>
                                    Nama Peserta <SortIcon column="participant_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap text-center">Status Terhubung</th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('training_name')}>
                                    Nama Pelatihan <SortIcon column="training_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('pt_name')}>
                                    Nama PT <SortIcon column="pt_name" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('department')}>
                                    Departemen <SortIcon column="department" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('work_location')}>
                                    Lokasi Kerja <SortIcon column="work_location" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('region')}>
                                    Region <SortIcon column="region" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('job_category')}>
                                    Golongan <SortIcon column="job_category" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('period_year')}>
                                    Periode <SortIcon column="period_year" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap text-right" onClick={() => handleSort('hours')}>
                                    Jam <SortIcon column="hours" />
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => handleSort('is_internal')}>
                                    Tipe <SortIcon column="is_internal" />
                                </th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            {records.data.length > 0 ? (
                                records.data.map((rec) => (
                                    <tr key={rec.id} className="bg-white border-b border-gray-50 hover:bg-blue-50/30 transition-colors">
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{rec.nik || '-'}</span>
                                            {renderNikBadge(rec.nik_status)}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            {rec.employee ? (
                                                <button 
                                                    onClick={() => setSelectedEmployee(rec.employee)}
                                                    className="text-amber-600 hover:text-amber-700 hover:underline text-left transition-colors"
                                                    title="Klik untuk melihat detail profil karyawan"
                                                >
                                                    {rec.participant_name}
                                                </button>
                                            ) : (
                                                <span title="Tidak dapat dihubungkan ke data karyawan" className="text-gray-900 cursor-not-allowed">
                                                    {rec.participant_name}
                                                </span>
                                            )}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                                            {renderConnectionBadge(!!rec.employee_id)}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-800 font-medium max-w-[200px] truncate" title={rec.training_name}>
                                            {rec.training_name}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            <div className="text-gray-900 font-medium">{rec.pt_name}</div>
                                            {rec.company_alias !== '-' && <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Alias: {rec.company_alias}</div>}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{rec.department || '-'}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{rec.work_location || '-'}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{rec.region || '-'}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{rec.job_category || '-'}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">{rec.period_month}/{rec.period_year}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-right font-semibold">{rec.hours}</td>
                                        <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap text-xs">
                                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                                                <span className="text-gray-500">{rec.is_internal ? 'Internal' : 'Eksternal'}</span>
                                                <span className="text-gray-400">{rec.is_regular ? 'Reguler' : 'Non Reguler'}</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                ))
                            ) : (
                                <tr>
                                    <td colSpan="12" className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-gray-500">
                                        Tidak ada data training yang ditemukan.
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            )}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>

                {/* Pagination Controls */}
                <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between bg-white">
                    <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                        Menampilkan <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{records.from || 0}</span> - <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{records.to || 0}</span> dari <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{records.total}</span> data
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        {records.links.map((link, i) => {
                            const isPrev = String(link.label).toLowerCase().includes('previous');
                            const isNext = String(link.label).toLowerCase().includes('next');
                            
                            return (
                                <Link
                                    key={i}
                                    href={link.url || '#'}
                                    className={`
                                        flex items-center justify-center min-w-[2rem] h-8 px-3 text-sm rounded-md transition-colors
                                        ${!link.url ? 'text-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed' : 
                                          link.active ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 font-bold' : 
                                          'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'}
                                    `}
                                    preserveState
                                    preserveScroll
                                >
                                    {isPrev ? <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> : isNext ? <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /> : <span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: link.label }}></span>}
                                </Link>
                            );
                        })}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {selectedEmployee && (
                <StaffDetailModal 
                    employeeId={selectedEmployee.employee_id} 
                    onClose={() => setSelectedEmployee(null)} 
                />
            )}
        </AppLayout>
    );
}

<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Inertia\Inertia;

Route::get('/', function () {
    return redirect('/dashboard');
});

// Since we skipped Breeze, we create a very simple login placeholder for Phase 0
Route::middleware('guest')->group(function () {
    Route::get('/login', function () {
        return Inertia::render('Auth/Login');
    })->name('login');

    Route::post('/login', function (\Illuminate\Http\Request $request) {
        $credentials = $request->validate([
            'email' => ['required', 'email'],
            'password' => ['required'],
        ]);

        if (\Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth::attempt($credentials)) {
            $request->session()->regenerate();
            return redirect()->intended('dashboard');
        }

        return back()->withErrors([
            'email' => 'Email atau password salah.',
        ]);
    });
});

Route::middleware('auth')->group(function () {
    Route::post('/logout', function (\Illuminate\Http\Request $request) {
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth::logout();
        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();
        return redirect('/login');
    })->name('logout');

    Route::get('/pengaturan', [\App\Http\Controllers\ProfileController::class, 'edit'])->name('profile.edit');
    Route::patch('/pengaturan/profil', [\App\Http\Controllers\ProfileController::class, 'updateProfile'])->name('profile.update');
    Route::put('/pengaturan/password', [\App\Http\Controllers\ProfileController::class, 'updatePassword'])->name('profile.password');

    Route::get('/dashboard', function (\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, \App\Support\EmployeeFilter $filter) {
        $asOf = $request->input('as_of') ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($request->input('as_of')) : \Carbon\Carbon::now();
        $metricsService = new \App\Services\WorkforceMetrics($asOf);
        
        return Inertia::render('Dashboard', [
            'metrics' => Inertia::defer(fn () => $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter, $request->user())),
            'insight' => Inertia::defer(function () use ($metricsService, $request, $filter) {
                $metrics = $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter, $request->user());
                return \App\Services\InsightBuilder::build($metrics['raw_totals'], $metrics['avg_age'], $metrics['raw_totals']['total_hc']);
            }),
            'filters' => $request->all()
        ]);
    })->name('dashboard');

    Route::get('/peta', function () {
        return Inertia::render('Map/Index');
    })->name('peta');

    Route::get('/demografi', function (\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, \App\Support\EmployeeFilter $filter) {
        $asOf = $request->input('as_of') ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($request->input('as_of')) : \Carbon\Carbon::now();
        $metricsService = new \App\Services\WorkforceMetrics($asOf);
        
        return Inertia::render('Demographics', [
            'metrics' => Inertia::defer(fn () => $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter, $request->user())),
            'filters' => $request->all()
        ]);
    })->name('demografi');

    Route::get('/masa-kerja', function (\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, \App\Support\EmployeeFilter $filter) {
        $metricsService = new \App\Services\TenureMetrics();
        return Inertia::render('Tenure', [
            'metrics' => Inertia::defer(fn () => $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter)),
            'filters' => $request->all()
        ]);
    })->name('masa-kerja');

    Route::get('/pensiun', function (\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, \App\Support\EmployeeFilter $filter) {
        $metricsService = new \App\Services\RetirementMetrics();
        return Inertia::render('Retirement', [
            'metrics' => Inertia::defer(fn () => $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter)),
            'filters' => $request->all()
        ]);
    })->name('pensiun');

    Route::get('/pelatihan', function (\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, \App\Support\TrainingFilter $filter) {
        $metricsService = new \App\Services\TrainingMetrics();
        return Inertia::render('Training', [
            'metrics' => Inertia::defer(fn () => $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter, $request->user())),
            'filters' => $request->all()
        ]);
    })->name('pelatihan');

    Route::get('/pelatihan/data', [\App\Http\Controllers\TrainingRecordController::class, 'index'])->name('pelatihan.data');
    Route::get('/pelatihan/data/export', [\App\Http\Controllers\TrainingRecordController::class, 'export'])->name('pelatihan.data.export');

    Route::get('/analisis-gabungan', function (\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, \App\Support\EmployeeFilter $filter) {
        $metricsService = new \App\Services\CombinedMetrics();
        return Inertia::render('Combined', [
            'metrics' => Inertia::defer(fn () => $metricsService->getMetrics($request, $filter)),
            'filters' => $request->all()
        ]);
    })->name('analisis-gabungan');

    // Karyawan route

File: scratch_audit.php

<?php
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Location;

$locations = Location::pluck('name', 'id')->toArray();

$facilities = ['Estate' => [], 'Mill' => [], 'HO' => []];
$regions = ['Sumatera' => [], 'Kalimantan' => [], 'Jawa / HO' => [], 'Lainnya' => []];

foreach (Employee::all() as $e) {
    $locName = $locations[$e->location_id] ?? '';
    $regionStr = $e->region ?? 'Unknown';
    $orgName = $e->organization_name ?? '';
    
    // Facility Logic
    $facilityType = match(true) {
        stripos($locName, 'office') !== false || stripos($locName, 'jakarta') !== false => 'HO',
        stripos($locName, 'pabrik') !== false || stripos($locName, 'mill') !== false || stripos($locName, 'kcp') !== false || stripos($locName, 'biodiesel') !== false || stripos($locName, 'bulking') !== false => 'Mill',
        default => 'Estate'
    };
    
    // Region Logic
    $targetRegion = 'Lainnya';
    if (stripos($regionStr, 'riau') !== false || stripos($regionStr, 'sumatera') !== false) $targetRegion = 'Sumatera';
    else if (stripos($regionStr, 'kalbar') !== false || stripos($regionStr, 'kubar') !== false || stripos($regionStr, 'kalimantan') !== false) $targetRegion = 'Kalimantan';
    else if (stripos($regionStr, 'corp') !== false || stripos($regionStr, 'jakarta') !== false) $targetRegion = 'Jawa / HO';
    
    $key = "$locName ($orgName)";
    
    if (!isset($facilities[$facilityType][$key])) $facilities[$facilityType][$key] = 0;
    $facilities[$facilityType][$key]++;
    
    if (!isset($regions[$targetRegion][$key])) $regions[$targetRegion][$key] = 0;
    $regions[$targetRegion][$key]++;
}

echo "=== LAINNYA REGIONS ===\n";
arsort($regions['Lainnya']);
foreach($regions['Lainnya'] as $k => $v) {
    echo "$k: $v\n";
}

echo "\n=== RANDOM 15 ESTATE ===\n";
$estateKeys = array_keys($facilities['Estate']);
shuffle($estateKeys);
foreach(array_slice($estateKeys, 0, 15) as $k) {
    echo "$k\n";
}

echo "\n=== RANDOM 15 MILL ===\n";
$millKeys = array_keys($facilities['Mill']);
shuffle($millKeys);
foreach(array_slice($millKeys, 0, 15) as $k) {
    echo "$k\n";
}

echo "\n=== RANDOM 15 HO ===\n";
$hoKeys = array_keys($facilities['HO']);
shuffle($hoKeys);
foreach(array_slice($hoKeys, 0, 15) as $k) {
    echo "$k\n";
}

echo "\nTOTAL HC: " . Employee::count() . "\n";

File: tests/Feature/CombinedAnalysisTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;
use App\Models\Employee;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Services\CombinedMetrics;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Support\EmployeeFilter;

class CombinedAnalysisTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_linked_only_filter_is_stable_when_unlinked_rows_added()
    {
        // 0. Create company
        $companyId = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId([
            'name' => 'PT Test',
            'code' => 'TEST',
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);

        // 1. Create one employee
        Employee::create([
            'employee_id' => 'E001',
            'name' => 'John Doe',
            'company_id' => $companyId,
            'region' => 'Riau',
            'organization_name' => 'IT',
            'job_level_code' => 'A',
            'birth_date' => '1990-01-01',
            'join_date' => '2020-01-01',
            'gender' => 'Male'
        ]);
        $emp = Employee::first();

        // 2. Add 1 linked training record
        DB::table('training_records')->insert([
            'employee_id' => $emp->id,
            'hours' => 10,
            'participant_name' => 'John Doe',
            'nik' => 'E001',
            'year' => 2026,
            'month' => 1,
            'days' => 1,
            'training_name' => 'Test Training'
        ]);

        // Calculate metrics
        $service = new CombinedMetrics();
        $request = new Request();
        $filter = new EmployeeFilter();
        
        $metricsBefore = $service->getMetrics($request, $filter);

        // Verify some initial metrics
        $this->assertEquals(1, $metricsBefore['coverage']['region'][0]['trained']);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $metricsBefore['coverage']['region'][0]['total']);
        $this->assertEquals(10, $metricsBefore['hours']['gender'][0]['total_hours']);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $metricsBefore['banner']['total_count']);
        $this->assertEquals(0, $metricsBefore['banner']['unlinked_count']);

        // 3. Add 5 UNLINKED training records (employee_id IS NULL)
        for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
            DB::table('training_records')->insert([
                'employee_id' => null,
                'hours' => 20,
                'participant_name' => 'Unknown',
                'nik' => null,
                'year' => 2026,
                'month' => 1,
                'days' => 1,
                'training_name' => 'Unlinked Training'
            ]);
        }

        // Calculate metrics again
        $metricsAfter = $service->getMetrics($request, $filter);

        // Banner should change
        $this->assertEquals(6, $metricsAfter['banner']['total_count']);
        $this->assertEquals(5, $metricsAfter['banner']['unlinked_count']);

        // But ACTUAL metrics should NOT change!
        $this->assertEquals($metricsBefore['coverage'], $metricsAfter['coverage']);
        $this->assertEquals($metricsBefore['hours'], $metricsAfter['hours']);
        $this->assertEquals($metricsBefore['scatter'], $metricsAfter['scatter']);
        $this->assertEquals($metricsBefore['company_ranking'], $metricsAfter['company_ranking']);
    }
}

File: tests/Feature/DataEndpointTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Company;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Location;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\TestCase;

class DataEndpointTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->user = User::factory()->create();

        $this->company1Id = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId(['code' => 'CA', 'name' => 'Company A']);
        $this->company2Id = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId(['code' => 'CB', 'name' => 'Company B']);

        $this->location1Id = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId(['code' => 'L1', 'name' => 'Location 1', 'latitude' => 1.0, 'longitude' => 1.0]);
        $this->location2Id = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId(['code' => 'L2', 'name' => 'Location 2', 'latitude' => 2.0, 'longitude' => 2.0]);

        DB::table('employees')->insert([
            ['employee_id' => 'E1', 'name' => 'E1', 'company_id' => $this->company1Id, 'location_id' => $this->location1Id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],
            ['employee_id' => 'E2', 'name' => 'E2', 'company_id' => $this->company1Id, 'location_id' => $this->location1Id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],
            ['employee_id' => 'E3', 'name' => 'E3', 'company_id' => $this->company1Id, 'location_id' => $this->location1Id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],

            ['employee_id' => 'E4', 'name' => 'E4', 'company_id' => $this->company2Id, 'location_id' => $this->location2Id, 'region' => 'Kalbar', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],
            ['employee_id' => 'E5', 'name' => 'E5', 'company_id' => $this->company2Id, 'location_id' => $this->location2Id, 'region' => 'Kalbar', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],

            // Shared location: Location 1 is used by Company B as well
            ['employee_id' => 'E6', 'name' => 'E6', 'company_id' => $this->company2Id, 'location_id' => $this->location1Id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'gender' => 'Male', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'join_date' => '2015-01-01'],
        ]);
    }

    public function test_companies_endpoint_returns_correct_shape_and_counts()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertJsonStructure([
            'data' => [
                '*' => ['id', 'code', 'name', 'employee_count', 'location_count', 'region'],
            ],
            'total_locations',
        ]);

        // Total unique locations should be 2
        $this->assertEquals(2, $response->json('total_locations'));

        $data = collect($response->json('data'));

        // Company 1 has 3 employees, 1 location
        $c1 = $data->firstWhere('id', $this->company1Id);
        $this->assertEquals(3, $c1['employee_count']);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $c1['location_count']);

        // Company 2 has 3 employees, 2 locations (location 2 and location 1)
        $c2 = $data->firstWhere('id', $this->company2Id);
        $this->assertEquals(3, $c2['employee_count']);
        $this->assertEquals(2, $c2['location_count']);
    }

    public function test_locations_endpoint_groups_by_location_id_and_avoids_n_plus_one()
    {
        DB::enableQueryLog();

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/map/locations');

        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $queries = DB::getQueryLog();
        $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(5, count($queries), 'Too many queries, N+1 detected');

        // There should be exactly 2 locations
        $response->assertJsonCount(2);

        $data = collect($response->json());
        $l1 = $data->firstWhere('id', $this->location1Id);
        $this->assertCount(2, $l1['companies'], 'Location 1 should have 2 companies');
        $this->assertEquals(4, $l1['employee_count'], 'Location 1 should have 4 employees');
    }

    public function test_employee_detail_endpoint_creates_audit_log()
    {
        $employee = Employee::first();
        $this->assertNotNull($employee, 'No employee found');

        // Clear existing audit logs just in case
        DB::table('audit_logs')->truncate();

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson("/data/employees/{$employee->employee_id}");

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertJsonStructure(['identitas', 'pribadi', 'kepegawaian', 'pelatihan']);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', [
            'user_id' => $this->user->id,
            'action' => 'VIEW_EMPLOYEE_DETAIL',
            'subject_type' => Employee::class,
            'subject_id' => $employee->id,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\TestCase;

class FilterTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->user = User::factory()->create();

        $companyId = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId([
            'code' => 'TESTCOMP',
            'name' => 'Test Company',
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $locationId = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId([
            'code' => 'TESTLOC',
            'name' => 'Test Location',
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);

        DB::table('employees')->insert([
            [
                'employee_id' => 'EMP01',
                'name' => 'Employee 1',
                'company_id' => $companyId,
                'location_id' => $locationId,
                'region' => 'Riau',
                'job_level_code' => 'MGR',
                'employment_type' => 'PERM',
                'gender' => 'Male',
                'birth_date' => '1990-01-01',
                'join_date' => '2015-01-01',
            ],
            [
                'employee_id' => 'EMP02',
                'name' => 'Employee 2',
                'company_id' => $companyId,
                'location_id' => $locationId,
                'region' => 'Kalbar',
                'job_level_code' => 'STF',
                'employment_type' => 'CONT',
                'gender' => 'Female',
                'birth_date' => '1995-01-01',
                'join_date' => '2020-01-01',
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function test_filter_by_region()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?region=Riau');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(1, $data->first()['employee_count']);
    }

    public function test_filter_by_job_level()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?job_level_code=MGR');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(1, $data->first()['employee_count']);
    }

    public function test_filter_by_employment_type()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?employment_type=CONT');
        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(1, $data->first()['employee_count']);
    }

    public function test_combination_filters()
    {
        // Should return 0 employees if combination does not exist
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?region=Kalbar&job_level_code=MGR');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(0, collect($data)->sum('employee_count'));

        // Should return 1 employee if combination matches
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user)->getJson('/data/companies?region=Kalbar&job_level_code=STF');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $data = collect($response->json('data'));
        $this->assertEquals(1, collect($data)->sum('employee_count'));
    }
}

File: tests/Feature/ImportTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Services\Import\EmployeeImporter;
use App\Services\Import\TrainingImporter;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ImportTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_import_is_idempotent()
    {
        // Setup dummy CSV for employee
        $empCsv = "Employee ID;Employee Name;Join Date;Employment Type;Job Level Code;Job Title Code;Job Title Name;Organization Code;Organization Name;Location Code;Location Name;Company Code;Company Name;Birth Date;Birth Place;Gender;Marital Status;Religion;PTKP Code;PTKP Name;Group;Region\n" .
                  "E001;John Doe;01-Jan-20;PERM;L1;T1;Manager;O1;Org 1;LOC1;Loc Name 1;C1;Comp 1;01-Jan-80;Jakarta;Male;Single;Islam;TK;TK;G1;Riau";
        
        $trainCsv = "NIK;Nama;Jenis Kelamin;Nama PT;Department;lokasi Kerja;Group;REGION;GOL;Jabatan;Tgl;Bln;Thn;Jml Hari;Jam Pelatihan;Nama Pelatihan;Instruktur;Tempat Pelatihan;Reg / Non Reg;Keterangan;Internal/Eksternal;Level;Periode\n" .
                    "E001;John Doe;Male;Comp 1;Dept 1;Loc 1;G1;Riau;Gol 1;Manager;;JAN;2023;1;8;Training 1;Inst 1;Venue 1;Reguler;;Internal;Level 1;Q1";
        
        $empFile = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'emp_');
        $trainFile = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'trn_');
        file_put_contents($empFile, $empCsv);
        file_put_contents($trainFile, $trainCsv);

        $empImporter = new EmployeeImporter();
        $trainImporter = new TrainingImporter();

        $empFileUploaded = new \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile($empFile, 'emp.csv', 'text/csv', null, true);
        $trainFileUploaded = new \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile($trainFile, 'train.csv', 'text/csv', null, true);

        $empBatch1 = $empImporter->import($empFileUploaded);
        $trainBatch1 = $trainImporter->import($trainFileUploaded);

        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('employees')->count());
        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('training_records')->count());
        $this->assertEquals(1, $empBatch1->rows_imported);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $trainBatch1->rows_imported);

        // Run again, should be idempotent
        $empBatch2 = $empImporter->import($empFileUploaded);
        $trainBatch2 = $trainImporter->import($trainFileUploaded);

        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('employees')->count());
        $this->assertEquals(1, DB::table('training_records')->count());
        $this->assertEquals(1, $empBatch2->rows_imported);
        $this->assertEquals(1, $trainBatch2->rows_imported);

        unlink($empFile);
        unlink($trainFile);
    }

    public function test_import_rejects_invalid_headers()
    {
        $csv = "Wrong Header;Another\n1;2";
        $file = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'err_');
        file_put_contents($file, $csv);

        $importer = new EmployeeImporter();
        $this->expectException(\RuntimeException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessageMatches('/Kolom hilang: Employee ID/');
        
        try {
            $importer->import(new \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile($file, 'test.csv', 'text/csv', null, true));
        } finally {
            unlink($file);
        }
    }

    public function test_import_query_count()
    {
        $empCsv = "Employee ID;Employee Name;Join Date;Employment Type;Job Level Code;Job Title Code;Job Title Name;Organization Code;Organization Name;Location Code;Location Name;Company Code;Company Name;Birth Date;Birth Place;Gender;Marital Status;Religion;PTKP Code;PTKP Name;Group;Region\n" .
                  "E001;John Doe;01-Jan-20;PERM;L1;T1;Manager;O1;Org 1;LOC1;Loc Name 1;C1;Comp 1;01-Jan-80;Jakarta;Male;Single;Islam;TK;TK;G1;Riau\n" .
                  "E002;Jane Doe;01-Jan-20;PERM;L1;T1;Manager;O1;Org 1;LOC1;Loc Name 1;C1;Comp 1;01-Jan-80;Jakarta;Female;Single;Islam;TK;TK;G1;Riau";
        $file = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'emp_');
        file_put_contents($file, $empCsv);

        $importer = new EmployeeImporter();
        
        DB::enableQueryLog();
        $importer->import(new \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile($file, 'test.csv', 'text/csv', null, true));
        $queries = DB::getQueryLog();
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        $this->assertLessThan(20, count($queries));
        unlink($file);
    }

    public function test_upsert_employee_and_warnings()
    {
        $compId = DB::table('companies')->insertGetId(['code' => 'C99', 'name' => 'Old']);
        $locId = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId(['code' => 'L99', 'name' => 'Old Loc']);

        DB::table('employees')->insert([
            'employee_id' => 'E999', 'name' => 'Old', 'company_id' => $compId, 'location_id' => $locId,
            'join_date' => '2020-01-01', 'birth_date' => '1990-01-01', 'employment_type' => 'PERMANENT',
            'gender' => 'Male', 'marital_status' => 'Single', 'religion' => 'Islam', 'region' => 'Riau'
        ]);

        $empCsv = "Employee ID;Employee Name;Join Date;Employment Type;Job Level Code;Job Title Code;Job Title Name;Organization Code;Organization Name;Location Code;Location Name;Company Code;Company Name;Birth Date;Birth Place;Gender;Marital Status;Religion;PTKP Code;PTKP Name;Group;Region\n" .
                  "E001;John Doe;01-Jan-20;PERM;L1;T1;Manager;O1;Org 1;LOC1;Loc Name 1;C1;Comp 1;01-Jan-80;Jakarta;Male;Single;Islam;TK;TK;G1;Riau";
        $file = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'emp_');
        file_put_contents($file, $empCsv);

        $importer = new EmployeeImporter();
        $batch = $importer->import(new \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile($file, 'test.csv', 'text/csv', null, true));
        
        $warnings = is_string($batch->warnings) ? json_decode($batch->warnings, true) : $batch->warnings;
        $hasMissingWarning = false;
        if ($warnings) {
            foreach ($warnings as $type => $w) {
                if ($type === 'missing_from_file' || (isset($w['type']) && $w['type'] === 'missing_from_file')) {
                    $hasMissingWarning = true;
                }
            }
        }

        $this->assertTrue($hasMissingWarning);
        unlink($file);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Models\Location;

class LocationTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_admin_can_update_coordinate()
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $loc = Location::create(['code' => 'L1', 'name' => 'Loc 1']);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->post("/admin/lokasi/{$loc->id}", [
            'latitude' => -6.2,
            'longitude' => 106.8
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('locations', ['code' => 'L1', 'latitude' => -6.2, 'longitude' => 106.8]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'UPDATE_LOCATION']);
    }

    public function test_coordinate_validation_boundaries()
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $loc = Location::create(['code' => 'L1', 'name' => 'Loc 1']);

        // Invalid latitude
        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->post("/admin/lokasi/{$loc->id}", [
            'latitude' => -12, // Out of bounds (-11 to 6)
            'longitude' => 106.8
        ]);
        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('latitude');

        // Invalid longitude
        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->post("/admin/lokasi/{$loc->id}", [
            'latitude' => -6.2,
            'longitude' => 90 // Out of bounds (95 to 141)
        ]);
        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('longitude');
    }

    public function test_import_locations()
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        Location::create(['code' => 'L1', 'name' => 'Loc 1']);
        Location::create(['code' => 'L2', 'name' => 'Loc 2']);

        $csv = "code;latitude;longitude\nL1;-6.2;106.8\nL2;-12;100\nL3;-6;100";
        $file = UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('locs.csv', $csv);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->post('/admin/lokasi-import', [
            'file' => $file
        ]);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('locations', ['code' => 'L1', 'latitude' => -6.2, 'longitude' => 106.8]);
        
        // L2 rejected because out of bounds (-12)
        $loc2 = Location::where('code', 'L2')->first();
        $this->assertNull($loc2->latitude);
        
        $response->assertSessionHas('warning'); // because L2 failed
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'IMPORT_LOCATIONS']);
    }

    public function test_import_with_coordinate_source()
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        Location::create(['code' => 'L1', 'name' => 'Loc 1']);
        Location::create(['code' => 'L2', 'name' => 'Loc 2']);
        Location::create(['code' => 'L3', 'name' => 'Loc 3']);

        $csv = "code;latitude;longitude;confidence\nL1;-6.2;106.8;resmi\nL2;-6;100;pendekatan-alamat\nL3;-6;100;sedang";
        $file = UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('locs2.csv', $csv);

        $this->actingAs($user)->post('/admin/lokasi-import', [
            'file' => $file
        ]);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('locations', ['code' => 'L1', 'coordinate_source' => 'resmi']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('locations', ['code' => 'L2', 'coordinate_source' => 'pendekatan']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('locations', ['code' => 'L3', 'coordinate_source' => 'pendekatan']);
    }

    public function test_import_validates_region_boundaries()
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $loc1 = Location::create(['code' => 'R1', 'name' => 'Loc Riau']);
        \App\Models\Company::create(['id' => 1, 'code' => 'C1', 'name' => 'Comp']);
        // Create an employee so region is Riau
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('employees')->insert(['employee_id' => '123', 'name' => 'A', 'location_id' => $loc1->id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'company_id' => 1]);

        // Riau limits: lat -1.5..2.5, lng 100..104.5
        // Let's provide a valid coordinate and an invalid one
        $loc2 = Location::create(['code' => 'R2', 'name' => 'Loc Riau Out']);
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('employees')->insert(['employee_id' => '124', 'name' => 'B', 'location_id' => $loc2->id, 'region' => 'Riau', 'company_id' => 1]);

        $csv = "code;latitude;longitude\nR1;1.0;102.0\nR2;3.0;102.0"; // R2 lat is 3.0 (outside 2.5)
        $file = UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('locs_region.csv', $csv);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->post('/admin/lokasi-import', [
            'file' => $file
        ]);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('locations', ['code' => 'R1', 'latitude' => 1.0]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('locations', ['code' => 'R2', 'latitude' => 3.0]); // It is NOT rejected, just a warning
        $response->assertSessionHas('warning'); // The session should have the warning string
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ProfileTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_profile_page_is_displayed(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();  

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->get('/pengaturan');

        $response->assertOk();
    }

    public function test_profile_information_can_be_updated(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->patch('/pengaturan/profil', [
            'name' => 'Test User Updated',
            'email' => 'testupdated@example.com',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $response->assertRedirect();

        $user->refresh();

        $this->assertSame('Test User Updated', $user->name);
        $this->assertSame('testupdated@example.com', $user->email);
        
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', [
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'action' => 'account.updated'
        ]);
    }

    public function test_profile_information_rejects_invalid_email(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->patch('/pengaturan/profil', [
            'name' => 'Test User',
            'email' => 'not-an-email',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('email');
    }

    public function test_password_can_be_updated(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'password' => Hash::make('password_lama'),
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->put('/pengaturan/password', [
            'current_password' => 'password_lama',
            'password' => 'password_baru_panjang',
            'password_confirmation' => 'password_baru_panjang',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $response->assertRedirect();

        $this->assertTrue(Hash::check('password_baru_panjang', $user->refresh()->password));
        
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', [
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'action' => 'account.password_changed'
        ]);
    }

    public function test_correct_password_must_be_provided_to_update_password(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'password' => Hash::make('password_lama'),
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->put('/pengaturan/password', [
            'current_password' => 'password_salah',
            'password' => 'password_baru_panjang',
            'password_confirmation' => 'password_baru_panjang',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('current_password');
    }

    public function test_new_password_must_be_at_least_12_characters(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'password' => Hash::make('password_lama'),
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->put('/pengaturan/password', [
            'current_password' => 'password_lama',
            'password' => 'pendek',
            'password_confirmation' => 'pendek',
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('password');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\WithFaker;
use Tests\TestCase;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\TrainingRecord;
use App\Models\Employee;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use App\Exports\TrainingRecordsExport;

class TrainingRecordDataTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
    }

    public function test_training_data_index_renders_with_pagination()
    {
        TrainingRecord::factory()->count(30)->create();

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data?per_page=25');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Training/Data')
            ->has('records.data', 25)
            ->where('records.total', 30)
        );
    }

    public function test_training_data_search_works()
    {
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['participant_name' => 'Budi Santoso']);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['participant_name' => 'Andi Wijaya']);

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data?search=Budi');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Training/Data')
            ->has('records.data', 1)
            ->where('records.data.0.participant_name', 'Budi Santoso')
        );
    }

    public function test_training_data_nik_status_filter_rusak_works()
    {
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['nik_status' => 'ok']);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['nik_status' => 'empty']);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['nik_status' => 'corrupt']);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['nik_status' => 'not_found']);

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data?nik_status=rusak');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Training/Data')
            ->has('records.data', 1)
            ->where('records.data.0.nik_status', 'corrupt')
        );
    }
    
    public function test_training_data_nik_status_filter_terhubung_works()
    {
        $company = \App\Models\Company::create(['code' => 'TEST', 'name' => 'Test Company']);
        $employeeId = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('employees')->insertGetId([
            'employee_id' => 'EMP123',
            'name' => 'John Doe',
            'company_id' => $company->id,
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now()
        ]);
        
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['employee_id' => $employeeId]);
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create(['employee_id' => null]);

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data?nik_status=terhubung');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page
            ->component('Training/Data')
            ->has('records.data', 1)
            ->where('records.data.0.employee_id', $employeeId)
        );
    }

    public function test_training_data_export_works_and_avoids_scientific_notation()
    {
        Excel::fake();

        // Create a record with a NIK that looks like scientific notation if parsed as number
        TrainingRecord::factory()->create([
            'nik' => '1234E567',
            'nik_raw' => '1234E567',
            'nik_status' => 'ok'
        ]);

        $response = $this->get('/pelatihan/data/export');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        
        Excel::assertDownloaded('data_training_' . date('Ymd_His') . '.xlsx', function (TrainingRecordsExport $export) {
            return $export instanceof \Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithCustomValueBinder;
        });
    }
}

File: tests/Unit/CleanTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Support\Clean;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class CleanTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_date2_parsing()
    {
        $d = Clean::date2('04-Dec-06', 15);
        $this->assertEquals('2006-12-04', $d->format('Y-m-d'));

        $d = Clean::date2('04-Dec-99', 15);
        $this->assertEquals('1999-12-04', $d->format('Y-m-d'));
        
        $this->assertNull(Clean::date2('', 15));
        $this->assertNull(Clean::date2('invalid', 15));
    }

    public function test_month_parsing()
    {
        $this->assertEquals(1, Clean::month('JAN'));
        $this->assertEquals(5, Clean::month('MEI'));
        $this->assertEquals(8, Clean::month('AGU'));
        $this->assertNull(Clean::month('xyz'));
    }

    public function test_region_mapping()
    {
        $this->assertEquals('Kaltim', Clean::region('Kaltim'));
        $this->assertEquals('Riau', Clean::region('riau'));
        $this->assertNull(Clean::region(''));
    }

    public function test_nik_status()
    {
        $this->assertEquals('empty', Clean::nikStatus('-'));
        $this->assertEquals('empty', Clean::nikStatus(''));
        $this->assertEquals('ok', Clean::nikStatus('20140700000000'));
        $this->assertEquals('corrupt', Clean::nikStatus('2,01407E+13'));
        $this->assertEquals('invalid', Clean::nikStatus('Promosi'));
        $this->assertEquals('ok', Clean::nikStatus('123456'));
    }

    public function test_company_key()
    {
        $this->assertEquals('PANCA SURYA GARDEN', Clean::companyKey('PT. Panca Surya Garden'));
        $this->assertEquals('PANCA SURYA GARDEN', Clean::companyKey('PANCA SURYA GARDEN'));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Support\Demographics;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Tests\TestCase;

class DemographicsTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_age_calculations()
    {
        Carbon::setTestNow('2026-09-28');
        
        $birth = Carbon::parse('1996-09-28');
        $this->assertEquals(30, Demographics::ageFullYears($birth));
        $this->assertEquals('25-34', Demographics::ageGroup(30));
        
        $this->assertEquals('Gen Y', Demographics::generation(1996));
        $this->assertEquals('Boomers', Demographics::generation(1960));
    }

    public function test_retirement_risk()
    {
        Carbon::setTestNow('2026-09-28');
        config(['sdm.retirement_age' => 55]);
        
        $retiringSoon = Carbon::parse('1971-09-28');
        $this->assertTrue(Demographics::isRetirementRisk($retiringSoon));
        
        $safe = Carbon::parse('1980-01-01');
        $this->assertFalse(Demographics::isRetirementRisk($safe));
        $this->assertTrue(Demographics::retiresInYears($safe, 10));
        $this->assertFalse(Demographics::retiresInYears($safe, 5));
    }
}
